sentences.en: The sales figures for this quarter were disappointing, falling short of our projections.
sentences.cn: 本季的销售数字令人失望，未达我们的预测目标。

sentences.en: We received disappointing feedback from the client regarding the recent product demonstration.
sentences.cn: 我们收到客户对最近产品演示的令人失望的回馈。

trans.tran: 失望；令人失望的人或事

sentences.en: There was a sense of disappointment among the team members after losing the game.
sentences.cn: 比赛失利后，团队成员之间弥漫着一股失望的情绪。

sentences.en: The movie was a huge disappointment, despite all the positive reviews.
sentences.cn: 尽管有这么多好评，这部电影还是一个巨大的失望。

trans.tran: 对某事的不认同或反对意见，通常表达为轻微的批评或否定。

sentences.en: The manager's disapproval of the new marketing strategy was evident in his silence.
sentences.cn: 经理对新行销策略的不认同从他沉默寡言的举动中显露无遗。

sentences.en: Despite the team's disapproval, the CEO decided to proceed with the project.
sentences.cn: 尽管团队表示不认同，CEO 仍决定继续推进该项目。

trans.tran: 表示不同意、反对；不赞同

sentences.en: The manager disapproved of the employee's decision to take a personal day without prior notice.
sentences.cn: 经理反对员工未事先通知就请事假的决定。

sentences.en: The board of directors disapproved the proposed merger due to concerns about potential financial risks.
sentences.cn: 由于对潜在财务风险的担忧，董事会反对了拟议的并购案。

trans.tran: 拆卸；将...分解开

sentences.en: The technician will disassemble the faulty machine to identify the source of the problem.
sentences.cn: 技术人员将会拆卸故障的机器以找出问题的根源。

sentences.en: Before shipping, please disassemble the large equipment to reduce transportation costs.
sentences.cn: 在运输前，请将大型设备拆卸以降低运输成本。

trans.tran: 灾难；严重损失或破坏事件，通常指突如其来的负面事件，对组织或个人造成重大影响。

sentences.en: The company is assessing the full extent of the disaster caused by the factory fire.
sentences.cn: 公司正在评估工厂火灾造成的灾难性后果。

sentences.en: A natural disaster can severely disrupt supply chains and impact business operations.
sentences.cn: 自然灾害可能会严重扰乱供应链并影响业务运营。

trans.tran: 灾难性的，极其糟糕的；带来严重后果的

sentences.en: The company's new product launch was a disastrous failure due to poor market research.
sentences.cn: 由于市场调查不佳，该公司的新产品发表会以灾难性的失败告终。

sentences.en: Ignoring the safety regulations proved to be a disastrous decision for the construction project.
sentences.cn: 忽视安全规定对该建筑项目来说是一个灾难性的决定。

trans.tran: 支付；拨款

sentences.en: The quarterly disbursement of funds to regional offices was completed ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 向区域办事处的季度资金disbursement提前完成。

sentences.en: Financial controllers oversee all disbursement procedures to maintain strict audit compliance.
sentences.cn: 财务控制员监督所有disbursement进程以保持严格的审计合规。

trans.tran: 丢弃；舍弃；放弃（不再需要的东西或想法）

sentences.en: The manager instructed the staff to discard any outdated inventory before the stocktake.
sentences.cn: 经理指示员工在盘点之前丢弃任何过期的库存。

sentences.en: We need to discard this proposal as it doesn't align with our company's current strategy.
sentences.cn: 我们需要放弃这个提案，因为它与我们公司目前的策略不符。

trans.tran: 具有敏锐洞察力，能辨别细微差异，做出明智判断。

sentences.en: The company seeks a discerning manager who can identify potential risks and opportunities.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找一位具有洞察力的经理，能够识别潜在的风险和机会。

sentences.en: A discerning customer will carefully compare prices and features before making a purchase.
sentences.cn: 一位精明的顾客在购买前会仔细比较价格和功能。

trans.tran: （正式地）解除职务；（医疗上）出院；（电力）放电

sentences.en: The company decided to discharge the employee due to poor performance.
sentences.cn: 由于绩效不佳，公司决定解除该员工的职务。

sentences.en: The patient was discharged from the hospital after a full recovery.
sentences.cn: 患者在完全康复后出院。

trans.tran: 纪律；训练；规范；自律

sentences.en: The company emphasizes discipline and punctuality in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 公司在工作场所强调纪律和准时性。

sentences.en: Employees are expected to discipline themselves to meet deadlines.
sentences.cn: 员工预期会自我约束以达成截止日期。

trans.tran: 揭露；透露（信息、细节等）

sentences.en: The company will disclose its quarterly earnings report next week.
sentences.cn: 本公司将于下周揭露本季的盈利报告。

sentences.en: The contract requires the vendor to disclose any potential conflicts of interest.
sentences.cn: 合约要求供应商揭露任何潜在的利益冲突。

trans.tran: 揭露；公开；披露；公布

sentences.en: The company made a full disclosure of its financial records.
sentences.cn: 该公司完全公开了其财务纪录。

sentences.en: Failure to make a proper disclosure can result in legal penalties.
sentences.cn: 未能妥善披露可能导致法律制裁。

trans.tran: 不适感；不舒服的感觉，通常指身体或心理上的不舒服。

sentences.en: The employee mentioned feeling some discomfort after working overtime for several days.
sentences.cn: 这位员工提到连续加班好几天后感到有些不适。

sentences.en: To minimize discomfort during the training session, please ensure the room temperature is comfortable.
sentences.cn: 为了减少培训过程中可能产生的不适，请确保房间温度舒适。

trans.tran: 断开连接；中断联系

sentences.en: The IT department is working to disconnect the faulty server to prevent further data loss.
sentences.cn: 信息部门正在努力断开故障服务器，以防止进一步的数据遗失。

sentences.en: Due to scheduled maintenance, your internet connection will briefly disconnect at 10:00 AM.
sentences.cn: 由于计划维护，您的网络连接将于上午 10:00 暂时断线。

trans.tran: 断线的；中断连接的；（电话等）已断开

sentences.en: The IT department is troubleshooting why several employees' computers are disconnected from the network.
sentences.cn: IT 部门正在调查为什么几个员工的电脑无法连接到网络。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, the call has been disconnected. Please try again later.
sentences.cn: 很抱歉，电话已断线。请稍后再试。

trans.tran: 停止供应、终止（服务、产品等）

sentences.en: Due to declining sales, the company decided to discontinue the product line.
sentences.cn: 由于销售额下降，公司决定终止该产品线。

sentences.en: We will discontinue service to customers who fail to pay their invoices within 30 days.
sentences.cn: 对于未能于 30 天内支付发票的客户，我们将停止服务。

trans.tran: 折扣；减价优惠

sentences.en: We are offering a 10% discount on all products during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 在节日期间，我们所有产品都提供 10% 的折扣。

sentences.en: The supplier discounted the price by $5 per unit after negotiation.
sentences.cn: 经过协商，供应商将单价降低了 5 美元。

trans.tran: 以折扣价出售或提供的；降低价格的

sentences.en: The company is offering a discounted rate for bulk orders.
sentences.cn: 公司为批量订单提供折扣价格。

sentences.en: We were able to purchase the software at a significantly discounted price during the holiday sale.
sentences.cn: 我们在节日促销期间以大幅折扣的价格购买了这款软件。

trans.tran: 折扣；减价（在商业交易中降低原价以促进销售）

sentences.en: The company offers a 10% discount on bulk orders.
sentences.cn: 公司对大宗订单提供 10% 的折扣。

sentences.en: We need to discount the outdated inventory to clear space for new products.
sentences.cn: 我们需要对过时的库存打折，以腾出空间给新产品。

trans.tran: 使...丧失信心；阻碍；劝退

sentences.en: The company's negative publicity discouraged potential investors.
sentences.cn: 该公司的负面新闻阻吓了潜在投资者。

sentences.en: We don't want to discourage employees from voicing their concerns.
sentences.cn: 我们不希望阻吓员工表达他们的顾虑。

trans.tran: 丧失信心；沮丧感，使人丧失信心的事物或行为。

sentences.en: The company is implementing a mentorship program to combat employee discouragement and boost morale.
sentences.cn: 公司正在实施指导项目，以对抗员工的沮丧感并提高士气。

sentences.en: Despite the initial setbacks, the team remained motivated and refused to let discouragement affect their performance.
sentences.cn: 尽管一开始遇到挫折，团队仍然保持动力，拒绝让沮丧感影响他们的表现。

trans.tran: 阻碍；使...失去信心

sentences.en: The company's strict policies discourage employees from taking risks and innovating.
sentences.cn: 公司的严格政策阻碍了员工冒险和创新。

sentences.en: High interest rates discourage investment in new businesses.
sentences.cn: 高利率会阻碍对新企业的投资。

trans.tran: 论述;谈话;演讲

sentences.en: The academic discourse on climate change continues to evolve.
sentences.cn: 关于气候变化的学术论述持续演进。

sentences.en: He discoursed eloquently on the history of art.
sentences.cn: 他雄辩地论述了艺术史。

trans.tran: 发现；偶然发现；揭露

sentences.en: Our research team is working to discover new markets for our product.
sentences.cn: 我们的研究团队正在努力发现我们产品的新市场。

sentences.en: The auditor discovered several discrepancies in the financial records.
sentences.cn: 审计员发现财务记录中存在一些差异。

trans.tran: 发现；意外发现；揭露

sentences.en: During the audit, the company discovered several discrepancies in the financial records.
sentences.cn: 在审计过程中，公司发现了财务记录中的几个不符。

sentences.en: The research team discovered a new method to improve the efficiency of the production process.
sentences.cn: 研究团队发现了一种提高生产效率的新方法。

trans.tran: 发现；意外发现；探索

sentences.en: Our research team is currently discovering new applications for this technology.
sentences.cn: 我们的研究团队目前正在探索这项技术的新应用。

sentences.en: During the audit, we discovered a discrepancy in the financial records.
sentences.cn: 在审计过程中，我们发现了财务记录中的差异。

trans.tran: 发现；发现物

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative discovery procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的discovery进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the discovery implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了discovery影响。

trans.tran: 谨慎、低调，不引人注目，通常指在处理敏感或私密信息时的行为或态度。

sentences.en: The company handled the sensitive merger negotiations with the utmost discretion.
sentences.cn: 该公司以极高的谨慎度处理了这项敏感的并购谈判。

sentences.en: Please be discreet when discussing confidential project details with colleagues.
sentences.cn: 请在与同事讨论保密的项目细节时保持低调。

trans.tran: 差异；不一致；偏差

sentences.en: There was a significant discrepancy between the budgeted expenses and the actual spending.
sentences.cn: 预算支出与实际支出之间存在显著的差异。

sentences.en: The auditor identified several discrepancies in the financial records that required further investigation.
sentences.cn: 审计员发现财务记录中存在一些需要进一步调查的差异。

trans.tran: 独立的; 分开的; 不连续的

sentences.en: The system has several discrete components that can be managed independently.
sentences.cn: 这个系统有几个独立的组件，可以单独管理。

sentences.en: We need to analyze the data in discrete units to identify patterns.
sentences.cn: 我们需要以离散的单位分析数据，以识别模式。

trans.tran: 判断权；酌情权；谨慎行事

sentences.en: The manager used his discretion to approve the employee's request for a flexible work schedule.
sentences.cn: 经理运用他的酌量权批准了员工弹性工作时间的请求。

sentences.en: We must exercise discretion when handling sensitive client information.
sentences.cn: 在处理敏感客户信息时，我们必须谨慎行事。

trans.tran: 裁量的；任意的；自由决定的

sentences.en: The company offers a discretionary bonus based on individual performance and company profits.
sentences.cn: 公司会根据个人绩效和公司利润发放酌情奖金。

sentences.en: Managers have discretionary authority to approve minor expenses without seeking further permission.
sentences.cn: 经理拥有酌情权限，无需寻求进一步许可即可批准小额开支。

trans.tran: 区别对待；差别待遇（通常指不公平的待遇）

sentences.en: The company has a strict policy against discriminating against employees based on age or gender.
sentences.cn: 公司有严格的政策，禁止根据年龄或性别对员工进行差别待遇。

sentences.en: We strive to create a diverse workforce and avoid any form of discrimination in the hiring process.
sentences.cn: 我们努力创建多元化的人力资源，并避免在招聘过程中出现任何形式的歧视。

trans.tran: 歧视；区别对待

sentences.en: The company has a strict policy against discrimination in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 该公司对工作场所的歧视行为有严格的政策。

sentences.en: Many laws have been enacted to prevent discrimination based on race, gender, or religion.
sentences.cn: 许多法律已颁布，以防止基于种族、性别或宗教的歧视。

trans.tran: 讨论；探讨（某议题）

sentences.en: Let's discuss the project timeline in the meeting this afternoon.
sentences.cn: 我们今天下午的会议上来讨论项目进度。

sentences.en: The management team will discuss the proposed budget cuts with the department heads.
sentences.cn: 管理团队将与部门主管讨论拟议的预算削减。

trans.tran: 讨论；探讨（某议题）

sentences.en: The management team discussed the proposed budget cuts during the meeting.
sentences.cn: 管理团队在会议中讨论了预算削减的提议。

sentences.en: We need to discuss the contract terms with the legal department before signing.
sentences.cn: 签署合约之前，我们需要与法律部门讨论合约条款。

trans.tran: 讨论；探讨（某议题）

sentences.en: The management team is discussing the proposed budget cuts.
sentences.cn: 管理团队正在讨论预算削减的提案。

sentences.en: We need to discuss the project timeline to ensure we meet the deadline.
sentences.cn: 我们需要讨论项目时程，以确保我们能按时完成。

trans.tran: 讨论；会谈，通常涉及多方参与，探讨特定议题。

sentences.en: Let's schedule a brief discussion to address the project's current challenges.
sentences.cn: 让我们安排一次简短的讨论，以解决项目目前面临的挑战。

sentences.en: The management team will hold a discussion with the employees regarding the new company policy.
sentences.cn: 管理团队将与员工就新的公司政策进行讨论。

trans.tran: 讨论；会谈，通常指正式或结构化的对话，用于探讨特定议题。

sentences.en: The project team will hold a series of discussions to finalize the budget.
sentences.cn: 项目团队将举行一系列讨论以敲定预算。

sentences.en: Let's schedule a brief discussion to address the recent performance issues.
sentences.cn: 我们来安排一次简短的讨论，以解决最近的绩效问题。

trans.tran: 疾病；症状（指影响健康或正常运作的状况）

sentences.en: The company's health insurance plan covers a wide range of diseases.
sentences.cn: 公司的健康保险计划涵盖了广泛的疾病。

sentences.en: Due to a widespread disease, the company implemented a remote work policy.
sentences.cn: 由于疾病蔓延，公司实施了远程工作政策。

trans.tran: 伪装；乔装打扮，以掩饰真实身份或外貌。

sentences.en: To gather market research, the consultant disguised himself as a potential customer.
sentences.cn: 为了收集市场调查，顾问伪装成潜在客户。

sentences.en: The company used a new disguise for its product packaging to appeal to a younger demographic.
sentences.cn: 该公司为吸引年轻族群，为其产品包装使用了新的外观设计。

trans.tran: 厌恶；作呕；反感

sentences.en: The smell of rotten food filled her with disgust.
sentences.cn: 腐烂食物的气味让她感到厌恶。

sentences.en: His rude behavior disgusted everyone present.
sentences.cn: 他粗鲁的行为让在场的每个人都感到反感。

trans.tran: 感到厌恶、反感，对某事感到极度不满。

sentences.en: The manager was disgusted by the employee's blatant disregard for company policy.
sentences.cn: 经理对员工公然不遵守公司政策感到非常厌恶。

sentences.en: The client was disgusted with the poor quality of the delivered product and demanded a full refund.
sentences.cn: 客户对交付产品的质量很差感到非常反感，并要求全额退款。

trans.tran: 令人厌恶的；极度不愉快的（通常指味道、外观或行为）

sentences.en: The smell from the faulty equipment was absolutely disgusting, and we had to shut down the production line.
sentences.cn: 来自故障设备的气味令人极度厌恶，我们不得不关闭生产线。

sentences.en: The client found the presentation slides to be visually disgusting and requested a complete redesign.
sentences.cn: 客户认为演示文稿的视觉效果令人厌恶，并要求彻底重新设计。

sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种菜肴，以满足不同顾客的口味。

sentences.en: Please clear the dishes from the table after the meal.
sentences.cn: 用餐完毕后，请将餐盘从桌子上移开。

trans.tran: 餐具、盘碗；（尤指）清洗餐具的过程或服务。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers dishwashing services for large catering events.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅为大型餐饮活动提供洗碗服务。

sentences.en: Please ensure all dishes are properly cleaned before the health inspector arrives.
sentences.cn: 请确保在卫生检查员到来之前，所有餐具都已妥善清洗。

trans.tran: 不诚实的；欺骗的，缺乏正直

sentences.en: The company has a strict policy against dishonest practices, including falsifying expense reports.
sentences.cn: 公司对不诚实行为有严格的政策，包括伪造费用报表。

sentences.en: During the interview, the candidate was asked about their honesty and integrity to ensure they were not dishonest.
sentences.cn: 在面试中，被问及候选人的诚实和正直，以确保他们没有不诚实。

sentences.cn: 饭店厨房配备了商用洗碗机，以处理大量的餐具。

sentences.en: To reduce energy consumption, please ensure the dishwasher is fully loaded before running it.
sentences.cn: 为了减少能源消耗，请确保在启动洗碗机之前已满载。

trans.tran: 名词：圆盘；磁盘；碟盘；动词：用盘片耕作；用圆盘形物体移动或覆盖

sentences.en: Please save your work to a external hard disk before shutting down the computer.
sentences.cn: 关闭电脑前，请将您的工作保存到外置硬盘中。

sentences.en: The new operating system requires more disk space than the previous version.
sentences.cn: 新的操作系统需要比旧版本更多的磁盘空间。

trans.tran: 不喜欢；对...感到厌恶

sentences.en: Many employees dislike the new mandatory overtime policy.
sentences.cn: 许多员工不喜欢这项强制加班的新政策。

sentences.en: I dislike having to deal with difficult clients, but it's part of the job.
sentences.cn: 我不喜欢处理难缠的客户，但这是工作的一部分。

trans.tran: 不喜欢；厌恶

sentences.en: He dislikes attending mandatory team-building exercises.
sentences.cn: 他不喜欢参加强制性的团队建设活动。

sentences.en: The client dislikes the proposed design and requests significant revisions.
sentences.cn: 客户不喜欢这个设计方案，并要求进行重大修改。

trans.tran: 忧郁的，阴沉的；惨淡的，糟糕的

sentences.en: Despite their efforts, the company reported dismal sales figures for the last quarter.
sentences.cn: 尽管他们努力了，公司报告了上季度惨淡的销售数据。

sentences.en: The weather was dismal, with continuous rain all day.
sentences.cn: 天气阴沉，一整天都在下雨。

trans.tran: 拆卸; 拆开; 拆除; 废除; 拆毁; 解散

sentences.en: The engineers had to dismantle the old machinery to repair it.
sentences.cn: 工程师们必须拆卸旧机器以进行维修。

sentences.en: The company decided to dismantle the entire department due to restructuring.
sentences.cn: 由于重组，公司决定解散整个部门。

trans.tran: 解雇；开除；驳回（请求、提案等）

sentences.en: The company decided to dismiss the employee due to poor performance.
sentences.cn: 由于绩效不佳，公司决定解雇这位员工。

sentences.en: The manager dismissed the proposal as unrealistic and not aligned with the company's goals.
sentences.cn: 经理驳回了这个提案，认为它不切实际，且与公司目标不符。

trans.tran: 解雇；开除（员工）

sentences.en: The company announced a series of dismissals due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济下行，公司宣布了一系列解雇。

sentences.en: After repeated warnings, the employee faced dismissal for poor performance.
sentences.cn: 在多次警告后，这位员工因表现不佳而面临解雇。

trans.tran: 解雇；开除（员工）；驳回（申请、提案等）

sentences.en: The company dismissed several employees due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济下滑，公司解雇了几名员工。

sentences.en: The proposal was dismissed by the board of directors as being too costly.
sentences.cn: 董事会驳回了该提案，因为成本太高。

trans.tran: 不服从的；不听从的

sentences.en: The employee's disobedient behavior towards his supervisor resulted in a formal warning.
sentences.cn: 这位员工对主管的不服从行为导致了正式警告。

sentences.en: We need to address the issue of disobedient interns who are not following company protocols.
sentences.cn: 我们需要处理不遵守公司规定的不服从实习生问题。

trans.tran: 混乱、紊乱；（组织、系统、进程等）失序

sentences.en: The company is working to address the supply chain disorder caused by the recent port closures.
sentences.cn: 公司正努力解决近期港口关闭导致的供应链紊乱。

sentences.en: A lack of clear procedures can lead to disorder and inefficiency in the workflow.
sentences.cn: 缺乏明确的进程可能导致工作流程中的混乱和效率低下。

trans.tran: 缺乏条理，杂乱无章，组织性差，通常指文档、工作流程或空间的状态。

sentences.en: The project was delayed because the files were disorganized and difficult to locate.
sentences.cn: 由于文档杂乱无章，难以找到，导致项目延迟。

sentences.en: To improve efficiency, we need to reorganize the office and eliminate the disorganized clutter.
sentences.cn: 为了提高效率，我们需要刷新办公室并消除杂乱的物品。

trans.tran: 截然不同地；大不相同地

sentences.en: The two departments operate disparately, with different budgets and reporting structures.
sentences.cn: 这两个部门运作方式截然不同，拥有不同的预算和报告结构。

sentences.en: Sales figures varied disparately across different regions during the promotional period.
sentences.cn: 促销期间，各个地区的销售额差异很大。

trans.tran: 派遣；调派；发送（人员、物品等）；发布（通知、指令等）

sentences.en: The logistics department will dispatch a courier to deliver the documents immediately.

sentences.cn: 新产品线代表了公司对亚洲市场的重大进军。

trans.tran: 信封；邮件信封

sentences.en: Please ensure all documents are sealed in an envelope before shipping.
sentences.cn: 请确保所有文档在寄送前都密封在信封里。

sentences.en: The receptionist collected the incoming envelopes and sorted them by department.
sentences.cn: 接待员收集了所有寄入的信封，并按部门进行分类。

trans.tran: 环境（指影响企业营运的外部因素，如法规、市场趋势、生态系统等）

sentences.en: The company is committed to minimizing its environmental impact through sustainable practices.
sentences.cn: 该公司致力于透过永续发展的措施来减少其对环境的影响。

sentences.en: A thorough environmental assessment is required before starting any new construction project.
sentences.cn: 在开始任何新的建筑项目之前，必须进行全面的环境评估。

trans.tran: 与环境相关的；环保的

sentences.en: The company is committed to implementing environmentally friendly practices throughout its operations.
sentences.cn: 该公司致力于在其所有营运中实施环保措施。

sentences.en: The environmental impact assessment is a crucial step before launching the new project.
sentences.cn: 在启动新项目之前，环境影响评估是一项关键步骤。

trans.tran: 与环境相关的；关于环境保护的

sentences.en: The company is committed to operating more environmentally friendly facilities.
sentences.cn: 该公司致力于营运更环保的设施。

sentences.en: Environmentally responsible packaging is a key selling point for this product.
sentences.cn: 环保包装是这款产品的主要销售点。

trans.tran: 想像、展望、预见（未来），通常指设想某种理想或可能的景象。

sentences.en: The company's leadership team envisions a future where remote work is standard practice.
sentences.cn: 公司领导团队展望未来，远距工作将成为标准做法。

sentences.en: We need to envision how our product will meet the evolving needs of the market.
sentences.cn: 我们需要想像我们的产品如何满足市场不断变化的需求。

trans.tran: 酵素；酶

sentences.en: Digestive enzymes play a crucial role in breaking down food.
sentences.cn: 消化酵素在分解食物的过程中扮演关键角色。

sentences.en: The body produces various enzymes to facilitate metabolic reactions.
sentences.cn: 人体会产生多种酵素以促进新陈代谢反应。

trans.tran: 史诗般的；极其重要的；令人印象深刻的

sentences.en: The marketing campaign was an epic success, exceeding all sales projections.
sentences.cn: 这次行销活动非常成功，远超出了所有销售预测。

sentences.en: The company is planning an epic product launch event to generate significant buzz.
sentences.cn: 公司正在规划一场史诗般的产品发布活动，以产生巨大的话题。

trans.tran: 流行病；大规模爆发的传染病，通常指影响范围广泛且病例数量异常增加的疾病。

sentences.en: The company temporarily suspended operations due to the global epidemic.
sentences.cn: 由于全球流行病，公司暂停营运。

sentences.en: The health department is working to contain the epidemic and prevent further spread.
sentences.cn: 卫生部门正在努力控制流行病并防止进一步蔓延。

trans.tran: 流行病学；疫学

sentences.en: The study of epidemiology is crucial for understanding the spread and control of diseases.
sentences.cn: 流行病学的研究对于理解疾病的传播与控制至关重要。

sentences.en: Public health agencies rely on epidemiology to track outbreaks and develop prevention strategies.
sentences.cn: 公共卫生机构仰赖流行病学来追踪疫情爆发并制定预防策略。

trans.tran: 一集（电视、广播节目、连载小说等）；一段，片段（尤指不愉快的经历或事件）；插曲

sentences.en: The latest episode of the series will be available for streaming tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 这个系列的最新一集将于明天开放串流观看。

sentences.en: He had a brief episode of dizziness after standing up too quickly.
sentences.cn: 他站起来太快后，短暂地感到一阵晕眩。

trans.tran: 相等的；均等的；与...相同

sentences.en: All employees should be treated equally, regardless of their position.
sentences.cn: 所有员工都应一视同仁，不论其职位。

sentences.en: The project budget needs to be divided equally among the team members.
sentences.cn: 项目预算需要平均分配给团队成员。

trans.tran: 平等；均等，指在机会、待遇等方面没有差异。

sentences.en: The company strives for equality in hiring practices, regardless of gender or ethnicity.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于在招聘实务上实现平等，不论性别或种族。

sentences.en: Ensuring equality of opportunity is a key component of our diversity and inclusion policy.
sentences.cn: 确保机会均等是我们多元共融政策的重要组成部分。

trans.tran: 平等地；均等地；同样地

sentences.en: The company distributes profits equally among its employees.
sentences.cn: 公司将利润均等地分配给所有员工。

sentences.en: All departments should be treated equally when allocating resources.
sentences.cn: 在分配资源时，所有部门都应得到平等对待。

trans.tran: 认为…相等；等同于；使…与…相等

sentences.en: It is a mistake to equate wealth with happiness.
sentences.cn: 把财富等同于幸福是错误的。

sentences.en: We cannot simply equate the success of a company with its profit margin.
sentences.cn: 我们不能简单地将公司的成功等同于其利润率。

trans.tran: 等式；方程式；平衡；综合体

sentences.en: The chemist spent hours trying to balance the chemical equation.
sentences.cn: 化学家花了数小时试图平衡化学方程式。

sentences.en: In the equation of success, hard work is just one variable.
sentences.cn: 在成功的方程式中，努力工作只是其中一个变量。

trans.tran: 平衡；均衡；（心情、情绪的）平静

sentences.en: The market reached an equilibrium where supply met demand.
sentences.cn: 市场达到了供需平衡的状态。

sentences.en: She tried to regain her emotional equilibrium after the stressful meeting.
sentences.cn: 在那场压力重重的会议之后，她试图恢复情绪的平静。

trans.tran: 配备； снабжённый; 提供必要的设备或资源

sentences.en: The company is equipping its new warehouse with state-of-the-art automation systems.
sentences.cn: 公司正在为其新仓库配备最先进的自动化系统。

sentences.en: Before the project can begin, we need to equip the team with the necessary training and tools.
sentences.cn: 在项目开始之前，我们需要为团队配备必要的培训和工具。

trans.tran: 设备、装备，通常指用于特定目的的工具或机器。

sentences.en: The company invested heavily in new equipment to improve production efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司大量投资新设备以提高生产效率。

sentences.en: Please ensure all safety equipment is readily available for the maintenance team.
sentences.cn: 请确保维护团队可以随时使用所有安全设备。

trans.tran: 配备；装备；提供必要的设备或资源

sentences.en: The new office is equipped with state-of-the-art technology to enhance productivity.
sentences.cn: 新办公室配备了最先进的技术，以提高生产力。

sentences.en: All employees are equipped with laptops and mobile phones to facilitate remote work.
sentences.cn: 所有员工都配备了笔记本电脑和手机，以方便远程工作。

trans.tran: 股权；公平；价值（指资产价值减去负债后的剩余部分）

sentences.en: The company's equity increased significantly after the successful IPO.
sentences.cn: 该公司在成功上市后，股权显著增加。

sentences.en: Investors are carefully evaluating the company's equity to determine its potential for growth.
sentences.cn: 投资者正在仔细评估该公司的股权，以确定其增长潜力。

trans.tran: 等同；等价；相等；对等

sentences.en: The two reports showed a clear equivalence in their main findings.
sentences.cn: 这两份报告在主要发现上显示出明显的等同性。

sentences.en: There is no direct equivalence between the two legal systems regarding certain procedures.
sentences.cn: 这两种法律制度在某些进程上没有直接的对等性。

trans.tran: 等值的；相当的；与...相同

sentences.en: The two software programs offer equivalent functionality.
sentences.cn: 这两个软件程序提供等效的功能。

sentences.en: The contract states that the payment will be equivalent to 10% of the total sales.
sentences.cn: 合约规定付款金额将相当于总销售额的 10%。

trans.tran: 时代；时期（通常指具有特定特征的历史阶段）

sentences.en: The company is adapting its strategies to the digital era.
sentences.cn: 公司正在调整其策略以适应数字时代。

sentences.en: This new technology marks the beginning of a new era for the industry.
sentences.cn: 这项新技术标志着该行业新时代的开始。

trans.tran: 彻底根除；完全消除（问题、疾病等）

sentences.en: The company aims to eradicate inefficiencies in its supply chain through automation.
sentences.cn: 公司计划透过自动化来彻底根除供应链中的低效率。

sentences.en: The organization is working to eradicate corruption within the government.
sentences.cn: 该组织正在努力根除政府中的贪腐。

trans.tran: 清除；擦除（信息、错误等）

sentences.en: Please erase any unnecessary information from the document before submitting it.
sentences.cn: 提交文档前，请将其中不必要的信息擦除。

sentences.en: The software allows users to easily erase mistakes made during data entry.
sentences.cn: 该软件让用户可以轻松地擦除数据输入时的错误。

trans.tran: 竖立；创建；（建筑、结构等）建造

sentences.en: The construction company plans to erect a new office building on the vacant lot.
sentences.cn: 该建筑公司计划在空置的土地上建造一栋新办公楼。

sentences.en: The manager requested that the team erect a clear and concise project timeline.
sentences.cn: 经理要求团队创建一个清晰简洁的项目时间表。

trans.tran: 符合人体工学的，以符合人体工学设计的

sentences.en: The office chairs are designed ergonomically to reduce back strain.
sentences.cn: 办公椅的设计符合人体工学，以减少背部压力。

sentences.en: The company invested in ergonomically designed workstations to improve employee productivity.
sentences.cn: 公司投资于符合人体工学的办公工作站，以提高员工生产力。

trans.tran: 人体工学：研究工作环境与工具设计，以提高效率、舒适度和安全性，减少身体压力与疲劳的学科。

sentences.en: The company invested in ergonomic chairs to improve employee comfort and productivity.
sentences.cn: 公司投资符合人体工学的椅子，以提高员工的舒适度和生产力。

sentences.en: Proper ergonomics in the office can help prevent repetitive strain injuries.
sentences.cn: 适当的办公室人体工学设计有助于预防重复性劳损。

trans.tran: 侵蚀；腐蚀；逐渐损害

sentences.en: The constant waves eroded the coastline over many years.
sentences.cn: 海浪经年累月不断侵蚀着海岸线。

sentences.en: High inflation can erode the purchasing power of consumers.
sentences.cn: 高通膨会侵蚀消费者的购买力。

trans.tran: 出错；犯错；偏离正确轨道

sentences.en: The report contained several errors due to a data entry mistake.
sentences.cn: 由于数据输入错误，报告中包含几个错误。

sentences.en: We need to carefully review the contract to err on the side of caution.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细审阅合约，以确保万无一失。

trans.tran: 运行短暂的任务或差事，通常是为了完成个人或公司事务。

sentences.en: I need to run a few errands this afternoon, such as picking up supplies from the stationery store.
sentences.cn: 我今天下午需要跑几个差事，例如从文具店采购物资。

sentences.en: The assistant is responsible for handling various errands, including mailing documents and delivering packages.
sentences.cn: 助理负责处理各种差事，包括邮寄文档和递送包裹。

trans.tran: 错误；差错；疏失

sentences.en: The report contained several errors that needed to be corrected before submission.
sentences.cn: 报告包含几个需要在提交前更正的错误。

sentences.en: The system encountered an error during the data processing, so we need to restart it.
sentences.cn: 数据处理过程中系统发生错误，因此我们需要重新启动它。

trans.tran: 错误；失误；疏失

sentences.en: The report contained several errors that needed to be corrected before submission.
sentences.cn: 报告包含几个需要提交前修正的错误。

sentences.en: We strive to minimize errors in our data entry process to ensure accuracy.
sentences.cn: 我们努力将数据输入过程中的错误降至最低，以确保准确性。

trans.tran: 手扶梯；电扶梯

sentences.en: Please use the escalator to go to the second floor.
sentences.cn: 请搭乘手扶梯前往二楼。

sentences.en: The escalator was out of order, so we had to use the stairs.
sentences.cn: 手扶梯故障了，所以我们不得不走楼梯。

trans.tran: 逃离；脱离（困境、责任等）

sentences.en: The company is trying to escape its financial difficulties by restructuring its operations.
sentences.cn: 该公司正透过重组营运来摆脱财务困境。

sentences.en: Employees must escape the office before the fire alarm sounds.
sentences.cn: 员工必须在火灾警报声响前离开办公室。

trans.tran: 护送；陪同；（尤指为保护或提供服务而）陪同人员

sentences.en: The hotel provides an escort service to the airport for VIP guests.
sentences.cn: 饭店为 VIP 客人提供机场护送服务。

sentences.en: Security personnel escorted the CEO to the conference room.
sentences.cn: 安全人员护送首席执行官到会议室。

trans.tran: 尤其；特别是（强调某事物的重要性或突出性）

sentences.en: The project deadline is approaching, especially for the marketing team.
sentences.cn: 项目截止日期即将到来，尤其对行销团队来说。

sentences.en: We appreciate your prompt response, especially given the complexity of the issue.
sentences.cn: 我们感谢您迅速的回应，尤其考虑到问题的复杂性。

trans.tran: 文章; 短文; 散文; 论说文

sentences.en: She submitted an essay on the impact of technology on society.
sentences.cn: 她提交了一篇关于科技对社会影响的短文。

sentences.en: The professor assigned a 1000-word essay due next week.
sentences.cn: 教授指派了一篇下周截止的1000字论说文。

trans.tran: 本质；精髓；要素；精华

sentences.en: The essence of good leadership is clear communication and empathy.
sentences.cn: 良好领导力的本质是清晰的沟通和同理心。

sentences.en: This extract captures the very essence of the rose.
sentences.cn: 这种萃取物捕捉了玫瑰的精华。

trans.tran: 必不可少的；极重要的，对于某事物至关重要

sentences.en: Having a reliable internet connection is essential for remote workers.
sentences.cn: 对于远程工作者来说，拥有可靠的网络连接至关重要。

sentences.en: Accurate data is essential for making informed business decisions.
sentences.cn: 准确的数据对于做出明智的商业决策至关重要。

trans.tran: 基本上；本质上；实质上

sentences.en: Essentially, the project's success hinges on securing the necessary funding.
sentences.cn: 基本上，这个项目的成功取决于获得必要的资金。

sentences.en: The report essentially outlines the company's new marketing strategy.
sentences.cn: 这份报告基本上概述了公司的新的行销策略。

trans.tran: 创建；设立；创建（组织、关系、系统等）

sentences.en: The company plans to establish a new branch in Southeast Asia to expand its market share.
sentences.cn: 为了扩大市场份额，公司计划在东南亚创建新的分公司。

sentences.en: We need to establish clear communication channels between departments to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 为了提高效率，我们需要创建部门之间清晰的沟通管道。

trans.tran: 确立；创建；（公司、机构等）成立

sentences.en: The company was established in 1998 and has since become a leader in the industry.
sentences.cn: 这家公司于 1998 年成立，此后已成为该行业的领先者。

sentences.en: We need to establish clear communication channels to avoid misunderstandings.
sentences.cn: 我们需要创建清晰的沟通管道以避免误解。

trans.tran: 机构、公司、设立、创建

sentences.en: The new retail establishment aims to attract young consumers with its modern design.
sentences.cn: 这家新的零售机构旨在通过其现代化的设计来吸引年轻消费者。

sentences.en: The company's establishment in the Asian market was a significant step in its global expansion.
sentences.cn: 公司在亚洲市场的设立是其全球扩张的重要一步。

trans.tran: 资产、房地产、遗产（尤指房地产及相关财产）

sentences.en: The company is looking to expand its real estate portfolio.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻求扩展其房地产投资组合。

sentences.en: The lawyer is handling the estate of the deceased client.
sentences.cn: 律师正在处理已故客户的遗产。

trans.tran: 尊重；重视；自尊

sentences.en: The company values the esteem of its employees and fosters a supportive work environment.
sentences.cn: 公司重视员工的尊重，并营造支持性的工作环境。

sentences.en: Maintaining a high level of customer esteem is crucial for long-term business success.
sentences.cn: 维持顾客的高度尊重对于长期商业成功至关重要。

trans.tran: 估计、评估（成本、时间、数量等）；预估

sentences.en: The project manager needs to estimate the cost of the new marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 项目经理需要估算新行销活动的成本。

sentences.en: Based on current sales figures, we estimate a 10% increase in profits this quarter.
sentences.cn: 根据目前的销售数据，我们预估本季利润将增加 10%。

trans.tran: 估计的；预估的；根据估算得出的

sentences.en: The project's budget is estimated at $50,000.
sentences.cn: 该项目的预算预估为 5 万美元。

sentences.en: Based on the estimated sales figures, we anticipate a profit increase this quarter.
sentences.cn: 根据预估的销售数字，我们预计本季将会有利润增加。

trans.tran: 估计值；预估数量或金额

sentences.en: The company's sales estimates for next quarter are slightly lower than expected.
sentences.cn: 公司下季的销售预估值略低于预期。

sentences.en: We need to review the project estimates to ensure we stay within budget.
sentences.cn: 我们需要审查项目预估值，以确保在预算范围内。

trans.tran: 估计；预算；评价

sentences.en: The initial estimation for the project cost was much lower than the actual expenditure.
sentences.cn: 该项目的初步成本估计远低于实际支出。

sentences.en: We need to get an accurate estimation of the time required to complete this task.
sentences.cn: 我们需要准确估计完成这项任务所需的时间。

trans.tran: 等等；及其他（指类似的项目）

sentences.en: The meeting agenda included topics such as sales reports, marketing strategies, etc.
sentences.cn: 会议议程包括销售报告、行销策略等相关议题。

sentences.en: We need to purchase office supplies like pens, paper, etc., before the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在本周结束前购买文具用品，例如笔、纸等等。

trans.tran: 无限的时间；永恒，通常指超出人类经验的漫长时期。

sentences.en: The company is committed to providing long-term value to its shareholders, ensuring their investment lasts an eternity.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于为股东提供长期的价值，确保他们的投资能够延续一辈子。

sentences.en: While technological advancements are rapid, the need for reliable customer service remains an eternal concern for businesses.
sentences.cn: 尽管科技进步迅速，但可靠的客户服务仍然是企业永恒的关注点。

trans.tran: 乙醇；酒精

sentences.en: Ethanol is commonly used as a solvent and as a fuel additive.
sentences.cn: 乙醇常用作溶剂和燃料添加剂。

sentences.en: Many hand sanitizers contain a high percentage of ethanol to kill germs.
sentences.cn: 许多洗手液含有高比例的乙醇以杀死细菌。

trans.tran: 道德准则；伦理规范，尤指在商业或专业领域的行为标准。

sentences.en: Our company adheres to strict ethical guidelines to ensure fair business practices.
sentences.cn: 我们公司遵守严格的道德准则，以确保公平的商业行为。

sentences.en: The training program emphasizes the importance of professional ethics in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 这项培训计划强调了职场专业伦理的重要性。

trans.tran: 符合道德规范的；道德上的

sentences.en: Our company is committed to ethical business practices and fair treatment of all employees.
sentences.cn: 我们公司致力于符合道德规范的商业行为，并对所有员工提供公平待遇。

sentences.en: The investigation revealed several unethical actions by the former manager, leading to his termination.
sentences.cn: 调查揭露了前经理的一些不道德行为，导致他被解雇。

sentences.en: The new marketing campaign is expected to be very exciting for our target audience.

sentences.en: The company is launching an exciting new product line to boost sales.

sentences.cn: 高层主管们正在开会讨论季度销售报告。

sentences.cn: 公司的经营团队批准了新的行销策略。

sentences.en: The employee's exemplary performance earned him a promotion.
sentences.cn: 这位员工的卓越表现让他升迁。

sentences.en: The company strives to provide exemplary customer service to maintain its reputation.
sentences.cn: 公司努力提供卓越的客户服务以维持其声誉。

sentences.cn: 这个项目体现了公司对创新和品质的承诺。

sentences.cn: 这位员工对团队的奉献精神彰显了我们所追求的价值观。

sentences.cn: 为公司服务超过 10 年的员工可免除强制性培训。

sentences.cn: 该公司获得了新税收法规的豁免。

sentences.cn: 经理要求团队在处理敏感数据时要谨慎行事。

sentences.cn: 员工受到鼓励行使他们对公司政策提出建议的权利。

sentences.cn: 公司提供各种培训练习，以提升员工绩效。

sentences.cn: 预计新的行销活动将为公司及其客户带来令人振奋的体验。

sentences.cn: 本季公司预期的利润显著高于去年。

trans.tran: 预期、期望（某事将会发生或出现）

sentences.en: We are expecting a significant increase in sales this quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们预计本季的销售额将会大幅增加。

sentences.en: The project manager is expecting the team to complete the report by Friday.
sentences.cn: 项目经理期望团队能在周五前完成报告。

trans.tran: 加速处理；加快进程

sentences.en: To meet the tight deadline, we need to expedite the shipping process.
sentences.cn: 为了赶上紧迫的截止日期，我们需要加速运输流程。

sentences.en: The manager decided to expedite the approval of the purchase order to avoid delays.
sentences.cn: 经理决定加速采购订单的批准，以避免延迟。

trans.tran: 开除；驱逐（某人或某物）；将…逐出

sentences.en: The company expelled the employee for violating its code of conduct.
sentences.cn: 由于违反公司行为准则，该员工被公司开除。

sentences.en: The school expelled the student for repeated instances of disruptive behavior.
sentences.cn: 由于多次出现扰乱行为，学校将该学生开除。

trans.tran: 支出；开销（尤指金钱或资源的消耗）

sentences.en: The company needs to reduce its annual expenditure on marketing to improve profitability.
sentences.cn: 为了提高利润，公司需要减少年度行销支出。

sentences.en: The project's expenditure exceeded the initial budget by 15%.
sentences.cn: 项目的支出超出最初预算 15%。

trans.tran: 支出；费用（尤指因业务活动而产生的费用）

sentences.en: Please submit your expense report by the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 请在月底前提交您的费用报销单。

sentences.en: The company reimbursed the employee for travel expenses.
sentences.cn: 公司已向员工报销了差旅费用。

trans.tran: 支出；费用（尤指业务或旅行相关的费用）

sentences.en: The company reimbursed the employee for his travel expenses.
sentences.cn: 公司已支付员工的差旅费用。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense report by the end of the month to receive reimbursement.
sentences.cn: 请在月底前提交费用报表以获得报销。

trans.tran: 昂贵的；价格高的，超出预算

sentences.en: The imported machinery is quite expensive, so we need to carefully consider the budget.
sentences.cn: 这批进口机器相当昂贵，我们需要仔细考虑预算。

sentences.en: We're looking for a cost-effective solution, as the current supplier's prices are too expensive.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找具成本效益的解决方案，因为目前供应商的价格太贵了。

trans.tran: 经验；经历；技能

sentences.en: The candidate's extensive experience in project management makes him a strong contender.
sentences.cn: 这位候选人在项目管理的丰富经验使他成为强劲的竞争者。

sentences.en: We need to experience the new software firsthand before making a purchase decision.
sentences.cn: 在做出购买决定之前，我们需要亲身体验这款新软件。

trans.tran: 富经验的；在某领域拥有丰富经验的

sentences.en: We are looking for an experienced project manager to lead this new initiative.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找一位经验丰富的项目经理来领导这个新的计划。

sentences.en: The company values experienced employees who can mentor junior staff.
sentences.cn: 公司重视经验丰富的员工，他们可以指导初级员工。

trans.tran: 经历；经验；过往经历

sentences.en: The candidate's extensive experiences in project management made him a strong contender for the position.
sentences.cn: 这位候选人在项目管理的丰富经验使他成为该职位的有力竞争者。

sentences.en: Based on our collective experiences, we recommend implementing a new training program.
sentences.cn: 根据我们共同的经验，我们建议实施新的培训计划。

trans.tran: 正在经历；体验到

sentences.en: The company is currently experiencing a period of rapid growth.
sentences.cn: 目前公司正经历一段快速成长的时期。

sentences.en: We are experiencing technical difficulties with our online payment system.
sentences.cn: 我们的在线支付系统目前正遇到技术问题。

trans.tran: 实验；测试（以验证假设或评估效果）

sentences.en: The marketing team is conducting an experiment with a new advertising campaign to gauge customer response.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在进行一项新的广告活动实验，以评估客户的回应。

sentences.en: Before launching the product, we need to experiment with different pricing strategies to find the optimal one.
sentences.cn: 在产品上市之前，我们需要尝试不同的定价策略，以找到最佳方案。

trans.tran: 实验性的；试验性的；基于实验的

sentences.en: The company is conducting an experimental marketing campaign to test new strategies.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在进行一项实验性的行销活动，以测试新的策略。

sentences.en: The IT department is using an experimental software to improve system performance.
sentences.cn: IT部门正在使用实验性软件来提升系统性能。

trans.tran: 专家；精通某领域的人

sentences.en: Our company hired an expert in international trade to advise on the new contract.
sentences.cn: 我们公司聘请了一位国际贸易专家，为新的合约提供建议。

sentences.en: The project manager consulted with the technical expert to resolve the software issue.
sentences.cn: 项目经理咨询技术专家以解决软件问题。

trans.tran: 专业知识与技能；精湛的技术

sentences.en: The company values employees with expertise in data analysis and project management.
sentences.cn: 公司重视在数据分析和项目管理方面具有专业知识的员工。

sentences.en: To secure the contract, we need to highlight our firm's expertise in international trade law.
sentences.cn: 为了获得合约，我们需要强调我们律师事务所在国际贸易法方面的专业知识。

trans.tran: 专家；专业人士

sentences.en: Our team consulted with industry experts to ensure the project's feasibility.
sentences.cn: 我们团队咨询了业界专家，以确保项目的可行性。

sentences.en: The company hired several experts in data analytics to improve its marketing strategies.
sentences.cn: 公司聘请了几位数据分析方面的专家，以改善其营销策略。

trans.tran: 到期日；有效期

sentences.en: Please check the expiration date on the product before using it.
sentences.cn: 使用产品前，请检查产品的到期日。

sentences.en: The contract's expiration is scheduled for December 31st.
sentences.cn: 合约的到期日定于 12 月 31 日。

trans.tran: 到期；失效

sentences.en: The contract will expire on December 31st, so we need to renew it before then.
sentences.cn: 合约将于 12 月 31 日到期，因此我们需要在届时前续签。

sentences.en: Please check the expiration date on the product before using it.
sentences.cn: 使用产品前，请检查其有效期限。

trans.tran: 解释；阐明；说明理由

sentences.en: Could you explain the reason for the project's delay to the stakeholders?
sentences.cn: 您能向利害关系人解释项目延迟的原因吗？

sentences.en: The consultant will explain the new policy to all employees during the training session.
sentences.cn: 顾问将在培训课程中向所有员工解释新的政策。

trans.tran: 解释；阐述；说明

sentences.en: The consultant explains the new policy to the team members.
sentences.cn: 顾问向团队成员解释了新的政策。

sentences.en: The report explains the reasons for the company's declining profits.
sentences.cn: 这份报告解释了公司利润下降的原因。

trans.tran: 解释；说明（尤指对某事物的理由或过程）

sentences.en: Could you provide an explanation for the delay in the project?
sentences.cn: 您能解释一下项目延迟的原因吗？

sentences.en: The manager offered a clear explanation of the new policy to the employees.
sentences.cn: 经理向员工清楚地说明了新的政策。

trans.tran: 解释性的，说明性的

sentences.en: The report included an explanatory note on the financial figures.
sentences.cn: 报告中包含了关于财务数据的解释性说明。

sentences.en: She provided an explanatory diagram to help us understand the complex process.
sentences.cn: 她提供了一张解释性图表来帮助我们理解复杂的过程。

trans.tran: 清楚明确的；明白的；详尽的；不含糊的

sentences.en: The instructions were explicit, leaving no room for misunderstanding.
sentences.cn: 这些指示非常明确，没有留下任何误解的空间。

sentences.en: She made an explicit request for a refund.
sentences.cn: 她明确地提出了退款要求。

trans.tran: 明确地；清楚地；毫不隐瞒地

sentences.en: The company's policy explicitly states that employees cannot accept gifts from clients.
sentences.cn: 公司的政策明确规定员工不能接受客户赠送的礼物。

sentences.en: She explicitly asked me to double-check the figures before submitting the report.
sentences.cn: 她明确要求我在提交报告前仔细核对这些数字。

trans.tran: 突然爆发；（压力、情绪等）失控

sentences.en: The company's profits exploded after the successful product launch.
sentences.cn: 在产品成功上市后，该公司的利润大幅增长。

sentences.en: The project manager warned that the team's workload could explode if they didn't prioritize tasks.
sentences.cn: 项目经理警告说，如果他们没有优先处理任务，团队的工作量可能会失控。

trans.tran: 突然爆发；（比喻）突然发生（问题、危机等）

sentences.en: The company's profits exploded after the successful product launch.
sentences.cn: 产品成功上市后，该公司的利润大幅爆发。

sentences.en: The project faced an unexpected crisis, and the budget exploded beyond initial estimates.
sentences.cn: 项目面临意想不到的危机，导致预算超出最初的估算。

trans.tran: 利用（漏洞、资源等）以获取利益；开发（潜力、优势等）

sentences.en: The company is looking for ways to exploit the growing demand for eco-friendly products.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找利用对环保产品日益增长的需求的方法。

sentences.en: The software developer exploited a security loophole to gain unauthorized access.
sentences.cn: 软件开发人员利用安全漏洞获得未经授权的访问。

trans.tran: 探索；勘探；调查研究（通常指系统性的、目的性的探索活动）

sentences.en: The company is conducting an exploration of potential new markets in Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在对东南亚的潜在市场进行勘探。

sentences.en: Our team's exploration of the new technology revealed significant cost savings.
sentences.cn: 我们团队对新技术的探索揭示了显著的成本节约。

trans.tran: 探索；研究（某事物，通常是为了发现新信息或解决问题）

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to explore new channels to reach a wider audience.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要探索新的管道来接触更广泛的受众。

sentences.en: We will explore the possibility of expanding our operations into the Asian market.
sentences.cn: 我们将探索将我们的业务扩展到亚洲市场的可能性。

trans.tran: 探险家；探索者（指探索未知领域或进行研究的人）

sentences.en: Our company is looking for explorers to identify new markets in Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在寻找探险家，以寻找东南亚的新市场。

sentences.en: The research team acted as explorers, venturing into uncharted data to uncover valuable insights.
sentences.cn: 研究团队扮演着探险家的角色，深入未知的数据，以发现有价值的见解。

trans.tran: 探索；研究（某事物以寻找信息或机会）

sentences.en: The company is currently exploring new markets in Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 该公司目前正在探索东南亚的新市场。

sentences.en: We're exploring options for streamlining our supply chain to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 我们正在探索优化供应链的方案，以降低成本。

trans.tran: 爆炸；爆发；激增

sentences.en: There has been an explosion in the number of mobile phone users.
sentences.cn: 移动电话用户的数量出现了爆炸性增长。

sentences.en: The company reported an explosion in sales after launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 该公司在推出新产品后，销售额呈现了爆炸性增长。

trans.tran: 爆炸性的；易爆炸的；（情绪等）爆发的；炸药；爆炸物

sentences.en: The startup experienced explosive growth in its first year, doubling its customer base.
sentences.cn: 这家新创公司在第一年经历了爆炸性增长，客户群翻了一倍。

sentences.en: Security forces discovered an explosive device hidden in a package.
sentences.cn: 安全部队在一个包裹中发现了一个爆炸设备。

trans.tran: 博览会；展览会

sentences.en: Our company will participate in the international expo to showcase our latest products.
sentences.cn: 我们公司将参加国际博览会，展示我们最新的产品。

sentences.en: The expo attracted over 10,000 visitors and generated significant leads for the sales team.
sentences.cn: 这次博览会吸引了超过 10,000 名参观者，并为销售团队产生了大量潜在客户。

trans.tran: 指数级的；急速增长的

sentences.en: The company has experienced exponential growth in its user base over the past year.
sentences.cn: 过去一年，该公司的用户基础呈现指数级的增长。

sentences.en: Technological advancements are leading to an exponential increase in data.
sentences.cn: 科技进步正导致数据呈指数级的增长。

trans.tran: 将商品或服务销售到国外；出口

sentences.en: Our company plans to export its new line of electronics to several Asian countries.
sentences.cn: 我们公司计划将其新款电子产品出口到几个亚洲国家。

sentences.en: The government is offering incentives to encourage businesses to export more goods.
sentences.cn: 政府正在提供诱因，鼓励企业出口更多商品。

trans.tran: 出口商；将商品出口到其他国家或地区的公司或个人。

sentences.en: Our company is a leading exporter of agricultural products to Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 我们公司是向东南亚出口农产品的主要出口商。

sentences.en: The importer negotiated favorable terms with the exporter to secure a long-term supply contract.
sentences.cn: 进口商与出口商协定了优惠条款，以确保长期供应合同。

trans.tran: 将商品或服务销售到国外；出口

sentences.en: Our company is expanding its operations by exporting electronics to Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正透过将电子产品出口到东南亚来扩展业务。

sentences.en: The government is offering incentives to encourage businesses to start exporting their products.
sentences.cn: 政府正在提供奖励，以鼓励企业开始出口其产品。

trans.tran: 揭露；暴露；使公开

sentences.en: The company decided to expose the fraudulent activities to protect its reputation.
sentences.cn: 为了保护公司声誉，公司决定公开揭露这些欺诈行为。

sentences.en: The report exposes the vulnerabilities in the company's cybersecurity system.
sentences.cn: 这份报告揭露了公司网络安全系统的漏洞。

trans.tran: 暴露于…之下；使…暴露；揭露；呈现

sentences.en: The company's financial data was exposed due to a security breach.
sentences.cn: 由于安全漏洞，该公司的财务数据遭到泄露。

sentences.en: The new marketing campaign aims to expose the product's unique features to a wider audience.
sentences.cn: 新的营销活动旨在向更广泛的受众展示产品的独特功能。

trans.tran: 展览；陈列；详细说明（通常指公开展示或解释）

sentences.en: The company will hold an exposition showcasing its latest technological innovations.
sentences.cn: 公司将举办一场展览，展示其最新的科技创新。

sentences.en: The sales team prepared a detailed exposition of the product's features to potential clients.
sentences.cn: 销售团队为潜在客户准备了产品功能的详细说明。

trans.tran: 暴露；接触；（媒体）报导

sentences.en: The company's extensive media exposure significantly boosted brand recognition.
sentences.cn: 公司广泛的媒体报导显著提升了品牌知名度。

sentences.en: Employees should limit their exposure to potentially harmful chemicals in the lab.
sentences.cn: 员工应限制在实验室中接触潜在有害化学物质。

trans.tran: 表达；传达（想法、情感、意见等）

sentences.en: The company needs to express its gratitude to its loyal customers.
sentences.cn: 公司需要向其忠实客户表达感谢之意。

sentences.en: He found it difficult to express his feelings in a formal business setting.
sentences.cn: 他发现要在正式的商务场合表达自己的感受很困难。

trans.tran: 表达；阐述（想法、意见等）

sentences.en: The manager clearly expressed his concerns about the project's timeline.
sentences.cn: 经理清楚地表达了他对项目进度的担忧。

sentences.en: The report expressed a need for increased investment in research and development.
sentences.cn: 该报告表达了对研发领域增加投资的需求。

trans.tran: 表达；表示；表现；表情；措辞；说法

sentences.en: Her facial expression clearly showed her surprise.
sentences.cn: 她的脸部表情清楚地显示了她的惊讶。

sentences.en: We need a clear expression of your goals for the project.
sentences.cn: 我们需要明确表达您对该项目的目标。

trans.tran: 富于表现力的；善于用语言或肢体表达情感的

sentences.en: The presenter's expressive delivery captivated the audience during the product launch.
sentences.cn: 产品发表会上，这位演讲者的富有表现力的演讲深深吸引了听众。

sentences.en: In negotiations, it's important to be expressive and clearly communicate your company's position.
sentences.cn: 在谈判中，重要的是要富有表现力，并清楚地传达贵公司的立场。

trans.tran: 明确地；特意地；特别地（表示某事是为了特定目的而做的）

sentences.en: The contract states that all changes must be approved expressly by the CEO.
sentences.cn: 合约规定所有变更必须经由 CEO 特意批准。

sentences.en: The company expressly forbids employees from disclosing confidential information.
sentences.cn: 公司明确禁止员工泄露机密信息。

trans.tran: 极致的；精致的；卓越的（通常指品质、设计或细节），带有高品质和精美的含义。

sentences.en: The hotel boasts exquisite décor and impeccable service, attracting high-end clientele.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店以其精致的装潢和完美无瑕的服务而闻名，吸引了高端客户。

sentences.en: The marketing campaign highlighted the exquisite craftsmanship of the luxury watch, emphasizing its value.
sentences.cn: 营销活动突出了这款奢华手表的精湛工艺，强调了它的价值。

trans.tran: 延长；扩展；伸出

sentences.en: The company is extending its business operations into new markets.
sentences.cn: 公司正在将其业务扩展到新的市场。

sentences.en: Could you extend the deadline for the project proposal by a week?
sentences.cn: 您能将项目提案的截止日期延迟一周吗？

trans.tran: 延长的；扩展的；延伸的

sentences.en: The project deadline has been extended due to unforeseen circumstances.
sentences.cn: 由于突发状况，项目截止日期已延迟。

sentences.en: We offer an extended warranty on all our products to ensure customer satisfaction.
sentences.cn: 我们为所有产品提供延长保固，以确保客户满意。

trans.tran: 延伸；扩展；扩大

sentences.en: The company plans to extend its operations into new markets next year.
sentences.cn: 公司计划明年将业务扩展到新的市场。

sentences.en: The deadline for the project can be extended by a week if necessary.
sentences.cn: 如果需要，项目期限可以延迟一周。

trans.tran: 延伸、扩展；（电话）分机

sentences.en: Could you please provide the extension number for Mr. Smith?
sentences.cn: 请问史密斯先生的分机号码是多少？

sentences.en: The company is planning to extend its operations into new markets.
sentences.cn: 公司计划将业务扩展到新的市场。

trans.tran: 广泛的；大量的；覆盖面广

sentences.en: The company conducted an extensive market research to identify potential customers.
sentences.cn: 公司进行了广泛的市场调查，以识别潜在客户。

sentences.en: The report provides an extensive overview of the project's progress and challenges.
sentences.cn: 这份报告提供了关于项目进展和挑战的广泛概述。

trans.tran: 广泛地；彻底地；详尽地（指范围广、程度深，通常用于描述研究、调查、使用等），尤其指在广泛的范围内进行。

sentences.en: The company conducted an extensive market research before launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 该公司在推出新产品之前进行了广泛的市场调查。

sentences.en: The report extensively details the company's financial performance over the past year.
sentences.cn: 这份报告详细说明了公司过去一年的财务表现。

trans.tran: 程度；范围

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative extent procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的extent进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the extent implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了extent影响。

trans.tran: 外观；外部结构；（建筑）外墙

sentences.en: The building's exterior was damaged during the recent storm.
sentences.cn: 最近的风暴对建筑物的外观造成损坏。

sentences.en: The hotel is undergoing renovations to improve its exterior appeal.

sentences.en: The company is seeking external funding to expand its operations.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻求外部资金以扩大其营运。

sentences.cn: 在做出决策时，我们需要考量内部和外部因素。

sentences.cn: 工厂造成的污染是一种影响当地社区的负面外部性。

sentences.cn: 为了降低成本，公司将其 IT 支持外包给外部公司。

sentences.cn: 这份报告详细说明了经过外部审计的财务报表。

sentences.cn: 由于该产品线在市场上越来越不被接受，公司已停止生产。

sentences.cn: 由于竞争加剧，该公司的利润正在下降。

sentences.cn: 下午，股市呈现下跌趋势。

trans.tran: 虚假的；不真实的；错误的

sentences.cn: 该报告包含几个需要立即更正的虚假陈述。

sentences.cn: 证人提供了关于该事件的虚假描述，这使得调查更加复杂。

sentences.en: The company's new marketing campaign aims to increase brand fame among younger consumers.
sentences.cn: 该公司的新行销活动旨在提高品牌在年轻消费者中的知名度。

sentences.en: Achieving international fame requires consistent effort and a unique selling proposition.
sentences.cn: 获得国际名声需要持续的努力和独特的销售主张。

sentences.en: The hotel is a famed landmark, attracting tourists from around the world.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店是一处享有盛誉的地标，吸引着来自世界各地的游客。

sentences.en: The company's famed customer service has been a key factor in its success.
sentences.cn: 该公司的卓越客户服务是其成功的重要因素之一。

trans.tran: 熟悉的；了解的；习以为常的

sentences.cn: 这位新员工应该熟悉公司的政策和流程。

sentences.en: I'm not familiar with this software; could you provide some training?
sentences.cn: 我不熟悉这个软件，您能提供一些培训吗？

sentences.cn: 团队对该软件的熟悉程度使他们能够迅速导入新系统。

sentences.en: A certain level of familiarity with international trade regulations is essential for this position.
sentences.cn: 此职位需要对国际贸易法规有一定的熟悉程度。

sentences.en: Before starting the project, it's crucial to familiarize yourself with the company's policies.
sentences.cn: 在开始项目之前，务必熟悉公司的政策。

sentences.en: The training program aims to familiarize new employees with our software systems.
sentences.cn: 这项培训计划旨在让新进员工熟悉我们的软件系统。

trans.tran: 家庭；亲属

sentences.en: The company offers generous parental leave benefits to support employees and their families.
sentences.cn: 公司提供慷慨的育婴假福利，以支持员工及其家庭。

sentences.en: We value work-life balance and encourage employees to spend quality time with their families.
sentences.cn: 我们重视工作与生活的平衡，并鼓励员工与家人共度美好时光。

trans.tran: 家庭；家人；亲属；族；家族

sentences.en: She comes from a large family with five siblings.
sentences.cn: 她来自一个有五个兄弟姊妹的大家庭。

sentences.en: The company treats its employees like family.
sentences.cn: 这家公司把员工视如家人。

trans.tran: 由家族经营的；家族企业

sentences.en: This restaurant is a family-run business that has been serving the community for over 50 years.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅是一家家族企业，为社区服务已超过 50 年。

sentences.en: Many small hotels are family-run, offering a more personalized guest experience.
sentences.cn: 许多小型旅馆由家族经营，提供更个人化的客户体验。

trans.tran: 广为人知的；著名的；举世闻名的

sentences.en: The company aims to become a famous brand in the global market.
sentences.cn: 该公司旨在成为全球市场上一个广为人知的品牌。

sentences.en: The speaker is a famous economist, known for his insightful analysis of the economy.
sentences.cn: 这位演讲者是一位著名的经济学家，以其对经济的深刻分析而闻名。

trans.tran: （电风扇）风扇；（比喻）狂热的支持者或追随者

sentences.cn: 办公室空气闷热，所以我打开风扇以促进空气流通。

sentences.en: The company's new product is a huge fan favorite among young consumers.
sentences.cn: 这家公司的新产品在年轻消费者中非常受欢迎。

sentences.cn: 这家饭店提供一家装潢精致的餐厅，可以俯瞰整个城市。

sentences.en: We need to find a fancy catering service for the company's anniversary gala.
sentences.cn: 我们需要为公司周年庆典找到一家提供精致餐饮服务的餐饮公司。

trans.tran: 狂热的支持者；粉丝（通常指对运动、娱乐或品牌等有强烈喜爱的人）

sentences.cn: 该公司正在推出新产品，以利用其忠实粉丝的热情。

sentences.en: The marketing team is analyzing fan engagement metrics to improve campaign effectiveness.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在分析粉丝参与度指针，以提高活动的有效性。

trans.tran: 极好的；令人印象深刻的；卓越的

sentences.en: The presentation was fantastic; the client was very impressed.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿非常出色，客户印象深刻。

sentences.en: We received fantastic feedback on the new product launch.
sentences.cn: 我们在新产品上市的评估中获得了极佳的回馈。

trans.tran: 想像、空想；（尤指）奇幻故事或情境

sentences.cn: 营销活动融入了奇幻元素，以吸引年轻族群。

sentences.cn: 虽然产品概念具有创新性，但它有些太过空想，缺乏实际应用。

sentences.cn: 新工厂位于离市中心很远的地方，这有助于降低租金成本。

sentences.en: How far along are we with the preparations for the conference?
sentences.cn: 我们为这次会议做的准备进度到哪里了？

trans.tran: （交通）车资、票价；（比喻）代价、报酬

sentences.cn: 到机场的出租车车资大约是 30 美元。

sentences.en: The company will reimburse employees for reasonable travel fares.
sentences.cn: 公司将会退还员工合理的交通车资。

trans.tran: 告别；告辞；再会

sentences.en: She bade farewell to her colleagues before leaving the company.
sentences.cn: 在离开公司前，她向同事们告别。

sentences.en: Farewell, my friends! I'll miss you all.
sentences.cn: 再会了，我的朋友们！我会想念你们的。

trans.tran: 农场；农家；耕作；饲养

sentences.cn: 我叔叔拥有一座大型酪农场，他在那里饲养乳牛。

sentences.en: The local community decided to farm organic vegetables to sell at the market.
sentences.cn: 当地社区决定种植有机蔬菜并在市场上贩售。

trans.tran: 农夫；农民

sentences.cn: 这位农夫今天一大早就收割了他的庄稼。

sentences.en: Many farmers are concerned about climate change's impact on their yields.
sentences.cn: 许多农民担心气候变迁对他们的收成造成的影响。

sentences.cn: 该公司正在投资可持续的农业耕作方式，以减少其对环境的影响。

sentences.cn: 我们的供应链在新鲜农产品方面严重依赖当地农业社区。

sentences.cn: 公司正在其农场投资可持续的措施，以减少环境影响。

sentences.cn: 我们正在从当地农场直接采购有机农产品，以确保新鲜度和品质。

sentences.en: Our company is expanding into the Iranian market, and we need translators fluent in Farsi.

sentences.cn: 公司用新标志更新了建筑物外墙的楣板。

sentences.cn: 演讲者的精彩演示文稿深深吸引了全体听众。

sentences.cn: 该公司的创新技术在贸易展览中深深吸引了潜在投资者。

sentences.cn: 时尚产业竞争激烈，设计师不断创新以保持领先地位。

sentences.cn: 该公司的新系列服装旨在吸引时髦的客户群。

sentences.cn: 为了保持竞争力，零售商必须适应不断变化的时尚潮流，并提供时髦的商品。

sentences.cn: 他常被称为现代经济学之父。

sentences.cn: 信息部门正在调查有故障的设备，以确定系统中断的原因。

sentences.cn: 由于设计缺陷，制造商回购了有缺陷的手机批量。

trans.tran: 最终定案；完成并确认

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to finalize the presentation slides before the client meeting.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要在客户会议前完成演示文稿的制作。

sentences.en: Please finalize the contract details and send it to the legal department for review.
sentences.cn: 请完成合约细节，并发送给法律部门审阅。

trans.tran: 最终确定；完成定案

sentences.en: The contract has been finalized and is ready for signatures.
sentences.cn: 合约已最终确定，准备好签署。

sentences.en: After several revisions, the project plan was finalized by the management team.
sentences.cn: 经过多次修改，项目计划由管理团队最终确定。

trans.tran: 最终、终于；用于表示在经过一段时间或多项进程后的结论或结果

sentences.en: Finally, we will implement the new pricing strategy starting next quarter.
sentences.cn: 最后，我们将于下季度开始实施新的定价策略。

sentences.en: After reviewing all proposals, we finally decided to award the contract to XYZ Corp.
sentences.cn: 在审查所有提案后，我们最终决定将合约授予 XYZ 公司。

trans.tran: 资金的取得、管理与运用，包括筹措、投资、预算编列及风险控制等企业或组织的财务活动。

sentences.en: The finance department will prepare the quarterly budget report by next Monday.
sentences.cn: 财务部门将于下周一前完成本季预算报告的编制。

sentences.en: We need to finance the new project through a combination of equity and debt.
sentences.cn: 我们需要透过股权与债务的组合来为新项目提供资金。

trans.tran: 财务；资金管理

sentences.en: The company's finances are currently under review by the auditors.
sentences.cn: 公司的财务状况目前正在由审计师审查。

sentences.en: Managing your personal finances effectively can help you achieve your financial goals.
sentences.cn: 有效地管理您的个人财务可以帮助您实现财务目标。

trans.tran: 与金钱、投资、会计或财务状况相关的。

sentences.en: The company is facing a financial crisis due to declining sales.
sentences.cn: 由于销售额下降，该公司正面临财务危机。

sentences.en: We need to analyze the financial statements to assess the company's performance.
sentences.cn: 我们需要分析财务报表以评估公司的绩效。

trans.tran: 财务上地；关于财务状况的

sentences.en: The company is financially stable and expected to report record profits this quarter.
sentences.cn: 该公司财务状况稳健，预计本季将报告创纪录的利润。

sentences.en: Employees are encouraged to seek financial advice to manage their retirement savings.
sentences.cn: 员工们被鼓励寻求财务建议，以管理他们的退休储蓄。

trans.tran: 财务报表、财务状况；财务数据

sentences.en: The board of directors will review the company's financials before making any investment decisions.
sentences.cn: 董事会将在做出任何投资决策之前审阅公司的财务报表。

sentences.en: Investors are closely examining the company's financials to assess its profitability.
sentences.cn: 投资者正在密切审阅公司的财务状况，以评估其盈利能力。

trans.tran: 融资；资金筹措

sentences.en: The company is seeking additional financing to expand its operations.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻求额外的融资以扩展其业务。

sentences.en: Securing financing proved to be a major challenge for the startup.
sentences.cn: 为新创公司融资证明是一项主要的挑战。

trans.tran: 找到；发现；查明；认为；感受；取得；(n)发现物

sentences.en: Did you find the document you were looking for?
sentences.cn: 你找到你正在找的文档了吗？

sentences.en: We need to find a solution to this problem as soon as possible.
sentences.cn: 我们需要尽快找到解决这个问题的办法。

trans.tran: 研究结果；发现（通常指经过分析后的结论）

sentences.en: The company's findings indicated a significant increase in customer satisfaction after implementing the new training program.
sentences.cn: 公司的研究结果显示，在实施新的培训计划后，客户满意度显著提升。

sentences.en: The audit findings revealed several discrepancies in the financial records.
sentences.cn: 审计结果揭示了财务记录中存在一些差异。

trans.tran: 状况良好；无恙；（表示同意或接受）好的

sentences.en: I'm fine, thank you for asking. I'm ready to start the meeting.
sentences.cn: 我很好，谢谢您的关心。我准备好开始会议了。

sentences.en: The report is fine, but could you please add a summary of the key findings?
sentences.cn: 报告很好，但您能否请添加主要发现的摘要？

trans.tran: 罚款；被处以罚金

sentences.en: The company was fined for violating environmental regulations.
sentences.cn: 该公司因违反环境法规而被处以罚款。

sentences.en: Employees who park in unauthorized areas will be fined.
sentences.cn: 在未经授权的区域停车的员工将被处以罚款。

trans.tran: 精细地；细致地；以细腻的方式

sentences.en: The documents were finely edited to ensure accuracy and clarity.
sentences.cn: 文档经过精细编辑，以确保准确性和清晰度。

sentences.en: The chef prepared the dish finely, paying close attention to detail.
sentences.cn: 厨师精细地准备了这道菜，非常注重细节。

trans.tran: 最优良的；顶级的；最好的

sentences.en: Our company offers the finest quality products to meet the highest customer expectations.
sentences.cn: 我们公司提供最优良的产品，以满足客户最高的期望。

sentences.en: The hotel boasts the finest dining experience in the city, featuring award-winning chefs.
sentences.cn: 这家酒店拥有城市中最顶级的餐饮体验，拥有屡获殊荣的厨师。

trans.tran: 手指；指头；（用手指）指示

sentences.en: Please point to the relevant section on the document with your finger.
sentences.cn: 请用手指指向文档中的相关部分。

sentences.en: The applicant was asked to demonstrate their finger dexterity during the typing test.
sentences.cn: 在打字测试中，被要求展示手指的灵活度。

trans.tran: 指尖

sentences.en: She felt the texture of the fabric with her fingertips.
sentences.cn: 她用指尖感受布料的质地。

sentences.en: It's important to have all the project details at your fingertips.
sentences.cn: 掌握所有项目细节是重要的。

trans.tran: 完成；结束；终止

sentences.en: Please finish the report by the end of the day.
sentences.cn: 请在今天结束前完成这份报告。

sentences.en: The project team needs to finish the presentation before the deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目团队需要在截止日期前完成演示文稿。

trans.tran: 完成；结束；告一段落

sentences.en: The project is finished ahead of schedule and under budget.
sentences.cn: 这个项目已超前进度且低于预算完成。

sentences.en: Please submit your report by Friday; we need it finished by then.
sentences.cn: 请在星期五前提交您的报告，我们需要在当时完成。

trans.tran: 完成；结束；终止

sentences.en: The project team needs to finish the report by Friday.
sentences.cn: 项目团队需要在星期五前完成报告。

sentences.en: Please ensure all invoices are finished and submitted before the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 请确保所有发票在月底前完成并提交。

trans.tran: 完成；结束；终结

sentences.en: The project team is working diligently to finish the report by the deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目团队正在努力工作，以在截止日期前完成报告。

sentences.en: We are finishing up the final details of the contract before sending it to the client.
sentences.cn: 我们正在完成合约的最后细节，然后再发送给客户。

trans.tran: 有限的；限定的；(语法)限定的

sentences.en: Our natural resources are finite, and we must conserve them.
sentences.cn: 我们的自然资源是有限的，我们必须加以保育。

sentences.en: The project has a finite budget, so we need to manage expenses carefully.
sentences.cn: 该项目预算有限，因此我们需要仔细管理开支。

sentences.en: The company was forced to fire several employees due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济下滑，公司被迫解雇了几名员工。

sentences.en: The fire alarm was triggered by a faulty electrical circuit.
sentences.cn: 一个电路故障触发了火灾警报。

trans.tran: 解雇；开除（员工）

sentences.en: The company fired several employees due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济衰退，公司解雇了几名员工。

sentences.en: He was fired for consistently failing to meet his sales targets.
sentences.cn: 他因为持续未能达成销售目标而被解雇。

trans.tran: 消防员

sentences.en: The brave firefighter rescued the child from the burning building.
sentences.cn: 勇敢的消防员从燃烧的建筑物中救出了孩子。

sentences.en: Firefighters work long hours and face dangerous situations regularly.
sentences.cn: 消防员工作时间长，并经常面临危险情况。

trans.tran: 壁炉，壁火炉

sentences.en: The hotel boasts a cozy fireplace in each suite, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere for guests.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店的每间套房都设有舒适的壁炉，为住客营造温馨且吸引人的氛围。

sentences.en: The property's value increased significantly due to the addition of a modern fireplace in the living room.
sentences.cn: 客厅添加了现代壁炉，使该房产的价值显著提升。

trans.tran: 木柴；燃料木材（通常指用于取暖或烹饪的木材）

sentences.en: The resort's sustainability policy encourages guests to use firewood responsibly for campfires.
sentences.cn: 度假村的可持续性政策鼓励客人负责任地使用木柴来营造篝火。

sentences.en: Due to the recent cold snap, the warehouse is stocking up on firewood to ensure heating for the staff.
sentences.cn: 由于最近的寒流，仓库正在大量备购木柴，以确保员工的供暖。

trans.tran: （公司、组织）公司、实体；坚定的、稳固的

sentences.en: Our company is a leading firm in the financial consulting industry.
sentences.cn: 我们公司是金融咨询业的领先企业。

sentences.en: The contract requires a firm commitment from both parties.
sentences.cn: 这份合约需要双方给予坚定的承诺。

trans.tran: 坚定地；牢固地；坚决地

sentences.en: The manager stated firmly that the deadline would not be extended.
sentences.cn: 经理坚定地表示，截止日期不会延长。

sentences.en: We firmly believe in providing excellent customer service.
sentences.cn: 我们坚信提供卓越的客户服务。

trans.tran: 公司；企业（通常指规模较小或专业性较强的公司）

sentences.en: Several small firms are competing for the government contract.
sentences.cn: 多家小型公司正在争夺政府合约。

sentences.en: The accounting firm specializes in providing tax services to startups.
sentences.cn: 这家会计公司专注于为新创公司提供税务服务。

trans.tran: 第一的; 最初的; 优先的; 首先; 第一次

sentences.en: Please review the first draft of the proposal by tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 请在明天前审阅提案的初稿。

sentences.en: She was the first person to achieve perfect attendance this year.
sentences.cn: 她是今年第一个达到全勤的人。

trans.tran: 直接的；第一手的；亲身经历的

sentences.en: The report is based on firsthand accounts from employees at the factory.
sentences.cn: 这份报告是根据工厂员工的第一手数据编写而成。

sentences.en: I gained firsthand experience in project management during my internship.
sentences.cn: 我在实习期间获得了第一手的项目管理经验。

trans.tran: 首先；第一，用于引导一系列步骤或论点。

sentences.en: Firstly, please review the attached document for any discrepancies.
sentences.cn: 首先，请检阅附件文档，确认是否有任何差异。

sentences.en: Firstly, we need to analyze the market trends, then develop a marketing strategy.
sentences.cn: 首先，我们需要分析市场趋势，然后制定营销策略。

trans.tran: 与政府或企业的财政相关的；财务的。

sentences.en: The company is facing a challenging fiscal year due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济衰退，公司面临一个充满挑战的财政年度。

sentences.en: The government announced a new fiscal policy to stimulate economic growth.
sentences.cn: 政府宣布了一项新的财政政策以刺激经济增长。

trans.tran: 鱼类；（比喻）不重要的事物或人

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a wide variety of seafood, including grilled fish.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种海鲜，包括烤鱼。

sentences.en: Let's not waste time on small fish; focus on the major clients.
sentences.cn: 别把时间浪费在不重要的细节上，专注于主要客户。

trans.tran: 捕鱼；（比喻）寻找、探寻（机会、资源等）

sentences.en: The company is exploring new markets, essentially fishing for potential clients.
sentences.cn: 公司正在探索新市场，实际上是在寻找潜在客户。

sentences.en: Due to regulations, commercial fishing in this area is strictly prohibited.
sentences.cn: 由于法规，此区域的商业捕鱼是被严格禁止的。

trans.tran: 拳头；用拳头击打

sentences.en: He slammed his fist on the table in frustration after the failed negotiation.
sentences.cn: 在谈判失败后，他因沮丧而重重地把拳头砸在桌子上。

sentences.en: The manager warned the employee against raising a fist in anger during a disagreement.
sentences.cn: 经理警告员工在发生争执时不要用拳头表示愤怒。

trans.tran: 合身；符合；适应；符合要求

sentences.en: The new software fits our company's workflow perfectly.
sentences.cn: 这个新软件完全符合我们公司的工作流程。

sentences.en: Make sure the proposal fits the client's budget and requirements.
sentences.cn: 请确保提案符合客户的预算和要求。

trans.tran: 健康状况；体能；适能

sentences.en: The company offers wellness programs to improve employee fitness and productivity.
sentences.cn: 公司提供健康促进计划，以提升员工的体能和生产力。

sentences.en: Maintaining a good level of fitness is crucial for performing demanding physical tasks in this role.
sentences.cn: 在这个职位上运行繁重体力工作，维持良好的体能至关重要。

trans.tran: 合身；符合；适应

sentences.en: The new software fits our company's existing IT infrastructure seamlessly.
sentences.cn: 这套新软件与我们公司的现有 IT 基础架构完美地契合。

sentences.en: The budget fits within the allocated resources for this quarter.
sentences.cn: 这个预算在我们本季的预算范围内。

trans.tran: （服装、家具等）量身订做的；合身的

sentences.en: The tailor provided a perfectly fitted suit for the important business meeting.
sentences.cn: 裁缝师为重要的商务会议提供了一件量身订做的西装。

sentences.en: Ensure all office chairs are fitted with ergonomic supports for employee comfort.
sentences.cn: 确保所有办公椅都配备符合人体工学的支撑，以提高员工的舒适度。

trans.tran: 修复；解决问题；（系统、设备等）维修

sentences.en: The IT department needs to fix the network error before the meeting starts.
sentences.cn: 在会议开始前，IT部门需要修复网络错误。

sentences.en: We need to fix this bug in the software before releasing the new version.
sentences.cn: 在发布新版本之前，我们需要修复软件中的这个错误。

trans.tran: 已确定、固定不变的；已修复或已解决的（形容词）

sentences.en: The project timeline has been fixed for the next six months, so no further changes will be allowed.
sentences.cn: 此项目的时间表已固定在未来六个月内，将不再允许变更。

sentences.en: Our IT team fixed the server issue within two hours, restoring normal operations.
sentences.cn: 我们的 IT 团队在两小时内修复了服务器问题，恢复了正常运作。

trans.tran: 修复；解决问题；订正

sentences.en: Our IT department quickly fixes any system errors to minimize downtime.
sentences.cn: 我们的 IT 部门迅速修复任何系统错误，以减少停机时间。

sentences.en: The software developer needs to fix the bug in the latest version before release.
sentences.cn: 软件开发人员需要在发布前修复最新版本中的错误。

trans.tran: 修复；解决问题；正在进行的维修或调整

sentences.en: The IT department is currently fixing the network outage.
sentences.cn: 信息部门目前正在修复网络中断。

sentences.en: We need to fix these errors in the report before submitting it to the client.
sentences.cn: 在提交报告给客户之前，我们需要修复报告中的这些错误。

trans.tran: 固定设备；（建筑物或车辆中的）固定设备

sentences.en: The new office building is equipped with modern fixtures, including energy-efficient lighting and plumbing.
sentences.cn: 这栋新办公大楼配备了现代化的固定设备，包括节能照明和水管。

sentences.en: Before moving in, ensure all fixtures in the apartment are in good working order.
sentences.cn: 搬入之前，请确保公寓内的所有固定设备都运作良好。

trans.tran: 标志；旗帜；信号；指示

sentences.en: The company's flag is prominently displayed at the entrance of the building.
sentences.cn: 该公司的标志悬挂在建筑物入口处，非常显眼。

sentences.en: The system flagged several potentially fraudulent transactions for review.
sentences.cn: 系统标记了几个可能存在欺诈的交易，以供审查。

trans.tran: 独特的风格或气质；擅长处理某事的技巧或能力

sentences.en: The marketing campaign lacked flair and failed to capture the audience's attention.
sentences.cn: 这项行销活动缺乏亮点，未能吸引受众的注意力。

sentences.en: Her presentation showcased a natural flair for public speaking.
sentences.cn: 她的演示文稿展现了她天生的演讲才能。

trans.tran: 火焰；燃烧的火光；（比喻）热情、活力

sentences.en: The company is working to reduce its carbon footprint and extinguish the flames of environmental concerns.
sentences.cn: 公司正努力减少碳足迹，并消除环境问题的担忧。

sentences.en: The marketing campaign ignited a flame of interest among potential investors.
sentences.cn: 营销活动点燃了潜在投资者的兴趣。

trans.tran: 易燃的；容易燃烧的，指物质或物品容易被火点燃。

sentences.en: The warehouse manager emphasized that all flammable materials must be stored in designated fire-resistant cabinets.
sentences.cn: 仓库经理强调，所有易燃材料必须保存在指定的防火柜中。

sentences.en: Due to safety regulations, the shipping department cannot accept packages containing flammable liquids without proper labeling and documentation.
sentences.cn: 由于安全规定，运输部门无法接受未正确标示和文档化的易燃液体包裹。

trans.tran: 瞬间的；快速的；（灯等）闪烁

sentences.en: The server experienced a brief flash of error messages before stabilizing.
sentences.cn: 服务器在稳定之前，经历了短暂的错误消息闪烁。

sentences.en: The presentation software needs a flash update to improve security.
sentences.cn: 为了提高安全性，演示软件需要进行快速更新。

trans.tran: 平坦的；公寓（住宅）

sentences.en: The company is looking for a flat piece of land to build a new warehouse.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找一块平坦的土地来建造新的仓库。

sentences.en: Many young professionals prefer to rent a flat in the city center.
sentences.cn: 许多年轻专业人士喜欢在市中心租一套公寓。

trans.tran: 使变平；压平；摊平

sentences.en: The packaging department needs to flatten the cardboard boxes to save storage space.
sentences.cn: 包装部门需要将纸箱摊平以节省保存空间。

sentences.en: To ensure efficient shipping, please flatten all packages before they are collected.
sentences.cn: 为了确保高效的运输，请在收集之前将所有包裹摊平。

trans.tran: 奉承；过度赞美（通常带有试图获得好处的目的）

sentences.en: He tends to flatter his boss in hopes of getting a promotion.
sentences.cn: 他倾向于奉承他的老板，希望得到升迁。

sentences.en: While compliments are appreciated, excessive flattery can be perceived as insincere.
sentences.cn: 虽然赞美令人愉快，但过度的奉承可能会被认为是不真诚的。

trans.tran: 因受到的赞美或称赞而感到高兴或自豪。

sentences.en: The manager was flattered by the employee's positive feedback on his leadership skills.
sentences.cn: 经理因员工对他领导技巧的正面回馈而感到受宠若思。

sentences.en: She was flattered to be invited to present at the international conference.
sentences.cn: 她很受鼓舞，被邀请在国际会议上发表演讲。

trans.tran: 风味、味道（尤指食物的独特风味）

sentences.en: The new coffee blend has a rich, nutty flavor.
sentences.cn: 这款新咖啡的风味浓郁，带有坚果的味道。

sentences.en: The restaurant is known for its unique flavor combinations and innovative menu.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅以其独特的风味组合和创新的菜单而闻名。

trans.tran: 带有特定风味的；调味过的
