sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供午餐套餐菜单，包含开胃菜、主菜和甜点。

trans.tran: 商品；货品（通常指经销或贩售的商品）

sentences.en: The store is having a huge sale on all its merchandise.
sentences.cn: 这家商店正在对其所有商品进行大规模促销。

sentences.en: Our company specializes in the import and export of high-quality merchandise.
sentences.cn: 我们公司专注于高品质商品的进出口贸易。

trans.tran: 商人；贸易商，通常指从事零售或批发业务的人。

sentences.en: The company is seeking a reliable merchant to supply raw materials.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找一位可靠的商人来供应原材料。

sentences.en: Online merchants are facing increased competition from larger retailers.
sentences.cn: 网络商人正面临来自大型零售商的日益激烈的竞争。

trans.tran: 汞，水银；水星

sentences.en: Mercury is a toxic heavy metal often found in industrial waste.
sentences.cn: 汞是一种有毒的重金属，常存在于工业废料中。

sentences.en: The planet Mercury is named after the Roman messenger god.
sentences.cn: 水星以罗马信使神的名字命名。

trans.tran: 仅仅的；微不足道的；仅有

sentences.cn: 本季公司利润仅增加 2%，这并不是一个显著的增长。

sentences.cn: 他只是提出了一个微不足道的建议，但却带来了重大的突破。

sentences.en: He was merely stating the facts, not expressing an opinion.
sentences.cn: 他仅仅是陈述事实，并非表达意见。

sentences.en: The mistake was merely a misunderstanding.
sentences.cn: 这个错误只是一个误会。

trans.tran: 合并；结合；融为一

sentences.en: The IT department will merge the two databases by the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 信息部门将在本周结束前合并这两个数据库。

sentences.en: Please merge your changes with the master document before submitting it.
sentences.cn: 提交文档前，请将您的修改合并到主文档。

sentences.en: The two companies merged to form a larger entity.
sentences.cn: 这两家公司合并成立一个更大的实体。

sentences.en: The marketing and sales departments merged to streamline operations.
sentences.cn: 行销和销售部门合并以简化营运。

trans.tran: 合并；联合，尤其指公司或部门的合并。

sentences.en: The two companies announced a merger to increase market share.
sentences.cn: 这两家公司宣布合并以提高市场占有率。

sentences.en: The merger process is expected to take several months and require significant restructuring.
sentences.cn: 预计合并过程将持续数月，并需要进行大规模的重组。

trans.tran: 蛋白酥饼；蛋白甜点，通常用于甜点或餐点的装饰。

sentences.en: The hotel's dessert menu features a variety of elegant meringues.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店的甜点菜单提供多种精美的蛋白酥饼。

sentences.en: The pastry chef is known for his delicate and flavorful meringues.
sentences.cn: 这位糕点师以其精致美味的蛋白酥饼闻名。

trans.tran: 优点、长处、功绩；值得赞扬的价值或品质

sentences.en: The employee's merit was recognized with a promotion and a bonus.
sentences.cn: 该员工的优点得到了认可，获得了晋升和奖金。

sentences.en: Highlighting the merits of the new software will be key to successful sales.
sentences.cn: 强调新软件的优点将是成功销售的关键。

trans.tran: 快乐的；愉快的（用于表达欢乐的氛围或庆祝活动）

sentences.en: The company organized a merry celebration to mark the successful launch of the new product.
sentences.cn: 公司举办了一场欢乐庆祝活动，以庆祝新产品成功发布。

sentences.en: We wish you a merry Christmas and a prosperous New Year!
sentences.cn: 祝您圣诞快乐，新年繁荣！

trans.tran: 杂乱、混乱；（使）弄乱、搞乱

sentences.en: The desk was a complete mess after the project deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目截止日期后，办公桌一片狼藉。

sentences.en: Please don't mess up the report before the presentation.
sentences.cn: 请不要在演示文稿前搞乱这份报告。

trans.tran: 消息；通知；传递的信息

sentences.cn: 请立即将此紧急消息转发给项目经理。

sentences.en: The company sent a message to all employees regarding the upcoming policy changes.
sentences.cn: 公司发送消息给所有员工，说明即将到来的政策变更。

trans.tran: 消息；传讯（通常指电子邮件、短信或其他数字形式的沟通内容）

sentences.en: The manager asked the secretary to prioritize responding to urgent messages.
sentences.cn: 经理请秘书优先回复重要的消息。

sentences.en: Please check your inbox for messages from the IT department regarding system updates.
sentences.cn: 请查看您的收件匣，收看来自 IT 部门关于系统更新的消息。

trans.tran: 消息传递；消息发送

sentences.en: The company uses instant messaging for quick internal communication.
sentences.cn: 公司使用实时消息传递进行快速的内部沟通。

sentences.en: Please message your supervisor to confirm your attendance at the meeting.
sentences.cn: 请发消息给你的主管，确认你是否会出席会议。

trans.tran: 搞乱；弄糟；使混乱（通常指非故意的结果）

sentences.en: I accidentally messed up the report with incorrect data.
sentences.cn: 我不小心在报告中加入了错误的数据，搞砸了。

sentences.en: The new software update messed with the system's performance.
sentences.cn: 新的软件更新导致系统性能下降。

trans.tran: 信使，送信人；送货员；通信软件

sentences.cn: 信使准时将紧急文档送达办公室。

sentences.en: She primarily uses a messenger app to communicate with her international clients.
sentences.cn: 她主要使用通信软件与她的国际客户沟通。

trans.tran: （通常指在会议或书面文档中）遇到；遭遇；碰到

sentences.cn: 项目团队将在下周与利害关系人会面，以讨论进度。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I didn't meet the deadline for submitting the report.
sentences.cn: 我很抱歉，我没有在提交报告的期限内完成。

trans.tran: 代谢的；新陈代谢的

sentences.cn: 医生解释说，患者精力不足是因为新陈代谢率缓慢。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can improve your metabolic health.
sentences.cn: 规律运动可以改善你的代谢健康。

sentences.en: Regular exercise can boost your metabolism and help with weight management.
sentences.cn: 规律运动可以促进你的新陈代谢，有助于体重管理。

sentences.en: The doctor explained how the drug affects the body's metabolism.
sentences.cn: 医生解释了这种药物如何影响身体的新陈代谢。

sentences.en: We need to ensure the metal components meet the required safety standards before installation.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在安装前确保金属组件符合所需的安全标准。

sentences.cn: 物流团队需要确保金属制品在运输过程中得到妥善包装，以防止损坏。

sentences.cn: “时间就是金钱”这个短语是一个众所周知的隐喻。

sentences.en: She used a beautiful metaphor to describe the sunset.
sentences.cn: 她用了一个美丽的隐喻来描述日落。

sentences.cn: 供应商需要以公尺为单位提供货运的尺寸。

sentences.cn: 仓库经理指示员工以公尺为单位测量保存空间，以优化库存。

sentences.cn: 仓库长 50 公尺，宽 30 公尺。

sentences.en: The delivery truck can carry up to 1,000 meters of cable.
sentences.cn: 这辆货车可以运送长达 1000 公尺的电缆。

sentences.cn: 我通常在中午休息一下，补充能量。

sentences.en: The company is currently in the middle of a major restructuring process.
sentences.cn: 公司目前正处于一项重大的重组流程之中。

sentences.cn: 她用尽全力推开那扇沉重的门。

sentences.cn: 移工在新环境中常面临挑战。

sentences.cn: 我们正在计划将数据迁移到新的云端服务器以提高系统性能。

sentences.en: The shipment was mislabeled, causing delays in delivery.
sentences.cn: 货物标签错误，导致了交货延迟。

trans.tran: 各种零星的、不属于同一类别的事物或项目。

sentences.en: Please submit a list of miscellaneous expenses for reimbursement.
sentences.cn: 请提交一份零星费用的清单以供报销。

sentences.en: The meeting agenda included a few miscellaneous topics that weren't directly related to the main project.
sentences.cn: 会议议程包含一些与主要项目无直接关联的零星议题。

trans.tran: 极度不快乐的；令人痛苦的，通常指因失望、挫折或困境而产生的负面情绪。

sentences.en: The project was delayed again, and the team is feeling miserable.
sentences.cn: 项目再次延迟，团队成员感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: I'm miserable working overtime every weekend; I need a better work-life balance.
sentences.cn: 我每个周末都加班，工作非常痛苦，我需要更好的工作与生活平衡。

trans.tran: 错误识别；认错

sentences.en: The witness misidentified the suspect in the lineup.
sentences.cn: 证人在指认嫌犯时认错了人。

sentences.en: It's easy to misidentify the cause of the problem without proper investigation.
sentences.cn: 若无适当调查，很容易错误识别问题的根源。

trans.tran: 误导

sentences.en: We need to mislead this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细误导。

sentences.en: The mislead is important for success.
sentences.cn: 误导对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 具有误导性，引人错误判断的；使人产生错误印象的。

sentences.en: The advertisement was misleading, failing to mention the hidden fees.
sentences.cn: 这则广告具有误导性，没有提及隐藏费用。

sentences.en: The company issued a statement clarifying the misleading information released earlier.
sentences.cn: 公司发布声明，澄清先前发布的误导性信息。

trans.tran: 将某物放置于不该放置的地方，或暂时找不到某物。

sentences.en: I seem to have misplaced my presentation notes; could someone help me find them?
sentences.cn: 我好像把我的演示文稿笔记弄丢了；有人能帮我找找吗？

sentences.en: The company is implementing a new inventory system to prevent employees from misplacing important documents.
sentences.cn: 公司正在实施新的库存系统，以防止员工将重要文档弄丢。

trans.tran: 印刷错误；误印

sentences.en: We need to reprint the brochures as there are several misprints on the first batch.
sentences.cn: 我们需要重新印制小册子，因为第一批有几个印刷错误。

sentences.en: The editor apologized for the misprint in the latest report and promised to correct it immediately.
sentences.cn: 编辑为最新报告中的印刷错误道歉，并承诺立即更正。

trans.tran: 误解；错误地阅读或理解

sentences.en: The contract clause was misread, leading to a misunderstanding between the parties.
sentences.cn: 合约条款被误解，导致双方产生误会。

sentences.en: I'm afraid I misread your email and scheduled the meeting for the wrong date.
sentences.cn: 我很抱歉，我误解了您的电子邮件，将会议安排在了错误的日期。

trans.tran: 错过；遗漏；想念

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I missed the deadline for submitting the proposal.
sentences.cn: 抱歉，我错过了提交提案的截止日期。

sentences.en: The manager missed a crucial detail in the report, which led to a significant error.
sentences.cn: 经理在报告中遗漏了一个关键细节，导致了严重的错误。

trans.tran: 错过；遗漏；未达到

sentences.en: I missed the deadline for submitting the project proposal.
sentences.cn: 我错过了提交项目提案的期限。

sentences.en: The company missed its sales target for the quarter due to unforeseen circumstances.
sentences.cn: 由于突发状况，公司未能达到本季的销售目标。

trans.tran: 遗漏；未达到（目标、期望等）

sentences.en: The project team misses the deadline due to unexpected delays.
sentences.cn: 由于意外延迟，项目团队未能按时完成。

sentences.en: She misses a crucial opportunity to secure the contract.
sentences.cn: 她错失了签订合约的关键机会。

trans.tran: 导弹; 飞弹; 发射物

sentences.en: The country successfully tested its new long-range missile.
sentences.cn: 该国成功测试了其新型远程导弹。

sentences.en: Anti-missile defense systems are designed to intercept incoming projectiles.
sentences.cn: 反导弹防御系统旨在拦截来袭的发射物。

trans.tran: 遗失的；缺少的；未找到的

sentences.en: The report is missing several key figures, so we need to double-check the data.
sentences.cn: 报告缺少几个关键数据，我们需要仔细核对数据。

sentences.en: A missing employee's laptop was reported to IT security immediately.
sentences.cn: 员工遗失的笔记本电脑已立即向 IT 安全部门报告。

trans.tran: 任务；委托事项（通常指具有特定目标的行动或计划）

sentences.en: Our company's mission is to provide innovative solutions for our clients.
sentences.cn: 我们公司的使命是为客户提供创新的解决方案。

sentences.en: The sales team is on a mission to increase sales by 15% this quarter.
sentences.cn: 销售团队的任务是本季将销售额提高 15%。

trans.tran: 错误；失误；偏差

sentences.en: I made a small mistake in the report, but I'm correcting it now.
sentences.cn: 我在报告中犯了一个小错误，但我现在正在修正它。

sentences.en: Let's review the contract carefully to avoid any mistakes.
sentences.cn: 让我们仔细审阅合约，以避免任何错误。

trans.tran: 错误地；错误地认为或做某事

sentences.en: The report was submitted with some figures mistakenly entered.
sentences.cn: 报告提交时，有些数字被错误地输入了。

sentences.en: I mistakenly believed the deadline was next week, so I haven't finished the project yet.
sentences.cn: 我错误地认为截止日期是下周，所以目前尚未完成项目。

trans.tran: 错误；失误；过失（通常指在工作或学习中发生的），需要被修正或避免。

sentences.en: Let's review the report carefully to avoid any mistakes before submitting it to the board.
sentences.cn: 请仔细审阅报告，在提交给董事会之前避免任何错误。

sentences.en: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes; the important thing is to learn from them and improve.
sentences.cn: 每个人偶尔都会犯错，重要的是从中学习并改进。

trans.tran: 先生

sentences.en: Good morning, mister Smith. How may I help you?
sentences.cn: 史密斯先生早安，我能为您做什么？

sentences.en: Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet.
sentences.cn: 先生不好意思，您的钱包掉了。

trans.tran: 误解；不了解

sentences.en: I'm afraid you've misunderstood the instructions.
sentences.cn: 恐怕你误解了这些指示。

sentences.en: I hope you don't misunderstand my intentions.
sentences.cn: 我希望你没有误解我的意图。

trans.tran: 误解；被误解

sentences.en: The manager felt misunderstood by his team after the restructuring announcement.
sentences.cn: 重组公告后，经理觉得自己的团队不理解他的意思。

sentences.en: Due to a language barrier, the client's request was misunderstood, leading to a delay in the project.
sentences.cn: 由于语言障碍，客户的要求被误解，导致项目延迟。

trans.tran: 错误使用；滥用（资源、设备、信息等）

sentences.en: The company is investigating how employees misused the company credit card.
sentences.cn: 公司正在调查员工如何滥用公司信用卡。

sentences.en: It is against company policy to misuse confidential data for personal gain.
sentences.cn: 为了个人利益而滥用机密数据违反公司政策。

trans.tran: 减轻；缓和；缓解

sentences.en: The company implemented new safety protocols to mitigate the risk of accidents.
sentences.cn: 该公司实施了新的安全协议，以减轻事故发生的风险。

sentences.en: We need to find effective strategies to mitigate the negative impact of the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 我们需要找到有效的策略来减轻经济衰退的负面影响。

trans.tran: 混合；结合；搀和

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to mix traditional and digital strategies to reach a wider audience.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要将传统和数字策略结合，以接触更广泛的受众。

sentences.en: Could you mix the ingredients thoroughly before baking the cake?
sentences.cn: 在烘焙蛋糕之前，您能将材料充分混合吗？

trans.tran: 混合的；混杂的；包含多种元素的

sentences.en: The company's portfolio is a mixed bag of investments, ranging from tech startups to established corporations.
sentences.cn: 该公司的投资组合包含多种投资，从科技新创公司到成熟企业都有。

sentences.en: The meeting attendees had mixed reactions to the proposed changes to the company's policy.
sentences.cn: 对于公司政策的建议变更，会议参与者们的反应褒贬不一。

trans.tran: 混合物；配方；组合

sentences.en: The quality control department needs to ensure the correct mixture of ingredients is used in the production process.
sentences.cn: 品质控制部门需要确保生产过程中使用了正确的原料混合比例。

sentences.en: We need a precise mixture of chemicals to achieve the desired product consistency.
sentences.cn: 为了达到所需的产品一致性，我们需要精确的化学品混合比例。

trans.tran: 行动的；可移动的；（指手机等）行动设备

sentences.en: The company is transitioning to a mobile workforce to reduce office space costs.
sentences.cn: 公司正在转型为行动办公室，以降低办公室空间成本。

sentences.en: Please send the presentation to all attendees via mobile devices.
sentences.cn: 请将演示文稿透过行动设备发送给所有与会者。

trans.tran: 流动性；行动力；可移动性，通常指人员、设备或信息的灵活性和便利性。

sentences.en: The company is investing in new software to improve employee mobility and collaboration.
sentences.cn: 公司正在投资新软件以提高员工的流动性和协作效率。

sentences.en: Increased mobility options, such as remote work, are attracting a wider range of talent.
sentences.cn: 更多流动性选择，例如远程工作，正在吸引更广泛的人才。

trans.tran: 动员；组织并部署资源以达到特定目标

sentences.en: The company needs to mobilize its sales team to meet the quarterly targets.
sentences.cn: 公司需要动员销售团队以达成季度目标。

sentences.en: In response to the crisis, the government mobilized emergency services and resources.
sentences.cn: 为了应对危机，政府动员了紧急服务和资源。

trans.tran: 模式；方式；运作方式

sentences.en: The company is transitioning to a new operational mode to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在转变为新的运作模式以提高效率。

sentences.en: We need to analyze the current sales mode to identify areas for improvement.
sentences.cn: 我们需要分析目前的销售模式，以找出需要改进的地方。

trans.tran: 范本；模型；示范；模仿

sentences.en: The marketing team used a model presentation to showcase the new product features.
sentences.cn: 行销团队使用范本演示文稿来展示新产品的功能。

sentences.en: Our company is looking for a model employee who demonstrates strong work ethic and teamwork.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在寻找一位展现出强烈的工作伦理和团队合作精神的优秀员工。

trans.tran: 模型；范例；设计图；（服装）模特儿

sentences.en: The marketing team created several models to showcase the new product's features.
sentences.cn: 行销团队制作了几个模型来展示新产品的功能。

sentences.en: The company hired professional models to participate in the fashion show.
sentences.cn: 公司聘请了专业模特儿参加时装秀。

sentences.en: You will need to connect the Ethernet cable to the modem to get internet access.
sentences.cn: 你需要将以太网线连接到调制解调器才能上网。

sentences.en: My internet speed improved after I upgraded to a new modem.
sentences.cn: 我升级到新的调制解调器后，网络速度有所提升。

trans.tran: 温和

sentences.en: We need to moderate this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细温和。

sentences.en: The moderate is important for success.
sentences.cn: 温和对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 主持人；引导者（通常指在在线论坛、会议或讨论中引导讨论并维持秩序的人）

sentences.en: The moderator ensured that all participants adhered to the meeting's agenda.
sentences.cn: 主持人确保所有参与者都遵守会议议程。

sentences.en: Online forums often have moderators to prevent spam and inappropriate content.
sentences.cn: 在线论坛通常会有主持人来防止垃圾消息和不当内容。

trans.tran: 现代的；当代的；符合当前潮流的

sentences.cn: 公司投资了现代化的设备以提高效率。

sentences.en: Our modern office building features state-of-the-art technology.
sentences.cn: 我们现代化的办公大楼配备了最先进的技术。

trans.tran: 现代化

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative modernization procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的modernization进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the modernization implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了modernization影响。

trans.tran: 使现代化；更新（设备、流程、系统等）以符合当代标准或技术。

sentences.en: The company is planning to modernize its production line to increase efficiency.
sentences.cn: 该公司计划现代化其生产线以提高效率。

sentences.en: To remain competitive, businesses need to modernize their IT infrastructure regularly.
sentences.cn: 为了保持竞争力，企业需要定期现代化其 IT 基础架构。

sentences.en: She has achieved great success but remains modest about her accomplishments.
sentences.cn: 她取得了巨大的成功，但对自己的成就仍然谦虚。

sentences.en: The company reported a modest increase in profits this quarter.
sentences.cn: 该公司本季度利润报告有小幅增长。

trans.tran: 谦虚地；适度地；以不引人注目的方式

sentences.en: The company announced its profits modestly, avoiding excessive boasting.
sentences.cn: 公司谦虚地宣布了利润，避免了过度的吹嘘。

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative modification procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的modification进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the modification implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了modification影响。

sentences.en: The company's marketing strategy needs a significant modifier to better target the younger demographic.
sentences.cn: 公司行销策略需要一个重要的修饰词，以更好地针对年轻族群。

sentences.en: The project manager used a clarifying modifier to ensure everyone understood the scope of the task.
sentences.cn: 项目经理使用了一个澄清的修饰词，以确保每个人都理解任务的范围。

trans.tran: 修改；调整；变更（计划、设计、文档等）以符合新的需求或标准。

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to modify the presentation to better reflect the latest market research.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要修改演示文稿，以更好地反映最新的市场研究。

sentences.en: Please modify the contract to include the revised payment terms.
sentences.cn: 请修改合约，以包含修改后的付款条款。

sentences.cn: 该软件设计有可重复使用的模块，使其更易于维护和升级。

sentences.en: Each module of the training program covers a different skill set.
sentences.cn: 培训课程的每个单元都涵盖不同的技能组。

sentences.cn: 仓库经理需要确保通风良好，以防止湿气对库存造成损害。

sentences.en: The quality control department rejected the shipment due to excessive moisture content.
sentences.cn: 由于水分含量过高，品质控制部门拒绝了这批货物。

trans.tran: 1. 霉菌；霉。 2. 模具；铸型。 3. 性格；类型。 4. 塑造；形成；影响。

sentences.en: Please check the expiration date on the food to avoid any mold.
sentences.cn: 请检查食物的有效期限，以避免发霉。

sentences.en: The designer will mold the clay into a unique sculpture.
sentences.cn: 设计师会将黏土塑造成独特的雕塑。

trans.tran: 痣；鼹鼠；内奸，卧底

sentences.en: She has a distinctive mole above her lip.
sentences.cn: 她上唇上方有一颗独特的痣。

sentences.en: The intelligence agency suspected there was a mole within their organization.
sentences.cn: 情报机构怀疑他们组织内部有内奸。

sentences.cn: 科学家正在研究这种病毒的分子结构。

sentences.en: Molecular biology is a rapidly advancing field that combines biology and chemistry.
sentences.cn: 分子生物学是一个快速发展的领域，结合了生物学和化学。

sentences.en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
sentences.cn: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the structure of complex organic molecules.
sentences.cn: 科学家正在研究复杂有机分子的结构。

trans.tran: 母亲；妈妈（指亲生或养育的母亲）

sentences.en: The employee mentioned he needed to leave early to pick up his mom from the airport.
sentences.cn: 这位员工提到他需要提前离开，因为他需要去机场接他的母亲。

sentences.en: The company is hosting a Mother's Day event to show appreciation for all mothers.
sentences.cn: 公司正在举办母亲节活动，以感谢所有母亲。

trans.tran: 瞬间；片刻；时刻（指时间的短暂时期，通常指重要或值得注意的时刻）

sentences.en: Let me just put that on hold for a moment.
sentences.cn: 等一下，我先暂停一下。

sentences.en: In the moment, it seemed like a good idea, but now I'm not so sure.
sentences.cn: 当时觉得是个好主意，但现在我不太确定。

trans.tran: 暂时地；片刻间

sentences.en: Please wait momentarily while I retrieve the document.
sentences.cn: 请稍等片刻，我正在寻找文档。

sentences.en: The system will be unavailable momentarily for maintenance.
sentences.cn: 系统将暂时维护中，请稍后再试。

trans.tran: 短暂的；一时的；瞬间的

sentences.en: The system experienced a momentary outage, but it's back online now.
sentences.cn: 系统出现了短暂的中断，但现在已恢复正常运作。

sentences.en: The delay was only momentary; we expect to depart on schedule.
sentences.cn: 延迟只是一时的，我们预计会按照原定时间出发。

trans.tran: 动量；势头；发展趋势（指某事物发展的推动力量或趋势）

sentences.en: The company is gaining momentum in the Asian market thanks to its innovative products.
sentences.cn: 由于其创新产品，该公司在亚洲市场正获得蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Despite the initial setbacks, the project is now building momentum and is expected to be completed on schedule.
sentences.cn: 尽管一开始遇到挫折，但这个项目现在正逐渐发展，预计将按时完成。

sentences.en: The company is launching a new initiative to support working moms and improve work-life balance.
sentences.cn: 公司正在推出一项新举措，以支持在职母亲并改善工作与生活平衡。

sentences.en: We value employees who are moms and understand the challenges they face.
sentences.cn: 我们重视在职母亲，并理解她们所面临的挑战。

trans.tran: 星期一；周一

sentences.en: The deadline for the project proposal is next Monday.
sentences.cn: 项目提案的截止日期是下星期一。

sentences.en: Our weekly team meeting is held every Monday morning.
sentences.cn: 我们每周的团队会议都在星期一早上举行。

trans.tran: 与金钱或货币相关的；财务的

sentences.en: The company's monetary policy aims to control inflation and stabilize the economy.
sentences.cn: 该公司的货币政策旨在控制通货膨胀并稳定经济。

sentences.cn: 她是一位非常有效率的员工，能在压力下有效地同时处理多项任务。

sentences.en: To improve productivity, employees are encouraged to focus on one task at a time rather than constantly multitasking.

trans.tran: 名字；名称；姓名；声誉；名声；命名；称呼；说出…的名称

sentences.en: Please write your name and address on the form.
sentences.cn: 请在表格上写下您的姓名和地址。

sentences.en: They named their new product 'InnovateX' to reflect its purpose.
sentences.cn: 他们将新产品命名为“InnovateX”，以反映其宗旨。

trans.tran: 被...命名；名为

sentences.en: The new product is named 'Nova' to reflect its innovative features.
sentences.cn: 为了反映其创新功能，新产品被命名为 'Nova'。

sentences.en: The project is named 'Phoenix' after the mythical bird, symbolizing a new beginning.
sentences.cn: 这个项目被命名为 'Phoenix'，灵感来自神话中的凤凰，象征新的开始。

trans.tran: 也就是说；特别是；具体来说

sentences.en: The company is focusing on three key areas, namely, product development, marketing, and customer service.
sentences.cn: 公司将重点放在三个关键领域，也就是说，产品开发、行销和客户服务。

sentences.en: We need to review the following documents, namely, the contract, the invoice, and the delivery receipt.
sentences.cn: 我们需要审查以下文档，具体来说，合同、发票和交货单。

trans.tran: 小睡；打盹

sentences.en: He usually takes a short nap after lunch.
sentences.cn: 他通常在午餐后小睡片刻。

sentences.en: I need to nap for an hour before my next meeting.
sentences.cn: 在下次会议前我需要小睡一小时。

trans.tran: 叙事；故事描述，尤其指详细的、有组织的描述。

sentences.en: The annual report includes a narrative outlining the company's performance over the past year.
sentences.cn: 年度报告包含一个叙事，概述了公司在过去一年中的表现。

sentences.en: The marketing team crafted a compelling narrative to showcase the product's benefits to potential customers.
sentences.cn: 行销团队制作了一个引人入胜的叙事，向潜在客户展示了产品的优势。

trans.tran: 狭窄

sentences.en: We need to narrow this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细狭窄。

sentences.en: The narrow is important for success.
sentences.cn: 狭窄对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 更窄的；比...更狭窄的

sentences.en: The new office layout allows for narrower aisles to maximize space.
sentences.cn: 新的办公室格局允许更窄的通道，以最大限度地利用空间。

sentences.en: We need a narrower margin of error in the market research data to ensure accuracy.
sentences.cn: 为了确保准确性，我们需要市场研究数据中更小的误差范围。

trans.tran: 险些；几乎，形容某事差点发生或达到某种状态，通常带有惊险或接近失败的意味。

sentences.en: The company narrowly avoided a major financial crisis thanks to the quick intervention of the board.
sentences.cn: 由于董事会的迅速介入，公司险些避免了一场重大的金融危机。

sentences.en: The project team narrowly missed the deadline due to unexpected delays.
sentences.cn: 由于意外延迟，项目团队几乎错过了截止日期。

trans.tran: 令人不快的；恶意的；严重的；肮脏的

sentences.en: She made some nasty comments about her colleague.
sentences.cn: 她对她的同事发表了一些恶意的评论。

sentences.en: The weather took a nasty turn, and it started to storm.
sentences.cn: 天气变得非常恶劣，开始下暴风雨了。

trans.tran: 国家；民族；国民

sentences.en: Our company is expanding its operations into several new nations.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在将业务扩展到几个新的国家。

sentences.en: The CEO emphasized the importance of respecting the cultural norms of each nation we operate in.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官强调了我们在各个国家运营时尊重当地文化习俗的重要性。

trans.tran: 全国性的；国家级的；与国家相关的

sentences.en: The company is committed to complying with all national regulations.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于遵守所有国家法规。

sentences.en: The national holiday will affect our office hours next week.
sentences.cn: 下周的国定假日将影响我们的办公时间。

trans.tran: 民族主义；国家主义。一种强烈的信念，认为一个人的国家优于所有其他国家，并强调其文化和利益。

sentences.en: The rise of nationalism often leads to conflicts between countries.
sentences.cn: 民族主义的兴起常导致国家之间的冲突。

sentences.en: She argued that nationalism could both unite and divide a nation.
sentences.cn: 她认为民族主义既能团结也能分裂一个国家。

trans.tran: 民族主义者 (n.); 国家主义者 (n.); 民族主义的 (adj.); 国家主义的 (adj.)

sentences.en: He is a strong nationalist who advocates for his country's independence.
sentences.cn: 他是一位主张国家独立的坚定民族主义者。

sentences.en: The party's nationalist policies have drawn both praise and criticism.
sentences.cn: 该党的民族主义政策引发了赞扬和批评。

trans.tran: 国籍；某人的出生地或归属国。

sentences.en: Please indicate your nationality on the employment application form.
sentences.cn: 请在求职申请表上注明您的国籍。

sentences.en: The company values diversity and welcomes applicants of all nationalities.
sentences.cn: 公司重视多元化，欢迎来自各国的求职者。

trans.tran: 将私人企业或产业转为政府所有并由政府控制。

sentences.en: The government decided to nationalize the railway system to improve efficiency and accessibility.
sentences.cn: 政府决定将铁路系统国有化，以提高效率和可及性。

sentences.en: Concerns were raised about the potential impact of nationalizing the energy sector on foreign investment.
sentences.cn: 人们对将能源部门国有化对外国投资的潜在影响表示担忧。

trans.tran: 国家；民族

sentences.en: The company is expanding its operations to several nations in Southeast Asia.
sentences.cn: 这家公司正在扩展其业务到东南亚的几个国家。

sentences.en: International trade agreements often involve complex negotiations between nations.
sentences.cn: 国际贸易协议通常涉及各国之间复杂的谈判。

trans.tran: 全国性的；涵盖全国的

sentences.en: The company launched a nationwide marketing campaign to increase brand awareness.
sentences.cn: 该公司启动了一项全国性的行销活动，以提高品牌知名度。

sentences.en: Due to the nationwide delivery service, customers can receive their orders within three business days.
sentences.cn: 由于提供全国性的配送服务，客户可以在三个工作天内收到订单。

trans.tran: 母语；原产地；天生的

sentences.en: The company seeks a native English speaker for the translation project.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找一位母语为英语的人员来负责翻译项目。

sentences.en: The software is designed to support native languages and dialects.
sentences.cn: 该软件旨在支持母语和方言。

trans.tran: 自然的；与生俱来的；不人工的；符合常理的

sentences.en: The company strives to use natural ingredients in its products to appeal to health-conscious consumers.
sentences.cn: 该公司努力在其产品中使用天然成分，以吸引注重健康的消费者。

sentences.en: He naturally excels at public speaking due to his confident demeanor.
sentences.cn: 由于他自信的举止，他天生擅长公开演讲。

trans.tran: 自然地；顺其自然地；本能地

sentences.en: The speaker delivered the presentation naturally, engaging the audience with ease.
sentences.cn: 演讲者自然地发表了演示文稿，轻松地吸引了听众。

sentences.en: He adapted to the new role naturally, quickly becoming a valuable member of the team.
sentences.cn: 他自然地适应了新的职位，迅速成为团队中宝贵的一员。

trans.tran: 自然环境；本质；特性

sentences.en: The company is committed to sustainable practices to minimize its impact on nature.
sentences.cn: 该公司致力于可持续的措施，以最大限度地减少对自然环境的影响。

sentences.en: Understanding the nature of the problem is crucial for developing an effective solution.
sentences.cn: 了解问题的本质对于制定有效的解决方案至关重要。

trans.tran: 肚脐

sentences.en: The baby's navel was still healing.
sentences.cn: 宝宝的肚脐还在愈合。

sentences.en: She has a small scar near her navel.
sentences.cn: 她的肚脐附近有一道小疤痕。

trans.tran: 引导、导航；（透过信息或指示）找到方向或路线

sentences.en: The GPS system helps drivers navigate the city streets efficiently.
sentences.cn: GPS 系统能帮助驾驶者有效地导航城市街道。

sentences.en: To navigate the company's internal website, please use the search bar.
sentences.cn: 为了浏览公司内部网站，请使用搜索栏。

trans.tran: 导航；导航系统；路线规划

sentences.en: The company is investing in advanced navigation systems for its delivery trucks.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在为其货运卡车投资先进的导航系统。

sentences.en: Please navigate to the conference room using the interactive map on the company website.
sentences.cn: 请使用公司网站上的交互地图导航至会议室。

trans.tran: 近的；在附近的；靠近；将近

sentences.en: The new cafe is near my apartment.
sentences.cn: 那间新咖啡厅在我公寓附近。

sentences.en: We are getting near the deadline for the project.
sentences.cn: 我们离项目的截止日期越来越近了。

trans.tran: 附近的；在…附近

sentences.en: The conference room is nearby, just down the hall.
sentences.cn: 会议室就在附近，就在走廊的尽头。

sentences.en: There's a convenient coffee shop nearby for a quick break.
sentences.cn: 附近有一间方便的咖啡店，可以快速休息一下。

trans.tran: 最近的；最接近的

sentences.en: The nearest subway station is just a five-minute walk from the office.
sentences.cn: 最近的地铁站距离办公室只有五分钟的步程。

sentences.en: Could you please direct me to the nearest ATM?
sentences.cn: 请问您能指引我到最近的 ATM 吗？

trans.tran: 即将到来；逼近

sentences.en: The project deadline is nearing, so we need to expedite the remaining tasks.
sentences.cn: 项目截止日期即将到来，因此我们需要加快完成剩余任务。

sentences.en: We are nearing the end of the fiscal year, and the financial report needs to be finalized.
sentences.cn: 我们即将结束财政年度，财务报告需要最终定稿。

trans.tran: 几乎；近乎；接近

sentences.en: The project is nearly complete, and we expect to launch it next week.
sentences.cn: 这个项目几乎完成，我们预计下周将会推出。

sentences.en: The company's revenue was nearly double what it was last year.
sentences.cn: 该公司的营收几乎是去年翻倍。

trans.tran: 整洁的；干净的；巧妙的；整齐的

sentences.en: The presentation slides were very neat and easy to follow.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿投视频非常整洁且易于理解。

sentences.en: She came up with a neat trick to optimize the workflow.
sentences.cn: 她想出一个很巧妙的技巧来优化工作流程。

trans.tran: 整洁地；有条理地

sentences.en: Please arrange the documents neatly on your desk.
sentences.cn: 请将文档整洁地放在您的桌面上。

sentences.en: The report was neatly organized, making it easy to understand.
sentences.cn: 这份报告组织得井井有条，让人很容易理解。

trans.tran: 不一定；不必然；表示某事不一定会发生，但可能发生。

sentences.en: The project timeline is subject to change, and we can't necessarily guarantee completion by the deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目时程可能会有变动，我们不一定能保证在截止日期前完成。

sentences.en: While we strive for customer satisfaction, it's not necessarily the case that every client will be completely happy.
sentences.cn: 虽然我们努力追求客户满意度，但并非所有客户都会完全满意。

trans.tran: 必要的；必需的；不可或缺的

sentences.en: It is necessary to review the contract before signing.
sentences.cn: 签署合约前，审阅文档是必要的。

sentences.en: A valid passport is necessary for international travel.
sentences.cn: 国际旅行需要有效的护照。

trans.tran: 使…成为必要；要求

sentences.en: The new regulations necessitate a complete overhaul of our inventory management system.
sentences.cn: 新的法规要求我们彻底改造库存管理系统。

sentences.en: Increased demand necessitates hiring additional staff to maintain service quality.
sentences.cn: 需求增加，需要雇用更多员工以维持服务品质。

trans.tran: 必需品；必要性；不可或缺的事物

sentences.en: Access to clean water is a basic necessity for human survival.
sentences.cn: 取得干净的水是人类生存的基本必需品。

sentences.en: There's no necessity to rush; we have plenty of time.
sentences.cn: 没有必要赶时间，我们时间充裕。

trans.tran: 颈部；脖子；衣领；细颈部分（如瓶颈）；颈状物；海峡；地峡

sentences.en: She wore a beautiful necklace around her neck.
sentences.cn: 她脖子上戴着一条漂亮的项链。

sentences.en: The collar of his shirt was too tight around his neck.
sentences.cn: 他衬衫的衣领太紧了，勒住了他的脖子。

trans.tran: 项链；珠宝饰品（通常绕颈佩戴）

sentences.en: The jewelry store is offering a discount on necklaces during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 珠宝店在节日期间对项链提供折扣。

sentences.en: She presented the executive with a commemorative necklace as a token of appreciation.
sentences.cn: 她赠送了这位高管一枚纪念项链，以表达感谢之情。

trans.tran: 需要；必需，要求

sentences.en: The project team needs to finalize the budget by the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 项目团队需要在本周结束前完成预算最终定案。

sentences.en: We need to assess the market demand before launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 在推出新产品之前，我们需要评估市场需求。

trans.tran: 针 (用于缝纫、注射、编织等); 指针 (仪器上指示方向或数值的); 针叶树叶; 刺激，惹恼 (动词)

sentences.en: She threaded the needle carefully before starting to sew.
sentences.cn: 她小心翼翼地穿针引线，然后才开始缝纫。

sentences.en: The needle on the pressure gauge slowly rose.
sentences.cn: 压力计上的指针缓慢上升。

trans.tran: 需求；需要（尤指必须满足的需求）

sentences.en: The company's current needs include a new accounting software and additional staff.
sentences.cn: 公司目前的需求包括新的会计软件和额外的员工。

sentences.en: We need to assess the client's needs before proposing a solution.
sentences.cn: 在提出解决方案之前，我们需要评估客户的需求。

trans.tran: 贫困的；生活匮乏的；需要关爱的；黏人的

sentences.en: Many organizations focus on helping needy families during the holidays.
sentences.cn: 许多组织在节日期间专注于帮助贫困家庭。

sentences.en: She can be a bit needy, always asking for attention and reassurance.
sentences.cn: 她可能有点黏人，总是寻求关注和安慰。

trans.tran: 否定；负面的；不赞同的

sentences.en: The company received negative feedback on the new product launch.
sentences.cn: 公司在新产品发布方面收到了负面回馈。

sentences.en: Despite the negative results, the team remains optimistic about future prospects.
sentences.cn: 尽管结果不佳，团队对未来前景仍然乐观。

trans.tran: 负面地；以不利的方式

sentences.en: The report negatively impacted the company's stock price.
sentences.cn: 这份报告对公司的股价产生了负面影响。

sentences.en: He viewed the proposed changes negatively, citing potential disruptions to workflow.
sentences.cn: 他对提出的变更持负面态度，理由是可能扰乱工作流程。

trans.tran: 忽略；遗弃；疏忽处理（责任、义务等）

sentences.en: The company cannot neglect employee training, as it impacts productivity and morale.
sentences.cn: 公司不能忽略员工培训，因为这会影响生产力和士气。

sentences.en: Due to budget cuts, the maintenance department has been forced to neglect essential equipment repairs.
sentences.cn: 由于预算削减，维护部门被迫忽略必要的设备维修。

trans.tran: 疏忽；过失（尤指法律上的过失，未尽到应有的注意或责任）

sentences.en: The company was found guilty of professional negligence.
sentences.cn: 该公司被判犯有专业过失罪。

sentences.en: His negligence in maintaining the equipment led to the accident.
sentences.cn: 他疏于保养设备导致了这场事故。

trans.tran: 可协商的；可谈判的；可转让的

sentences.en: The price of the car is negotiable.
sentences.cn: 这辆车的价格是可以协商的。

sentences.en: All the terms and conditions in the contract are negotiable.
sentences.cn: 合约中的所有条款都可以协商。

trans.tran: 协商；谈判（达成协议或解决争端）

sentences.en: The purchasing manager will negotiate the price with the supplier to secure a better deal.
sentences.cn: 采购经理将与供应商协商价格，以获得更好的交易。

sentences.en: We need to negotiate the terms of the contract before signing it.
sentences.cn: 在签署合约之前，我们需要协商条款。

trans.tran: 协商；谈判（通常指商业或合同条款）

sentences.en: The purchasing manager is negotiating a lower price with the supplier.
sentences.cn: 采购经理正在与供应商协商更低的价格。

sentences.en: We are currently negotiating the terms of the contract with the new vendor.
sentences.cn: 我们目前正在与新供应商协商合约条款。

trans.tran: 协商；谈判，通常指商业或合同条款的讨论和达成一致。

sentences.en: The company is currently in negotiation with its suppliers to secure better prices.
sentences.cn: 该公司目前正在与供应商进行协商，以确保更优惠的价格。

sentences.en: Successful negotiation requires strong communication skills and a willingness to compromise.
sentences.cn: 成功的谈判需要强大的沟通技巧和愿意妥协的意愿。

trans.tran: 谈判；协商，通常指商业或政治上的谈判过程。

sentences.en: The company is currently engaged in negotiations with its suppliers to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 该公司目前正在与供应商进行谈判，以降低成本。

sentences.en: Successful negotiations require patience, flexibility, and a clear understanding of both parties' interests.
sentences.cn: 成功的谈判需要耐心、灵活性以及对双方利益的清晰理解。

trans.tran: 谈判者；协商者

sentences.en: She is a skilled negotiator who always manages to secure favorable deals.
sentences.cn: 她是一位技术娴熟的谈判者，总能确保达成有利的交易。

sentences.en: The company hired a professional negotiator to resolve the labor dispute.
sentences.cn: 该公司聘请了一位专业谈判者来解决劳资纠纷。

trans.tran: 邻居；周边的居民或公司

sentences.en: Our neighbor, a local business owner, offered valuable insights into the market trends.
sentences.cn: 我们一位邻居，一位本地企业主，提供了关于市场趋势的宝贵见解。

sentences.en: The company is committed to being a good neighbor and supporting the local community.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于成为一位好邻居，并支持当地社区。

trans.tran: 社区；周边地区（指居住或工作区域内的邻近环境）

sentences.en: The company is planning to expand its operations into a new neighborhood.
sentences.cn: 公司计划将其业务扩展到一个新的社区。

sentences.en: Our market research indicates a strong demand for our product within this neighborhood.
sentences.cn: 我们的市场调查显示，在这个社区对我们的产品需求强劲。

trans.tran: 邻近的；附近的；与…相邻的

sentences.en: Our company is located in a neighboring office building, just a short walk away.
sentences.cn: 我们公司位于邻近的办公大楼里，步行即可到达。

sentences.en: The neighboring department has agreed to collaborate on this project.
sentences.cn: 邻近部门已同意合作处理这个项目。

trans.tran: 邻居；周边的居民

sentences.en: The company is organizing a community event to foster better relationships with its neighbors.
sentences.cn: 公司正在组织社区活动，以促进与邻居创建更好的关系。

sentences.en: Our neighbors were very helpful when we were relocating our office.
sentences.cn: 当我们搬迁办公室时，我们的邻居非常乐于助人。

trans.tran: 两者都不；既不…也不…；也不

sentences.en: Neither proposal was accepted by the committee.
sentences.cn: 委员会两项提案都未接受。

sentences.en: I don't agree with his decision, and neither does my colleague.
sentences.cn: 我不同意他的决定，我的同事也不同意。

trans.tran: 前缀，表示“新的”、“近代的”或“新兴的”，通常用于构成复合词。

sentences.en: The architect proposed a neo-futuristic design for the new building.
sentences.cn: 建筑师为新大楼提出了一个新未来主义的设计。

sentences.en: Many scholars debate the impact of neoliberal policies on global economies.
sentences.cn: 许多学者就新自由主义政策对全球经济的影响进行辩论。

trans.tran: 神经；勇气，胆量；（常用复数）紧张不安

sentences.en: It takes a lot of nerve to challenge the CEO directly in a meeting.
sentences.cn: 在会议中直接挑战首席执行官需要很大的胆量。

sentences.en: Her nerves were a wreck before the big presentation.
sentences.cn: 在重要的演示文稿前，她非常紧张。

trans.tran: 因紧张或焦虑而感到不安或担心，尤其是在面对重要场合或任务时。

sentences.en: She was nervous about her presentation to the board of directors.
sentences.cn: 她对于向董事会的演示文稿感到紧张。

sentences.en: The candidate answered the interview questions nervously, but he eventually relaxed.
sentences.cn: 这位候选人在回答面试问题时显得紧张，但最后还是放松下来了。

trans.tran: 巢穴；（比喻）稳固的地位或环境

sentences.en: The company is trying to build a stable nest for its employees, offering competitive salaries and benefits.
sentences.cn: 该公司正努力为员工创建稳固的环境，提供具竞争力的薪资和福利。

sentences.en: After years of hard work, she finally built a successful nest for her family.
sentences.cn: 经过多年的辛勤工作，她最终为她的家庭创建了一个成功的事业。

trans.tran: 网络；净值（在商业语境中，通常指网络或互联网）

sentences.en: The company is investing heavily in its online presence to expand its reach across the net.
sentences.cn: 公司正在大力投资其在线存在，以扩展其在网络上的影响力。

sentences.en: Please ensure all data is securely transmitted over the net.
sentences.cn: 请确保所有数据透过网络安全传输。

trans.tran: 网络桥接器，一种连接不同网络区域的硬件设备，允许数据在网络之间流动。

sentences.en: Our IT department is installing a netbridge to improve network connectivity between the sales and marketing teams.
sentences.cn: 我们的 IT 部门正在安装网络桥接器，以改善销售和行销团队之间的网络连接。

sentences.en: The network administrator confirmed that the faulty netbridge was causing intermittent connection issues.
sentences.cn: 网络管理员确认，有问题的网络桥接器导致了间歇性的连接问题。

trans.tran: 网络；联系系统（指企业内部或外部的信息传输和沟通系统）

sentences.en: Our company is expanding its network of international partners to increase market share.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在扩展其国际合作伙伴网络，以提高市场占有率。

sentences.en: The IT department is responsible for maintaining the company's computer network.
sentences.cn: 信息技术部门负责维护公司的电脑网络。

trans.tran: 创建和维护人脉关系，以促进职业发展或达成业务目标。

sentences.en: Attending industry conferences is a great way to network with potential clients and partners.
sentences.cn: 参加行业会议是与潜在客户和合作伙伴创建人脉的好方法。

sentences.en: She's actively networking to expand her professional connections and explore new job opportunities.
sentences.cn: 她正积极创建人脉，以扩展她的专业联系并探索新的就业机会。

trans.tran: 神经的；神经系统的

sentences.en: Scientists are studying the neural pathways involved in memory formation.
sentences.cn: 科学家正在研究记忆形成中涉及的神经通路。

sentences.en: The company uses neural networks for advanced image recognition.
sentences.cn: 该公司利用神经网络进行高级图像辨识。

trans.tran: 神经元

sentences.en: A neuron transmits electrical and chemical signals throughout the body.
sentences.cn: 神经元在全身传递电气和化学信号。

sentences.en: In artificial intelligence, a neural network is inspired by the structure of neurons in the brain.
sentences.cn: 在人工智能中，神经网络的灵感来自于大脑中神经元的结构。

trans.tran: 中立的；不偏袒的；没有明显立场的

sentences.en: The mediator tried to remain neutral during the negotiation.
sentences.cn: 调解人在谈判过程中试图保持中立。

sentences.en: The company released a neutral statement regarding the ongoing dispute.
sentences.cn: 公司就持续的争议发布了一份中立声明。

trans.tran: 中立立场；不偏袒的态度或政策

sentences.en: The company declared neutrality in the dispute between its suppliers.
sentences.cn: 公司在供应商之间的争端中宣布保持中立。

sentences.en: Maintaining neutrality is crucial for a mediator to facilitate a fair resolution.
sentences.cn: 保持中立对于调解人促成公平解决方案至关重要。

trans.tran: 中和；消除（影响、效果等）；使无效

sentences.en: The company implemented a crisis management plan to neutralize the negative publicity.
sentences.cn: 该公司实施了危机管理计划，以中和负面新闻。

sentences.en: The new software update aims to neutralize any security vulnerabilities.
sentences.cn: 新的软件更新旨在消除任何安全漏洞。

trans.tran: 从不;绝不;永不

sentences.en: I never thought I would get this opportunity.
sentences.cn: 我从未想过我会得到这个机会。

sentences.en: She said she would never betray her team.
sentences.cn: 她说她绝不会背叛她的团队。

trans.tran: 尽管如此；然而；不过；仍然

sentences.en: The task was difficult; nevertheless, we managed to complete it on time.
sentences.cn: 这项任务很困难；尽管如此，我们还是设法按时完成了。

sentences.en: She was very tired, nevertheless she continued working until late.
sentences.cn: 她非常累，然而她仍然工作到很晚。

trans.tran: 新的；初次的；最近的

sentences.en: We need to develop new strategies to improve sales.
sentences.cn: 我们需要制定新策略来提升销售额。

sentences.en: The company is launching a new product next month.
sentences.cn: 公司下个月将推出新产品。

trans.tran: 新进员工/成员；新来者

sentences.en: The company is offering a comprehensive onboarding program for all newcomers.
sentences.cn: 公司为所有新进员工提供全面的入职培训计划。

sentences.en: As a newcomer to the team, please don't hesitate to ask for assistance.
sentences.cn: 身为团队的新成员，如有任何需要，请随时提出。

trans.tran: 新近的；刚开始的；最近才有的

sentences.en: The company is implementing a newly developed software to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在导入新开发的软件以提高效率。

sentences.en: The marketing team is focusing on newly launched products to boost sales.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正专注于刚上市的新产品以提升销售额。

trans.tran: 新闻；消息（尤指最近发生的重要事件）

sentences.en: The company announced the merger in the latest news release.
sentences.cn: 公司在最新的新闻稿中宣布了合并。

sentences.en: Stay informed about industry news to keep your business competitive.
sentences.cn: 为了保持竞争力，请随时关注行业新闻。

trans.tran: 定期发行的电子邮件，通常包含公司或组织的最新信息、产品更新、活动公告等，用于与客户、合作伙伴或员工保持联系。

sentences.en: The marketing team is preparing the monthly newsletter to announce the new product launch.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在准备每月电子报，以公告新产品的上市。

sentences.en: Subscribers can opt-in or opt-out of receiving our company newsletter.
sentences.cn: 订阅者可以选择订阅或取消订阅我们公司的电子报。

trans.tran: 报纸；新闻报导

sentences.en: The company's announcement was featured prominently in the business newspapers.
sentences.cn: 该公司的公告在商业报纸上刊登了显著的位置。

sentences.en: Please review the latest newspapers for any relevant industry trends.
sentences.cn: 请查阅最新的报纸，了解任何相关的行业趋势。

trans.tran: 报纸；新闻报导（通常指定期发行的印刷品）

sentences.en: The company distributes newspapers to all employees every morning to keep them updated on industry news.
sentences.cn: 为了让员工随时掌握产业新闻，公司每天早上都会向所有员工发放报纸。

sentences.en: According to the newspapers, the merger is expected to be finalized by the end of the quarter.
sentences.cn: 根据报纸的报导，这项合并预计将在季末完成。

trans.tran: 报刊摊；杂志贩售点

sentences.en: I stopped by the newsstand to pick up a copy of the latest business journal.
sentences.cn: 我顺道在报刊摊上买了一份最新的商业杂志。

sentences.en: The company decided to place promotional flyers at the newsstand near the office building.
sentences.cn: 公司决定在办公大楼附近的报刊摊上放置宣传传单。

trans.tran: 牛顿（单位）：国际标准制中表示力的基本单位，在工程、科学和商业领域常用于衡量重量和力。

sentences.en: The product's weight is 5 kilograms, which is approximately 49 newtons.
sentences.cn: 该产品的重量为 5 公斤，大约是 49 牛顿。

sentences.en: Engineers must ensure the bridge can withstand a force of at least 10,000 newtons.
sentences.cn: 工程师必须确保桥梁能够承受至少 10,000 牛顿的力。

trans.tran: 下一个；接下来的；然后；接着

sentences.en: Our next meeting is scheduled for Tuesday.
sentences.cn: 我们下一次会议订于周二。

sentences.en: Please tell me what to do next.
sentences.cn: 请告诉我接下来该做什么。

trans.tran: 友善的；令人愉快的；（态度、行为等）令人满意的

sentences.en: The staff were very nice and helpful during our business trip.
sentences.cn: 在我们这次商务旅行中，员工非常友善且乐于助人。

sentences.en: It's nice to hear that the negotiations are progressing smoothly.
sentences.cn: 听到谈判顺利进行，真是令人愉快。

trans.tran: 外表吸引人、令人愉悦的；具有良好视觉效果的。

sentences.en: The new product packaging is very nice-looking and is expected to attract more customers.
sentences.cn: 新款产品包装非常吸引人，预计将吸引更多客户。

sentences.en: The hotel's lobby is nice-looking and creates a positive first impression on guests.
sentences.cn: 饭店的接待大厅外观雅致，给客人留下良好的第一印象。

trans.tran: 友善地、礼貌地、得体地

sentences.en: Could you please handle this matter nicely and resolve the customer's complaint?
sentences.cn: 请您友善地处理此事，并解决客户的投诉。

sentences.en: The team worked nicely together to complete the project ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 团队合作得体，成功地提前完成了项目。

trans.tran: 利基；专门市场

sentences.en: The startup found its niche by specializing in sustainable packaging solutions.
sentences.cn: 这家新创公司透过专精于永续包装解决方案找到了niche。

sentences.en: Our company dominates the luxury niche market with premium product offerings.
sentences.cn: 我们公司以优质产品在奢侈品niche市场占主导地位。

trans.tran: （俚语）小偷；盗手；（口语）轻微的损失或缺口

sentences.cn: 由于意外的维护成本，公司利润受到轻微的损失。

sentences.en: Security cameras were installed to prevent employees from nicking office supplies.
sentences.cn: 安装了安全摄影机以防止员工盗用办公用品。

sentences.cn: 夜晚星星闪耀。

sentences.cn: 我通常每晚睡前都会读一本书。

sentences.en: Our marketing campaign aims to attract a younger demographic to the nightclub.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销活动旨在吸引年轻族群到夜总会。

sentences.en: The hotel's nightclub is a popular destination for tourists and locals alike.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店的夜总会是游客和当地居民的热门去处。

trans.tran: 傍晚；黄昏，指天色渐暗的时刻，通常指工作结束或交通量减少的时间。

sentences.en: Due to nightfall, the delivery schedule will be adjusted to ensure driver safety.
sentences.cn: 由于黄昏将至，为了确保司机安全，将调整送货时间表。

sentences.en: The security team increased patrols at nightfall to prevent any potential incidents.
sentences.cn: 为了防止任何潜在事件发生，保全人员在黄昏时加强巡逻。

trans.tran: 夜生活，指夜晚的娱乐活动，通常与酒吧、俱乐部、餐厅等场所相关。

sentences.en: The city is known for its vibrant nightlife, attracting tourists from around the world.
sentences.cn: 这座城市以其热闹的夜生活而闻名，吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

sentences.en: Our hotel offers shuttle services to popular nightlife destinations in the downtown area.
sentences.cn: 我们的酒店提供前往市中心热门夜生活景点的接驳服务。

trans.tran: 夜晚；夜间（多指连续的夜晚）

sentences.en: Due to the power outage, we had to work late into the nights to meet the deadline.
sentences.cn: 由于停电，我们不得不工作到深夜才能赶上截止日期。

sentences.en: The security team conducts routine patrols throughout the nights to ensure the safety of the building.
sentences.cn: 保全人员在夜间进行例行巡逻，以确保大楼的安全。

trans.tran: 尼罗斯河（埃及的主要河流）; (比喻) 漫长而艰难的过程

sentences.en: The company is planning a corporate retreat along the Nile River.
sentences.cn: 公司正在计划在尼罗河沿岸举办一场企业团建活动。

sentences.en: Negotiating this contract has been like navigating the Nile – a long and winding process.
sentences.cn: 谈判这份合约就像航行尼罗河一样，是一个漫长而曲折的过程。

trans.tran: 零；无（指数量或金额）

sentences.cn: 报告显示，由于 непредвиденные 费用，本季利润为零。

sentences.cn: 会计部门确认客户的未付余额为零。

sentences.en: The applicant's nimble fingers and quick reflexes made her ideal for the data entry position.
sentences.cn: 这位应征者的灵巧手指和快速反应，使她非常适合数据输入职位。

sentences.en: To keep up with the fast-paced market, our team needs to be nimble and adaptable.
sentences.cn: 为了跟上快速变化的市场，我们的团队需要灵活且具适应性。

trans.tran: 九

sentences.en: The office opens at nine in the morning.
sentences.cn: 办公室早上九点开门。

sentences.en: There are nine employees working on this project.
sentences.cn: 有九位员工正在处理这个项目。

trans.tran: 十九

sentences.cn: 班上有十九位学生。

sentences.en: He will turn nineteen next month.
sentences.cn: 他下个月就满十九岁了。

trans.tran: 九十

sentences.cn: 该公司本季报告了九十个新的销售线索。

sentences.en: More than ninety participants registered for the webinar.
sentences.cn: 超过九十名参与者报名参加了网络研讨会。

trans.tran: 氮

sentences.cn: 氮气约占地球大气层的78%。

sentences.en: Liquid nitrogen is used in many industrial processes, including freezing and cooling.
sentences.cn: 液态氮用于许多任务业过程，包括冷冻和冷却。

trans.tran: 不，没有；一点儿也不；否；否决票

sentences.en: There is no doubt that the project will be successful.
sentences.cn: 毫无疑问，这个项目将会成功。

sentences.en: No, I haven't finished the report yet.
sentences.cn: 不，我还没有完成报告。

trans.tran: 高尚的; 贵族的; 崇高的

sentences.en: It was a noble effort to establish a scholarship fund for underprivileged students.
sentences.cn: 为贫困学生设立奖学金基金是一项崇高的努力。

sentences.en: The architect chose noble materials like marble and oak for the building's interior.
sentences.cn: 建筑师为建筑内部选用了大理石和橡木等高贵材料。

trans.tran: 没有人； niemand

sentences.en: Nobody attended the optional training session.
sentences.cn: 没有人参加了这场可选的培训课程。

sentences.en: Nobody knows the exact details of the contract negotiations.
sentences.cn: 没有人知道合约谈判的确切细节。

trans.tran: 节点；结；重要交会点

sentences.en: Each computer in the network acts as a node, exchanging data with other devices.
sentences.cn: 网络中的每台电脑都作为一个节点，与其他设备交换数据。

sentences.en: The central office serves as a crucial node for all regional operations.
sentences.cn: 中心办公室是所有区域营运的关键节点。

trans.tran: 不留下痕迹；隐匿行踪（通常指数字或环境影响）

sentences.en: The company aims to operate a nofootprint data center, minimizing its environmental impact.
sentences.cn: 该公司旨在运营一个不留下痕迹的数据中心，最大限度地减少其环境影响。

sentences.en: We need a nofootprint solution for tracking user activity to ensure privacy compliance.
sentences.cn: 我们需要一种不留下痕迹的解决方案来追踪用户活动，以确保隐私合规性。

trans.tran: 噪音；干扰声，尤其指不悦耳或令人分心的声音。

sentences.en: The construction noise outside the office is disrupting our concentration.
sentences.cn: 办公室外施工的噪音正在影响我们的专注力。

sentences.en: Please keep the noise level down during the conference call.
sentences.cn: 请在电话会议期间降低噪音。

trans.tran: 喧闹的；嘈杂的，指声音过大或过多，造成干扰。

sentences.en: The open-plan office can be quite noisy during peak hours.
sentences.cn: 开放式办公室在尖峰时段可能会非常嘈杂。

sentences.en: We need to find a quieter location for the conference call to avoid a noisy environment.
sentences.cn: 为了避免嘈杂的环境，我们需要找到一个更安静的会议地点。

sentences.en: The company only charges a nominal fee for the software upgrade.
sentences.cn: 公司对于软件升级仅收取象征性的费用。

sentences.en: The nominal value of the bond is $1,000, but its market value fluctuates.
sentences.cn: 该债券的面额为1,000美元，但其市场价值会波动。

trans.tran: 提名；推荐（某人担任某职位或参与某项活动）

sentences.en: The board of directors will nominate a new CEO next month.
sentences.cn: 董事会将下个月提名一位新的首席执行官。

sentences.en: Our team is nominating Sarah for the employee of the year award.
sentences.cn: 我们团队正在提名莎拉获得年度员工奖。

trans.tran: 提名；推荐（某人或某事物以供选拔或考虑）

sentences.en: The company is accepting nominations for the 'Employee of the Year' award.
sentences.cn: 公司正在接受“年度员工”奖项的提名。

sentences.en: Several candidates were put forward for nomination to the board of directors.
sentences.cn: 有多位候选人被提名进入董事会。

trans.tran: 不；没有；否定的

sentences.en: The company has a non-disclosure agreement for all employees.
sentences.cn: 公司所有员工都有签订保密协议。

sentences.en: This is a non-refundable deposit.
sentences.cn: 这是一笔不可退还的订金。

trans.tran: 没有；无；不存在

sentences.cn: 下周的培训课程没有任何空位。

sentences.en: We have none of the requested documents on file at this time.
sentences.cn: 目前我们没有任何要求的文档。

sentences.en: The company policy strictly prohibits any behavior that could offend our clients.
sentences.cn: 公司政策严禁任何可能冒犯我们客户的行为。

trans.tran: 冒犯；得罪；罪行；违法行为；攻击；进攻

sentences.en: I apologize if I caused any offense with my remarks.
sentences.cn: 如果我的言论造成任何冒犯，我深感抱歉。

sentences.en: Driving under the influence is a serious offense.
sentences.cn: 酒驾是一种严重的罪行。

trans.tran: 冒犯的；令人不快的；攻击性的；攻势

sentences.en: His remarks were widely regarded as highly offensive.
sentences.cn: 他的言论被普遍认为极具冒犯性。

sentences.en: The army launched a major offensive against enemy positions.
sentences.cn: 军队对敌方阵地发起了一次大规模攻势。

trans.tran: 提供；提出（建议、方案等）；报价

sentences.en: The supplier offered a 10% discount on the bulk order.
sentences.cn: 供应商为批量订单提供了 10% 的折扣。

sentences.en: We would like to offer our services to assist your company with the project.
sentences.cn: 我们想提供我们的服务来协助贵公司处理这个项目。

trans.tran: 提供；提出（建议、机会等）

sentences.en: The company offered a special discount to attract new customers.
sentences.cn: 为了吸引新客户，公司提供了一项特别折扣。

sentences.en: We offered our services at a competitive rate to secure the contract.
sentences.cn: 为了签订合约，我们以具竞争力的价格提供了我们的服务。

trans.tran: 提供、赠送（商品或服务），通常带有商业或促销目的。

sentences.en: The company is offering a 20% discount on all products during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 公司在节日期间为所有产品提供 20% 的折扣。

sentences.en: We appreciate the generous offering of support from our partners.
sentences.cn: 我们感谢来自合作伙伴的慷慨支持。

trans.tran: 供品；提供的服务或产品（通常指为了吸引顾客或提升价值）

sentences.en: Our company's diverse offerings cater to a wide range of client needs.
sentences.cn: 我们公司的多元产品组合能满足广泛的客户需求。

sentences.en: The hotel is enhancing its offerings with a new spa and fitness center to attract more guests.
sentences.cn: 为了吸引更多客人，饭店正在扩展其服务，包括新的水疗中心和健身中心。

trans.tran: 提供（服务、产品、优惠等），提出（建议、方案等）

sentences.en: The company offers a wide range of financial products to meet diverse customer needs.
sentences.cn: 该公司提供多种金融产品，以满足不同客户的需求。

sentences.en: We offer a special discount for bulk orders placed before the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 我们为月底前下的批量订单提供特别折扣。

trans.tran: 办公室；公司事务所

sentences.en: The meeting will be held in the conference room on the third floor of the office.
sentences.cn: 会议将在办公室三楼的会议室举行。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense reports to the accounting office by the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 请在月底前将您的费用报销单提交到会计部门。

trans.tran: 官员；公司内负责特定职务或部门的高级主管，负责运行与管理相关事务。

sentences.en: The company's compliance officer will review the new regulations next week.
sentences.cn: 公司合规官将于下周审查新法规。

sentences.en: Please forward the report to the finance officer for final approval.
sentences.cn: 请将报告转交财务官以获得最终批准。

trans.tran: 办公室；公司总部

sentences.en: The company is expanding and plans to open new offices in several major cities.
sentences.cn: 公司正在扩张，并计划在几个主要城市开设新的办公室。

sentences.en: Employees are responsible for maintaining a clean and organized workspace in the offices.
sentences.cn: 员工有责任保持办公室的清洁和整洁。

trans.tran: 正式的；官方的；具备法律或机构授权的；（名词）官员、官方人员

sentences.en: The official report will be submitted to the board by Friday.
sentences.cn: 正式报告将于周五提交给董事会。

sentences.en: Please contact the company’s official representative for any contract negotiations.
sentences.cn: 如需进行合约谈判，请联系公司的官方代表。

trans.tran: 正式地；依照规定地

sentences.en: The company announced the merger officially through a press release.
sentences.cn: 公司已透过新闻稿正式宣布合并。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense reports officially through the online portal.
sentences.cn: 请透过在线入口正式提交您的费用报销单。

trans.tran: 官员；官方代表；主管人员

sentences.en: Company officials announced a new policy regarding remote work.
sentences.cn: 公司主管宣布了一项关于远程工作的新规政策。

sentences.en: Customs officials inspected the shipment to ensure compliance with import regulations.
sentences.cn: 海关人员检查了这批货物，以确保符合进口法规。

trans.tran: 主持（仪式、比赛等）；担任裁判

sentences.en: The senior manager will officiate at the opening ceremony of the new branch.
sentences.cn: 资深经理将主持新分行的开幕典礼。

sentences.en: The experienced referee officiated the championship game fairly and impartially.
sentences.cn: 这位经验丰富的裁判公平公正地主持了冠军赛。

trans.tran: 卸载；将任务或责任转移给他人处理

sentences.en: The manager decided to offload some of his responsibilities to his assistant to reduce his workload.
sentences.cn: 经理决定将部分责任转给他的助理，以减轻他的工作量。

sentences.en: The company is offloading outdated inventory to make room for new products.
sentences.cn: 公司正在清理过时的库存，以腾出空间存放新产品。

trans.tran: 抵消；补偿；（时间、空间等）偏移

sentences.en: The company implemented a carbon offset program to reduce its environmental impact.
sentences.cn: 该公司实施了碳抵消计划，以减少其对环境的影响。

sentences.en: The deadline was offset by a week due to the unexpected system outage.
sentences.cn: 由于意外的系统中断，截止日期被延迟了一周。

trans.tran: 离岸的；国外的；海外的 (adj.)；向海外 (adv.)。常用于商业语境中指将业务、生产或资金转移到国外。

sentences.en: Many companies are moving their manufacturing operations offshore to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 许多公司将其制造业务转移到海外以降低成本。

sentences.en: The bank offers a range of offshore investment accounts.
sentences.cn: 这家银行提供多种离岸投资帐户。

trans.tran: 后代; 子孙; 幼兽; (常作复数)产物; 结果

sentences.en: The company's new product is the offspring of years of research and development.
sentences.cn: 该公司的新产品是多年研发的成果。

sentences.en: Many animals protect their offspring fiercely.
sentences.cn: 许多动物会极力保护牠们的后代。

trans.tran: 频繁地；经常地（表示某事发生的次数较多）

sentences.en: The manager often checks the sales reports to monitor performance.
sentences.cn: 经理经常检查销售报告以监控绩效。

sentences.en: We often collaborate with our partners to develop new products.
sentences.cn: 我们经常与合作伙伴合作开发新产品。

trans.tran: 石油；润滑油

sentences.en: The company is exploring alternative energy sources to reduce its reliance on oil.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在探索替代能源，以减少对石油的依赖。

sentences.en: Ensure the machinery is regularly lubricated with the correct type of oil to prevent breakdowns.
sentences.cn: 确保机器定期使用正确类型的润滑油润滑，以防止故障。

trans.tran: 奥卡福 (Okafor) 通常指尼日尔利亚的姓氏，在商务情境中可能指某位来自尼日尔利亚的商业伙伴、员工或客户。

sentences.en: Mr. Okafor from our Lagos office will be leading the negotiations.
sentences.cn: 来自我们拉各斯办公室的奥卡福先生将负责协商。

sentences.en: Please send the contract to Mr. Okafor for his review and signature.
sentences.cn: 请将合约发送给奥卡福先生审阅并签署。

trans.tran: 表示同意、接受或满意。亦可指事情顺利、没问题，或指身体状况良好。作为动词时，表示许可或批准。

sentences.en: Is it okay if I leave work early today?
sentences.cn: 我今天可以早点下班吗？

sentences.en: The manager okayed the new project proposal.
sentences.cn: 经理批准了新的项目企划书。

trans.tran: 老的；旧的；年老的；古老的；以前的

sentences.en: My car is very old, so I'm thinking of buying a new one.
sentences.cn: 我的车很旧了，所以我正考虑买一辆新的。

sentences.en: He is an old friend from college.
sentences.cn: 他是大学时代的老朋友。

trans.tran: 橄榄（果实或油）；（比喻）和解的橄榄枝

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a selection of appetizers, including marinated olives and bruschetta.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种开胃菜，包括腌制橄榄和烤面包。

sentences.en: The company is extending an olive branch to its competitor by proposing a joint venture.
sentences.cn: 该公司通过提议合资企业向其竞争对手伸出了和解之橄榄枝。

trans.tran: 希腊字母的最后一个字；事物的终结或最终阶段；最终点

sentences.en: From alpha to omega, the comprehensive report covered every aspect of the market.
sentences.cn: 从头到尾，这份综合报告涵盖了市场的各个方面。

sentences.en: Many consider the successful product launch to be the omega of years of hard work and dedication.
sentences.cn: 许多人认为产品的成功发布是多年努力和奉献的最终成果。

trans.tran: 征兆；预兆（通常指不祥的或暗示未来事件的信号）

sentences.en: The sudden drop in sales figures served as an ominous omen for the company's future.
sentences.cn: 销售数字的突然下降对公司的未来发出了一个不祥的征兆。

sentences.en: Despite the positive market trends, the project manager felt a sense of foreboding, viewing it as a bad omen for the launch.
sentences.cn: 尽管市场趋势积极，项目经理仍然感到一种不祥的预感，认为这是一个对发布的坏征兆。

trans.tran: 遗漏；省略（指未包含或未提及的事物）

sentences.en: The report contained several omissions that needed to be corrected before submission.
sentences.cn: 这份报告包含几个遗漏，在提交前需要更正。

sentences.en: Due to an omission in the contract, the company is liable for additional expenses.
sentences.cn: 由于合约中遗漏了某些条款，公司需要承担额外的费用。

trans.tran: 遗漏、疏漏（指未包含或未提及的事项）

sentences.en: The report contained several omissions that needed to be corrected before submission.
sentences.cn: 报告中包含几个疏漏，需要在提交前进行修正。

sentences.en: Due to oversight, there were some omissions in the inventory list.
sentences.cn: 由于疏忽，库存清单上有一些遗漏。

trans.tran: 省略

sentences.en: We need to omit this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细省略。

sentences.en: The omit is important for success.
sentences.cn: 省略对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 在现场的；在工作地点的

sentences.en: The technician will be on-site tomorrow to repair the equipment.
sentences.cn: 技术人员明天会在现场维修设备。

sentences.en: We require an on-site inspection before finalizing the contract.
sentences.cn: 在签订合约之前，我们需要进行现场检查。

trans.tran: 曾经；一度；一旦

sentences.en: The project manager mentioned that the budget might need to be adjusted once the final report is reviewed.
sentences.cn: 项目经理提到，一旦审阅最终报告，预算可能需要调整。

sentences.en: Once a month, the team holds a meeting to discuss progress and address any challenges.
sentences.cn: 团队每个月召开一次会议，以讨论进展并解决任何挑战。

trans.tran: 一;一个;单一的;某一;独一无二的;人称代词:一个人;数字“一”;同类人或物中的一个

sentences.en: We need to address this issue as one team.
sentences.cn: 我们需要以一个团队的姿态解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Can I have one of those reports, please?
sentences.cn: 我能拿一份那些报告吗？

trans.tran: 指代先前提及的特定人或物，表示‘那些’或‘这些’的意思。

sentences.en: Please review the ones marked in red and send your feedback by Friday.
sentences.cn: 请检查标记为红色的那些项目，并于星期五前回复您的意见。

sentences.en: The ones that were delayed will be shipped out tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 那些延迟的货物将于明天发货。

trans.tran: 持续进行的；正在进行的

sentences.en: The project is still ongoing and expected to be completed by the end of the year.
sentences.cn: 这个项目仍在进行中，预计会在年底前完成。

sentences.en: We are currently reviewing the ongoing negotiations with the supplier.
sentences.cn: 我们目前正在审查与供应商的持续进行的谈判。

trans.tran: 洋葱，一种常用于烹饪的蔬菜，也指洋葱的气味或味道。

sentences.en: The chef requested a large quantity of onions for the soup.
sentences.cn: 厨师要求大量的洋葱来制作汤品。

sentences.en: The restaurant's signature dish features caramelized onions and a balsamic glaze.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅的招牌菜以焦糖洋葱和巴萨米克釉为特色。

trans.tran: 洋葱，一种常见的蔬菜，常用于烹饪和调味。

sentences.en: The restaurant uses fresh onions in all of their signature dishes.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅在所有招牌菜肴中都使用新鲜洋葱。

sentences.en: Could you please add onions to my salad? I'd like a bit more flavor.
sentences.cn: 请问可以帮我加点洋葱到沙拉里吗？我想让它更有味道。

trans.tran: 透过网络连接的；在网络上进行的

sentences.en: Our company offers online training courses for all employees.
sentences.cn: 我们公司为所有员工提供在线培训课程。

sentences.en: The meeting was held online due to travel restrictions.
sentences.cn: 由于旅行限制，会议是在网上举行的。

trans.tran: 唯一的；仅仅；只

sentences.en: She was the only person to arrive on time for the meeting.
sentences.cn: 她是唯一准时参加会议的人。

sentences.en: We only have five minutes left to finish the report.
sentences.cn: 我们只剩下五分钟完成这份报告了。

trans.tran: 在屏幕上显示的；在屏幕上的

sentences.en: The presentation will be displayed onscreen for the audience to follow.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿将在屏幕上显示，以便观众能跟上。

sentences.en: Please ensure all data is onscreen before starting the meeting.
sentences.cn: 请确保会议开始前所有数据都在屏幕上显示。

trans.tran: (疾病、不愉快事情的)发作；开始；开端

sentences.en: The new medication helps to prevent the onset of symptoms.
sentences.cn: 这种新药有助于预防症状的发作。

sentences.en: At the onset of the project, we established clear goals.
sentences.cn: 在项目开始之际，我们就确立了明确的目标。

trans.tran: 到...上面；到...之上

sentences.en: She stepped onto the stage to accept her award.
sentences.cn: 她踏上舞台领取她的奖项。

sentences.en: The cat jumped onto the table.
sentences.cn: 那只猫跳到桌子上。

trans.tran: 向前地；从某时起；从某处起

sentences.en: The office will be open from Monday onwards.
sentences.cn: 办公室将从周一开始营业。

sentences.en: From this point onwards, we will focus on the next phase of the project.
sentences.cn: 从此刻起，我们将专注于项目的下一个阶段。

trans.tran: 表示惊讶、喜悦、痛苦或兴奋的感叹词。

sentences.en: Ooh, that's a beautiful dress!
sentences.cn: 噢，那件洋装真漂亮！

sentences.en: The crowd oohed and aahed at the fireworks.
sentences.cn: 人群对烟火发出喔喔和啊啊的赞叹声。

trans.tran: 打开；开放；打开；可用的

sentences.en: The manager decided to open the new branch office downtown.
sentences.cn: 经理决定在市中心开设新的分公司。

sentences.en: The application process is open to all qualified candidates.
sentences.cn: 申请进程对所有合格的候选人开放。

trans.tran: 打开；打开

sentences.en: The manager opened the meeting with a brief overview of the quarterly results.
sentences.cn: 经理以简要介绍季度业绩为开场，打开了会议。

sentences.en: Please ensure all files are opened and reviewed before submitting your report.
sentences.cn: 请确保提交报告前，所有文件都已打开并审阅。

trans.tran: 开瓶器；开罐器；启封工具；（系列活动、比赛等的）第一场；开场白；开幕词

sentences.en: He used a can opener to open the tuna.
sentences.cn: 他用开罐器打开鲔鱼罐头。

sentences.en: The first game of the season is often called the season opener.
sentences.cn: 赛季的第一场比赛通常被称为赛季开幕战。

trans.tran: 开端、开业、开放（商店、活动等）

sentences.en: The company is planning a grand opening ceremony for its new branch.
sentences.cn: 公司正在为其新分店策划一个盛大的开业典礼。

sentences.en: We are looking for an opening to discuss the contract terms with the supplier.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找一个机会与供应商讨论合约条款。

trans.tran: 机会；空缺；开放性

sentences.en: The company is currently advertising several openings for marketing specialists.
sentences.cn: 公司目前正在招募多个行销专员的职位空缺。

sentences.en: We need to explore new market openings to increase our sales revenue.
sentences.cn: 我们需要探索新的市场机会以增加销售额。

trans.tran: 公开地；坦率地；不加掩饰地

sentences.en: The CEO addressed the concerns of the employees openly and honestly.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官坦率且诚实地向员工们表达了关切。

sentences.en: The company policy encourages employees to discuss potential issues openly with their supervisors.
sentences.cn: 公司政策鼓励员工与主管公开讨论潜在问题。

trans.tran: 打开；打开（指门窗、系统等）

sentences.en: The conference room opens at 7:30 AM for early arrivals.
sentences.cn: 会议室在早上 7:30 开放，方便提早抵达的人。

sentences.en: Please ensure the new software opens quickly to avoid delays in the workflow.
sentences.cn: 请确保新软件快速打开，以避免工作流程延迟。

trans.tran: 歌剧；歌剧表演

sentences.en: The company is sponsoring a local opera production to enhance its brand image.
sentences.cn: 公司赞助当地歌剧团的演出，以提升品牌形象。

sentences.en: Many tourists choose to attend an opera performance during their visit to Italy.
sentences.cn: 许多游客在访问意大利时选择观看歌剧表演。

trans.tran: 操作；运行；运营

sentences.en: The new software system is designed to operate efficiently with minimal human intervention.
sentences.cn: 这个新的软件系统设计用于在最小的人工干预下高效运作。

sentences.en: The company plans to operate a new branch in the city center next quarter.
sentences.cn: 公司计划在下个季度在市中心开设一家新分店。

trans.tran: 运作；运行；营运

sentences.en: The company operates several factories in China to reduce production costs.
sentences.cn: 为了降低生产成本，该公司在中国运营多家工厂。

sentences.en: The new software operates smoothly and efficiently, improving overall productivity.
sentences.cn: 新的软件运作流畅且高效，提高了整体生产力。

trans.tran: 运作、运行、营运（指系统、设备、流程等），或指正在进行的活动。

sentences.en: The company is operating at full capacity to meet the increased demand.
sentences.cn: 为了满足日益增加的需求，公司正在全功率运作。

sentences.en: The operating system needs to be updated regularly for security reasons.
sentences.cn: 为了安全起见，操作系统需要定期更新。

trans.tran: 营运、作业、手术（指公司或组织的日常活动或流程）

sentences.en: The company is undergoing a major operational restructuring to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在进行重大的营运重组以提高效率。

sentences.en: The new software will automate many of the manual operations in the warehouse.
sentences.cn: 新软件将自动化仓库中的许多手动作业。

trans.tran: 可运作的；营运中的；有效的

sentences.en: The new software system is now operational and ready for employee training.
sentences.cn: 新软件系统现在已可运作，并已准备好供员工培训。

sentences.en: We need to ensure all equipment is operational before the factory resumes production.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在工厂恢复生产之前，确保所有设备都可运作。

trans.tran: 营运、作业、业务流程

sentences.en: The company is streamlining its operations to reduce costs.
