trans.tran: 其他的; 另外的; 别的

sentences.en: Do you have any other questions or concerns?
sentences.cn: 你还有其他问题或疑虑吗？

sentences.en: Some employees prefer to work from home, while others prefer to be in the office.
sentences.cn: 有些员工喜欢在家工作，而另一些则喜欢在办公室里工作。

trans.tran: 其他人；其余的人

sentences.en: We need to gather feedback from all employees, including those working remotely.
sentences.cn: 我们需要收集所有员工的回馈，包括远程工作的员工。

sentences.en: The company is offering training to help others improve their skills.
sentences.cn: 公司提供培训，以帮助其他人提升技能。

trans.tran: 否则；不然；如果没有...

sentences.en: The project will be delayed if we don't receive the necessary documents by Friday; otherwise, we can proceed as planned.
sentences.cn: 如果我们在周五前没有收到必要的文档，项目将会延迟；否则，我们可以按照原计划进行。

sentences.en: Please double-check all figures; otherwise, the financial report will be inaccurate.
sentences.cn: 请仔细核对所有数字；否则，财务报告将不准确。

trans.tran: （表示义务或建议）应该，理应

sentences.en: You ought to submit your expense report by the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 您应该在本周末前提交您的费用报表。

sentences.en: We ought to consider alternative suppliers to mitigate risk.
sentences.cn: 我们理应考虑替代供应商以降低风险。

trans.tran: 盎司（重量单位，约等于28克）；少量

sentences.en: The recipe calls for eight ounces of flour.
sentences.cn: 这个食谱需要八盎司的面粉。

sentences.en: She only managed to drink an ounce or two of water.
sentences.cn: 她只喝了一两盎司的水。

trans.tran: 我们自己；我们自身（强调主语是我们自己）

sentences.en: We need to review our procedures to ensure we are meeting all regulatory requirements ourselves.
sentences.cn: 我们需要审查我们的流程，以确保我们自己符合所有法规要求。

sentences.en: The team decided to handle the project themselves to maintain quality control.
sentences.cn: 团队决定自行处理项目，以维持品质控制。

trans.tran: 罢免；驱逐；赶下台

sentences.en: The CEO was ousted from his position after the company reported record losses.
sentences.cn: 在公司报告创纪录亏损后，首席执行官被罢免了职位。

sentences.en: Protesters called for the government to oust the corrupt officials.
sentences.cn: 抗议者呼吁政府罢免腐败的官员。

trans.tran: 在外面；向外；离开；出现；发布；结束；过时的；熄灭的

sentences.en: She stepped out of the meeting room to take a call.
sentences.cn: 她走出会议室接电话。

sentences.en: The company's latest financial report is out.
sentences.cn: 公司最新的财务报告已经发布了。

trans.tran: 过时的；不再适用的；已失效的

sentences.en: The company's software is out-of-date and needs to be updated immediately.
sentences.cn: 公司的软件已过时，需要立即更新。

sentences.en: Please check if the pricing information on the website is out-of-date before finalizing the contract.
sentences.cn: 在最终签订合约之前，请检查网站上的价格信息是否已过时。

trans.tran: 断电；停止运转；中断服务

sentences.en: The severe storm caused a widespread power outage across the region.
sentences.cn: 这场严重的风暴导致该地区大范围停电。

sentences.en: Our technical team is working to resolve the network outage as quickly as possible.
sentences.cn: 我们的技术团队正在尽快解决网络中断问题。

trans.tran: （疾病、暴力等的）爆发，突然发生

sentences.en: The sudden outbreak of the disease caused widespread panic in the city.
sentences.cn: 这种疾病的突然爆发在城市中引起了广泛的恐慌。

sentences.en: Authorities are implementing measures to prevent a further outbreak of the virus.
sentences.cn: 当局正在实施措施以防止病毒进一步爆发。

trans.tran: 结果；后果；成效

sentences.en: The company's success depends on the outcome of the negotiations.
sentences.cn: 公司的成功取决于谈判的结果。

sentences.en: We need to analyze the outcome of the marketing campaign to determine its effectiveness.
sentences.cn: 我们需要分析行销活动的成效，以确定其有效性。

trans.tran: 使过时；使陈旧；使不流行

sentences.en: New software updates can quickly outdate older versions.
sentences.cn: 新的软件更新可能很快就会使旧版本过时。

sentences.en: Their marketing strategies quickly outdate if they don't adapt to new trends.
sentences.cn: 如果他们的行销策略不适应新趋势，很快就会过时。

trans.tran: 过时的；不再适用的（信息、技术、进程等）

sentences.en: The company's software is outdated and needs to be updated immediately.
sentences.cn: 该公司的软件已过时，需要立即更新。

sentences.en: We can't use this outdated process; let's implement a more efficient system.
sentences.cn: 我们不能使用这个过时的流程，让我们实施一个更有效率的系统。

trans.tran: 超越、胜过（他人或事物），在某方面表现得更好。

sentences.en: Our new marketing campaign aims to outdo the competition in terms of customer engagement.
sentences.cn: 我们的全新行销活动旨在在客户交互方面超越竞争对手。

sentences.en: The sales team is determined to outdo their previous quarter's performance.
sentences.cn: 销售团队决心超越上一季的业绩表现。

trans.tran: 户外；室外环境

sentences.en: The company is planning an outdoor team-building event to boost morale.
sentences.cn: 公司正在规划一场户外团队建设活动以提升士气。

sentences.en: The conference will feature both indoor and outdoor exhibition spaces.
sentences.cn: 这次会议将设有室内和户外展览空间。

trans.tran: 在户外；室外

sentences.en: The company picnic will be held outdoors next Saturday.
sentences.cn: 公司野餐将在下周六在户外举行。

sentences.en: Despite the rain, the event continued outdoors under a large tent.
sentences.cn: 尽管下着雨，活动仍在大型帐篷下在户外继续进行。

trans.tran: 外部的；外面的；外层的

sentences.en: The outer layer of the packaging provides protection.
sentences.cn: 包装的外层提供保护。

sentences.en: They established an outer perimeter for security.
sentences.cn: 他们创建了一个外部警戒线以确保安全。

trans.tran: 外衣；穿在最外面的衣物（通常指用于保暖或防风的服装）

sentences.en: Due to the cold weather, employees are encouraged to wear appropriate outerwear during their breaks.
sentences.cn: 由于天气寒冷，员工在休息时间建议穿着合适的外衣。

sentences.en: The company policy requires all delivery personnel to wear branded outerwear for identification purposes.
sentences.cn: 公司规定所有送货人员为了辨识目的，必须穿着品牌外衣。

trans.tran: 一套服装；全套装备；公司，团体；提供装备；配备

sentences.en: She chose a stylish business outfit for the presentation.
sentences.cn: 她为这次演示文稿选择了一套时尚的商务服装。

sentences.en: The company plans to outfit all new employees with laptops and monitors.
sentences.cn: 该公司计划为所有新员工配备笔记本电脑和屏幕。

trans.tran: 流出；外流；流出量；外流量

sentences.en: The company reported a significant outflow of cash in the last quarter.
sentences.cn: 该公司报告上个季度有大量的现金流出。

sentences.en: There has been an outflow of talent from the industry due to lack of opportunities.
sentences.cn: 由于缺乏机会，该产业出现了人才外流的现象。

trans.tran: 外向的；健谈的，善于与人交互的

sentences.en: Our sales team needs outgoing individuals who can easily connect with potential clients.
sentences.cn: 我们销售团队需要外向健谈的人才，他们能轻松与潜在客户创建联系。

sentences.en: She's an outgoing employee and always volunteers to represent the company at networking events.
sentences.cn: 她是一位外向的员工，总是自愿代表公司参加社交活动。

trans.tran: 超越、胜过、持续比其他事物更久

sentences.en: Our company aims to outlast the economic downturn and emerge stronger.
sentences.cn: 我们公司旨在度过经济衰退，并以更强大的姿态生存下去。

sentences.en: The new product is expected to outlast its competitors in the market.
sentences.cn: 预计新产品将在市场上胜过竞争对手，拥有更长的生命周期。

trans.tran: （法律上）被禁止的；（非法）的；（通常指）被法律声明为不合法的人或行为。

sentences.en: The company ceased all operations in the region after the government outlawed their product.
sentences.cn: 在政府禁止该产品后，公司停止了该地区的所有营运。

sentences.en: Illegal dumping of waste is outlawed in this municipality and carries a hefty fine.
sentences.cn: 本市禁止非法倾倒废弃物，并处以高额罚款。

trans.tran: 支出；费用

sentences.en: The initial capital outlay for the project exceeded budget expectations by 15%.
sentences.cn: 项目的初始资本outlay超出预算预期15%。

sentences.en: Management carefully evaluated the marketing outlay before approving the campaign.
sentences.cn: 管理层在批准活动前仔细评估了行销outlay。

trans.tran: 出口；经销店

sentences.en: Our team will focus on outlet improvement this quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们团队本季将专注于出口改进。

sentences.en: The company's outlet approach needs to be updated.
sentences.cn: 公司的出口方法需要更新。

trans.tran: 大纲；概要；轮廓

sentences.en: Before starting the presentation, please review the outline to ensure all key points are covered.
sentences.cn: 在开始演示文稿之前，请先审阅大纲，以确保涵盖所有重点。

sentences.en: The project manager asked the team to outline their proposed solutions in a written report.
sentences.cn: 项目经理要求团队在书面报告中概述他们提出的解决方案。

trans.tran: 概述；勾勒出轮廓；简要说明

sentences.en: The project manager outlined the key milestones for the upcoming quarter.
sentences.cn: 项目经理概述了下个季度的主要里程碑。

sentences.en: Before the meeting, please outline your proposal in a brief memo.
sentences.cn: 在会议之前，请在简短的备忘录中概述您的提案。

trans.tran: 概述；大纲；轮廓

sentences.en: Before starting the project, please outline the key objectives and deliverables.
sentences.cn: 在开始项目之前，请概述主要目标和交付成果。

sentences.en: The manager asked the team to provide outlines of their presentations by Friday.
sentences.cn: 经理要求团队在周五前提供演示文稿的大纲。

trans.tran: 展望；预测；看法；态度

sentences.en: The company's outlook for the next quarter is positive, with projected sales growth.
sentences.cn: 公司下个季度的展望乐观，预计销售额将会成长。

sentences.en: Despite the economic downturn, the manager maintains a positive outlook on the future of the business.
sentences.cn: 尽管经济下滑，经理对公司的未来仍然抱持积极的态度。

trans.tran: 位于主要区域之外的；偏远的；不重要的

sentences.en: The company decided to close the outlying branch offices due to low profitability.
sentences.cn: 由于获利能力低，公司决定关闭位于偏远地区的分支机构。

sentences.en: The outlying warehouse is located 50 miles from the main distribution center.
sentences.cn: 该仓库位于主要配送中心 50 英里之外。

trans.tran: 超越（竞争对手），胜过（某人或某事）的速度或进度

sentences.en: Our company aims to outpace its competitors in the market share by launching innovative products.
sentences.cn: 我们公司计划透过推出创新产品，在市场份额上超越竞争对手。

sentences.en: To stay ahead, the team needs to outpace the rapidly changing industry trends.
sentences.cn: 为了保持领先地位，团队需要超越快速变化的行业趋势。

trans.tran: 表现优于；胜过

sentences.en: The company's new product is expected to outperform its competitors in the market.
sentences.cn: 预计该公司的新产品将在市场上超越其竞争对手。

sentences.en: Despite the challenging economic conditions, our sales team managed to outperform their targets.
sentences.cn: 尽管经济环境充满挑战，我们的销售团队仍设法超额达成目标。

trans.tran: 产出；输出；结果；成果

sentences.en: The software's output needs to be checked for accuracy before distribution.
sentences.cn: 在发布前，需要检查软件的输出结果是否准确。

sentences.en: The company is working to increase its production output to meet the growing demand.
sentences.cn: 公司正努力提高产出量以满足不断增长的需求。

trans.tran: 义愤；愤慨；暴行；愤怒；激怒；使震怒

sentences.en: The public expressed outrage over the company's unethical practices.
sentences.cn: 公众对该公司不道德的行为表达了愤慨。

sentences.en: His rude comments outraged many people at the meeting.
sentences.cn: 他粗鲁的言论激怒了会议上的许多人。

trans.tran: 外展

sentences.en: We need to outreach this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细外展。

sentences.en: The outreach is important for success.
sentences.cn: 外展对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 彻底地；完全地；公然地；立即的；坦率的

sentences.en: The company made an outright purchase of the new software system.
sentences.cn: 该公司直接全额购买了新的软件系统。

sentences.en: She rejected his proposal outright, without even considering it.
sentences.cn: 她当场断然拒绝了他的提议，甚至没有考虑。

trans.tran: 外包；外包事务

sentences.en: The company decided to outsource its IT department to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 公司决定将其 IT 部门外包以降低成本。

sentences.en: We're reviewing the outs currently handled by external vendors.
sentences.cn: 我们正在审查目前由外部供应商处理的外包事务。

trans.tran: 销售额超过；卖得比...好

sentences.en: Our new product significantly outsells the competitor's model.
sentences.cn: 我们的最新产品的销售额远超过竞争对手的型号。

sentences.en: Despite the lower price, the brand's reputation helped it outsell the generic alternatives.
sentences.cn: 尽管价格较低，但该品牌的声誉使其销售额超过了通用替代品。

trans.tran: 在...之外；室外；外部

sentences.en: The meeting will be held outside the main conference room.
sentences.cn: 会议将在主会议室外举行。

sentences.en: Please leave your luggage outside the hotel entrance.
sentences.cn: 请将您的行李放在饭店入口外。

trans.tran: 局外人；外来者；不属于某一特定团体或组织的人

sentences.en: He felt like an outsider at the company picnic because he didn't know anyone.
sentences.cn: 他觉得自己在公司野餐会上像个局外人，因为他不认识任何人。

sentences.en: The new employee was initially treated as an outsider, but soon became an integral part of the team.
sentences.cn: 这位新员工最初被视为外来者，但很快就成为了团队不可或缺的一部分。

trans.tran: 郊区；城郊地区

sentences.en: The new factory is located on the outskirts of the city, providing easy access to major transportation routes.
sentences.cn: 这家新工厂位于城郊，方便前往主要的交通路线。

sentences.en: Due to the heavy traffic, the commute from the outskirts can take over an hour.
sentences.cn: 由于交通繁忙，从郊区通勤可能需要一个多小时。

trans.tran: 外包；委外

sentences.en: Many companies choose to outsource their IT services to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 许多公司选择将其信息技术服务外包以降低成本。

sentences.en: We are considering outsourcing our customer support to a call center in another country.
sentences.cn: 我们正在考虑将客户支持外包给另一个国家的电话服务中心。

trans.tran: 杰出、卓越的；超出预期的

sentences.en: The employee's performance was outstanding, exceeding all expectations.
sentences.cn: 这位员工的表现非常杰出，远超所有期望。

sentences.en: The company received outstanding feedback on the new product launch.
sentences.cn: 公司在新产品上市的评估中获得了卓越的回馈。

trans.tran: 外面的，表面的；向外的，往外的

sentences.en: The outward appearance of the product is sleek and modern.
sentences.cn: 该产品的外观时尚现代。

sentences.en: She turned her gaze outward, towards the distant horizon.
sentences.cn: 她将目光向外，望向远方的地平线。

trans.tran: 外表上，表面上；从外观来看

sentences.en: He outwardly appeared calm, but inside he was quite nervous about the presentation.
sentences.cn: 他外表看起来很镇定，但内心对演示文稿相当紧张。

sentences.en: The company outwardly supported the new initiative, but internally there was considerable resistance.
sentences.cn: 公司表面上支持这项新计划，但内部存在相当大的反对。

trans.tran: 胜过；超过（重量、重要性等）

sentences.en: The potential benefits of the merger outweigh the risks involved.
sentences.cn: 这次合并的潜在利益胜过其中涉及的风险。

sentences.en: The company believes that improved customer service will outweigh the increased operational costs.
sentences.cn: 公司认为改善客户服务将胜过增加的营运成本。

trans.tran: 椭圆形的；椭圆

sentences.en: The conference table has an elegant oval design.
sentences.cn: 那张会议桌有着优雅的椭圆形设计。

sentences.en: She drew an oval on the whiteboard to represent the project timeline.
sentences.cn: 她在白板上画了一个椭圆来代表项目时间表。

trans.tran: 烤箱；烘焙设备

sentences.en: The hotel kitchen uses a large convection oven to bake bread and pastries daily.
sentences.cn: 饭店的厨房每天使用大型对流烤箱烘焙面包和糕点。

sentences.en: Please preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit before baking the cookies.
sentences.cn: 在烘焙饼干之前，请将烤箱预热至华氏 350 度。

trans.tran: 在…上方；越过；超过；结束；遍及；关于；翻转；再次；多余的

sentences.en: The project manager will go over the new proposal during the meeting.
sentences.cn: 项目经理将在会议中查看新的提案。

sentences.en: The meeting is over, so you can leave now.
sentences.cn: 会议结束了，你现在可以离开了。

trans.tran: 总体而言；整体上；总计

sentences.en: Overall, the project was a success, despite some minor setbacks.
sentences.cn: 总体而言，尽管有一些小挫折，这个项目仍然成功。

sentences.en: The company's overall profits increased by 15% this quarter.
sentences.cn: 本季公司总体利润增长了 15%。

trans.tran: （船只或飞机上）掉入海中或掉下机舱外；（比喻）失去控制或失去职位。

sentences.en: During the storm, a crate of supplies was washed overboard.
sentences.cn: 在暴风雨中，一箱物资被冲出了船外。

sentences.en: The company's CEO was dismissed after the scandal, effectively thrown overboard.
sentences.cn: 在丑闻爆发后，该公司的 CEO 被解雇，这等于将他赶出了公司。

trans.tran: 超额订位；（航空公司、饭店等）预先接纳超出实际座位或房间数量的订位，通常会导致后续的取消或调整。

sentences.en: The airline overbooked the flight, and several passengers were denied boarding.
sentences.cn: 航空公司超额订位了这趟航班，导致几位乘客无法登机。

sentences.en: To avoid customer dissatisfaction, the hotel manager decided not to overbook the rooms during the peak season.
sentences.cn: 为了避免客户不满意，饭店经理决定在旺季不要超额订位房间。

trans.tran: 以过高的价格收费；收取过高的费用

sentences.en: The taxi driver was accused of overcharging the tourists.
sentences.cn: 出租车司机被指控向游客收取过高的费用。

sentences.en: We received a complaint that the hotel was overcharging for extra services.
sentences.cn: 我们收到一份投诉，指出饭店对额外服务收取过高的费用。

trans.tran: 一件厚重的冬大衣，通常用于保暖或正式场合。

sentences.en: He wore a dark grey overcoat to the business conference.
sentences.cn: 他穿了一件深灰色大衣参加商务会议。

sentences.en: The receptionist requested that all visitors wear an overcoat during the winter months.
sentences.cn: 接待员要求所有访客在冬季穿着大衣。

trans.tran: 克服；战胜；克服困难

sentences.en: The company needs to overcome several challenges to meet the quarterly sales target.
sentences.cn: 为了达成季度销售目标，公司需要克服几个挑战。

sentences.en: Despite the technical difficulties, the team managed to overcome them and deliver the project on time.
sentences.cn: 尽管存在技术困难，团队还是克服了这些困难，并按时交付了项目。

trans.tran: 使…过于拥挤；使…挤满人

sentences.en: The small hall was overcrowded with guests during the award ceremony.
sentences.cn: 在颁奖典礼期间，这个小礼堂挤满了客人。

sentences.en: Many cities are facing challenges as public transportation becomes overcrowded during peak hours.

trans.tran: 页面（指文档、书籍、网站等的页面）

sentences.en: The report is 25 pages long and needs to be printed.
sentences.cn: 这份报告有 25 页，需要打印。

sentences.en: Please review the first few pages of the contract before the meeting.
sentences.cn: 在会议之前，请先审阅合约的前几页。

trans.tran: 支付；付费

sentences.en: The company paid its employees a generous bonus this year.
sentences.cn: 今年公司向员工支付了丰厚的奖金。

sentences.en: All invoices must be paid within 30 days of receipt.
sentences.cn: 所有发票必须在收到后 30 天内支付。

trans.tran: 痛苦、疼痛；（比喻）困难、不愉快的事物

sentences.en: The company offers comprehensive health insurance to cover employees' medical pains.
sentences.cn: 公司提供全面的健康保险，以涵盖员工的医疗费用和疼痛。

sentences.en: The manager needs to address the pains of the restructuring process to maintain team morale.
sentences.cn: 经理需要解决重组过程中的困难和不愉快，以维持团队士气。

trans.tran: 令人痛苦的；引起不适的，尤其指身体上的疼痛或不舒服。

sentences.en: The employee complained about the painful strain on his wrist after hours of typing.
sentences.cn: 这位员工抱怨长时间打字后，手腕感到非常疼痛。

sentences.en: The company is working to minimize the painful disruptions caused by the system upgrade.
sentences.cn: 公司正在努力减少系统升级所造成的痛苦干扰。

trans.tran: 费时费力地；极度谨慎地

sentences.en: The team painstakingly reviewed the contract to ensure accuracy.
sentences.cn: 团队费时地审阅合约，以确保准确性。

sentences.en: She painstakingly crafted each presentation slide to impress the potential investors.
sentences.cn: 她精心制作每一张演示文稿投视频，以给予潜在投资者留下深刻印象。

trans.tran: 涂漆；绘画；（颜色）色调

sentences.en: The company is planning to paint the office building to improve its image.
sentences.cn: 公司计划为改善形象而重新粉刷办公大楼。

sentences.en: We need to paint the product in a color that will appeal to our target market.
sentences.cn: 我们需要将产品涂成能吸引目标市场的颜色。

trans.tran: 上漆的；绘制的；涂色的

sentences.en: The newly painted office walls create a more welcoming atmosphere for employees.
sentences.cn: 新粉刷的办公室墙壁为员工创造了更友善的氛围。

sentences.en: The company decided to paint the warehouse a bright yellow to improve visibility for logistics personnel.
sentences.cn: 公司决定将仓库涂成鲜艳的黄色，以提高物流人员的可见度。

trans.tran: 油漆匠；画家（指以油画为主要创作媒介的艺术家）

sentences.en: The company hired a painter to touch up the office walls before the client visit.
sentences.cn: 为了迎接客户拜访，公司聘请了一位油漆匠来修补办公室的墙壁。

sentences.en: The art gallery features works by several local painters.
sentences.cn: 这家艺廊展示了几位当地画家的作品。

trans.tran: 油画或其他形式的绘画作品；亦指涂刷墙面或其他表面的行为，常用于办公室、会议室或展示空间的装潢。

sentences.en: The facilities manager scheduled the painting of the office lobby for next weekend.
sentences.cn: 设施经理已安排下周末对办公大厅进行油漆粉刷。

sentences.en: Our marketing brochure features a painting of the new product concept to attract investors.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销手册中展示了一幅新产品概念的绘画，以吸引投资者。

trans.tran: 画作；油画作品（通常指艺术品或装饰品）

sentences.en: The hotel is showcasing a collection of modern paintings in its lobby.
sentences.cn: 饭店在其大厅展示了一系列现代画作。

sentences.en: The company is considering purchasing several paintings to enhance the office environment.
sentences.cn: 公司正在考虑购买一些画作以提升办公室环境。

trans.tran: 一对；两个（通常指相同或匹配的物品）

sentences.en: Could you please provide a pair of gloves for handling these delicate components?
sentences.cn: 您能请提供一副手套来处理这些精密的零件吗？

sentences.en: The marketing team needs a pair of fresh eyes to review the campaign proposal.
sentences.cn: 营销团队需要一双新的眼睛来审查营销活动提案。

trans.tran: 成对的；一对一的

sentences.en: The company is looking for pairs of employees to participate in the cross-training program.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找成对的员工参与跨训练计划。

sentences.en: We need to ensure that each product is sold in pairs to maximize profit.
sentences.cn: 我们需要确保每个产品一对一地销售，以最大化利润。

trans.tran: （脸色）苍白的；（颜色）浅的，淡的；（光线）微弱的，暗淡的；（使）变苍白；（使）褪色；相形见绌

sentences.en: Her face went pale when she heard the shocking news.
sentences.cn: 当她听到这个震惊的消息时，脸色变得苍白。

sentences.en: Compared to the original, all other imitations pale in comparison.
sentences.cn: 与原版相比，所有其他仿制品都相形见绌。

trans.tran: 栈板；托盘（通常指用于运输货物的扁平木质或塑料平台）

sentences.en: The warehouse staff are responsible for stacking the pallets neatly and efficiently.
sentences.cn: 仓库人员负责整洁且有效地堆栈栈板。

sentences.en: We need to order more pallets to handle the increased volume of shipments.
sentences.cn: 我们需要订购更多栈板以处理增加的货物运输量。

trans.tran: 手掌；棕榈树；用手掌触摸；将…藏于掌中

sentences.en: She carefully held the delicate flower in the palm of her hand.
sentences.cn: 她小心翼翼地将那朵娇嫩的花握在手掌心。

sentences.en: The beach was lined with tall palm trees, providing shade from the sun.
sentences.cn: 海滩边缘种满了高大的棕榈树，为人们屏蔽阳光。

trans.tran: 朋友；伙伴（通常指关系亲密的朋友或同事）

sentences.en: I'm glad to have such supportive pals at work who always offer a helping hand.
sentences.cn: 我很庆幸能在工作中拥有如此支持的朋友，他们总是乐于伸出援手。

sentences.en: Let's catch up with our old pals at the industry conference next month.
sentences.cn: 下个月的行业会议，我们一起和老朋友们叙叙旧吧。

trans.tran: 小册子;宣传手册

sentences.en: The tourist information center provides free pamphlets about local attractions.
sentences.cn: 旅游信息中心提供免费的当地景点小册子。

sentences.en: We handed out pamphlets at the trade show to promote our new product.
sentences.cn: 我们在展会上发放小册子以推广我们的新产品。

trans.tran: 煎锅；平底锅

sentences.en: The chef used a large pan to fry the vegetables for the buffet.
sentences.cn: 厨师使用了一个大煎锅为自助餐油炸蔬菜。

sentences.en: Could you please get a non-stick pan for preparing the omelets?
sentences.cn: 您能请拿一个不沾锅来准备煎蛋吗？

trans.tran: 由专家或代表组成的讨论小组；亦指用于控制或显示信息的仪表板。

sentences.en: The marketing department will host a panel of industry experts to discuss emerging trends.
sentences.cn: 行销部门将邀请一个产业专家小组讨论新兴趋势。

sentences.en: Please panel the new conference room with acoustic panels to improve sound quality.
sentences.cn: 请在新会议室安装吸音板，以提升音质。

trans.tran: 恐慌；惊慌；（使）恐慌不安

sentences.en: There was a moment of panic when the system crashed unexpectedly.
sentences.cn: 系统意外当机时，现场出现了一阵恐慌。

sentences.en: Please don't panic; we have a contingency plan in place for this situation.
sentences.cn: 请不要惊慌；我们针对这种情况已制定了应变计划。

trans.tran: 喘气；气喘吁吁地说或走；（心脏）剧烈跳动；（口语）渴望

sentences.en: The dog was panting heavily after chasing the ball.
sentences.cn: 那只狗追完球后，大口地喘着气。

sentences.en: She reached the top of the hill, out of breath and with a slight pant.
sentences.cn: 她到达山顶时，气喘吁吁，稍微喘息了一下。

trans.tran: 裤子

sentences.en: She bought a new pair of pants for the business trip.
sentences.cn: 她为这次出差买了一条新裤子。

sentences.en: These pants are very comfortable for long hours at the office.
sentences.cn: 这条裤子非常适合在办公室长时间穿着。

trans.tran: 文档、纸张；（报刊）新闻报导

sentences.en: Please submit your expense reports and supporting papers by the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 请在周末前提交您的费用报告和相关文档。

sentences.en: The company released a white paper outlining its new sustainability initiatives.
sentences.cn: 该公司发布了一份白皮书，概述了其新的可持续发展计划。

trans.tran: 平装书；软皮书

sentences.en: I prefer reading paperbacks because they are lighter and easier to carry.
sentences.cn: 我比较喜欢读平装书，因为它们更轻且更容易携带。

sentences.en: The paperback edition of the novel will be released next month.
sentences.cn: 这部小说的平装版将于下个月发行。

trans.tran: 文牍、文档（通常指大量且重复性的行政或公司文档）

sentences.en: The new employee spent the first week completing a lot of paperwork.
sentences.cn: 这位新进员工花了一周的时间完成大量的文牍。

sentences.en: We're trying to reduce paperwork by implementing a digital filing system.
sentences.cn: 我们正在尝试透过实施数字文件系统来减少文牍。

trans.tran: 标准；平均水平；（股票、债券的）票面价值；同等

sentences.en: Her skills are on par with the best in the industry.
sentences.cn: 她的技能与业界最顶尖的人士不相上下。

sentences.en: The company's performance was below par this quarter.
sentences.cn: 公司本季的表现低于标准。

trans.tran: 游行队伍；（特别是）庆祝活动的游行

sentences.en: The company organized a parade to celebrate its 50th anniversary and boost brand awareness.
sentences.cn: 为了庆祝公司成立 50 周年并提升品牌知名度，公司组织了一场游行。

sentences.en: The marketing team is planning a parade route to maximize visibility during the product launch event.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在规划游行路线，以在产品发布活动期间最大化可见度。

trans.tran: 范例；典范；范式；思维模式

sentences.en: The company decided to shift to a new business paradigm to adapt to market changes.
sentences.cn: 该公司决定转向一种新的商业范式以适应市场变化。

sentences.en: This discovery represents a paradigm shift in our understanding of the universe.
sentences.cn: 这项发现代表了我们对宇宙理解的典范转移。

trans.tran: 悖论；似是而非的说法；自相矛盾的情况

sentences.en: It's a paradox that a highly connected world can sometimes lead to greater feelings of isolation.
sentences.cn: 高度链接的世界有时反而会导致更强烈的孤立感，这是一个悖论。

sentences.en: The company's rapid growth amidst a shrinking market presents a curious paradox.
sentences.cn: 这家公司在市场萎缩的情况下却快速成长，呈现了一个耐人寻味的矛盾。

trans.tran: 段落；一篇文章的结构性区块，通常包含一个主题句和相关的细节。

sentences.en: The report is well-organized, with each paragraph focusing on a specific aspect of the project.
sentences.cn: 这份报告组织良好，每个段落都专注于项目的特定面向。

sentences.en: Please review the following paragraph to ensure it accurately reflects the company's policy.
sentences.cn: 请审阅以下段落，以确保它准确反映了公司的政策。

trans.tran: 律师助理；法律助理

sentences.en: The law firm hired a new paralegal to assist with legal research and document preparation.
sentences.cn: 这家律师事务所雇用了一位新的律师助理，协助法律研究和文档准备。

sentences.en: She decided to pursue a career as a paralegal after completing her legal studies.
sentences.cn: 她完成法律学业后，决定从事律师助理的职业。

trans.tran: 平行的；同时发生的；相似的（指事物在某方面具有相似性或一致性）

sentences.en: The two projects ran parallel to each other, allowing for efficient resource allocation.
sentences.cn: 这两个项目同时进行，允许有效分配资源。

sentences.en: The company's marketing strategy needs to be parallel with its sales goals.
sentences.cn: 公司的行销策略需要与销售目标一致。

trans.tran: 参数；要素；界限

sentences.en: The report analyzed various parameters to evaluate project success.
sentences.cn: 该报告分析了多个参数以评估项目的成功。

sentences.en: Adjusting these parameters will change the output of the model.
sentences.cn: 调整这些参数将会改变模型的输出结果。

trans.tran: 准军事部队；准军事组织（非官方但以军事方式组织和运作的团体）

sentences.en: The government deployed paramilitary forces to maintain order in the troubled region.
sentences.cn: 政府向动乱地区部署了准军事部队以维持秩序。

sentences.en: He was accused of involvement with a paramilitary group operating illegally.
sentences.cn: 他被指控参与了一个非法运作的准军事组织。

trans.tran: 意译; 改述; 转述; 解释

sentences.en: Could you please paraphrase the main points of the report for clarity?
sentences.cn: 您可以将报告的重点意译一下，让大家更容易理解吗？

sentences.en: The speaker offered a clear paraphrase of the complex legal terms.
sentences.cn: 讲者对复杂的法律术语进行了清晰的意译。

trans.tran: 包裹；邮包（通常指较小的包裹）

sentences.en: The shipping department is expecting a large number of parcels to arrive today.
sentences.cn: 运输部门预计今天会有大量的包裹抵达。

sentences.en: Please ensure the parcel is properly labeled with the recipient's address.
sentences.cn: 请确保包裹已正确标示收件人的地址。

trans.tran: 宽恕；原谅；赦免；（用于礼貌地要求重复、道歉或允许）请再说一遍；对不起；请原谅

sentences.en: Pardon me, could you repeat that last part?
sentences.cn: 请原谅，您能重复一下最后那部分吗？

sentences.en: The governor granted a pardon to the wrongly convicted man.
sentences.cn: 州长赦免了那位被错误定罪的人。

trans.tran: 父母；家长；养育

sentences.en: Both parents were present at the meeting to discuss their child's academic performance.
sentences.cn: 父母双方都出席了会议，讨论他们孩子的学业表现。

sentences.en: It can be challenging to parent teenagers effectively while balancing work.
sentences.cn: 在平衡工作的同时有效养育青少年可能很有挑战性。

trans.tran: 父母的，父亲的，母亲的

sentences.en: Parental guidance is recommended for this film.
sentences.cn: 这部电影建议由家长陪同观看。

sentences.en: She has strong parental instincts.
sentences.cn: 她有很强的父母本能。

trans.tran: 圆括号；括弧；插入语

sentences.en: Please enclose the additional information in parenthesis.
sentences.cn: 请将额外信息放在圆括号内。

sentences.en: The speaker's lengthy parenthesis made it difficult to follow the main argument.
sentences.cn: 演讲者冗长的插入语使得很难跟上主要论点。

trans.tran: 巴黎，法国首都，常指法国的商业中心或欧洲的商业枢纽。

sentences.en: Our company is planning a business trip to Paris to explore potential partnerships.
sentences.cn: 我们公司计划前往巴黎进行商务旅行，以寻找潜在的合作伙伴。

sentences.en: The logistics team confirmed that the shipment will arrive in Paris next week.
sentences.cn: 物流团队确认货物下周将抵达巴黎。

trans.tran: 平等；同等；相同；（货币的）等价；平价

sentences.en: The company aims to achieve wage parity between male and female employees.
sentences.cn: 该公司旨在实现男女员工的工资平等。

sentences.en: Economists discuss purchasing power parity to compare living standards across countries.
sentences.cn: 经济学家们讨论购买力平价，以比较不同国家的生活水准。

trans.tran: 停车场；公园；停放（车辆）

sentences.en: Employees are required to park their vehicles in the designated parking area.
sentences.cn: 员工必须将车辆停放在指定的停车区域。

sentences.en: The company is considering purchasing a new park to enhance the employee benefits package.
sentences.cn: 公司正在考虑购买新的公园，以提升员工福利待遇。

trans.tran: 代客泊车员；负责在停车场或大楼入口协助驾驶人停车的工作人员

sentences.en: The parker will guide you to an available spot near the entrance of the conference center.
sentences.cn: 代客泊车员会引导您前往会议中心入口附近的空位。

sentences.en: Please inform the parker that the client needs a reserved parking space for the business meeting.
sentences.cn: 请告知代客泊车员，客户需要为商务会议预留停车位。

trans.tran: 停车场；停车行为；停车处

sentences.en: The hotel offers complimentary parking for all guests.
sentences.cn: 饭店为所有住客提供免费停车服务。

sentences.en: Please park your car in the designated area to avoid a fine.
sentences.cn: 请将您的汽车停放在指定区域，以避免罚款。

trans.tran: 公园；绿地

sentences.en: The company is considering purchasing land to develop new parks for employees and their families.
sentences.cn: 公司正在考虑购买土地，为员工及其家人开发新的公园。

sentences.en: The office building's proximity to several parks is a significant advantage for attracting talent.
sentences.cn: 办公大楼靠近几个公园，这对吸引人才是一个显著的优势。

trans.tran: 国会；议会

sentences.en: The new legislation was passed by parliament last week.
sentences.cn: 新法案已于上周在国会通过。

sentences.en: Members of parliament will discuss the budget proposal tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 国会议员们将于明日讨论预算提案。

trans.tran: 国会的; 议会的

sentences.en: The committee discussed the proposed changes to the parliamentary procedure.
sentences.cn: 该委员会讨论了议会进程拟议的变革。

sentences.en: She has extensive experience in parliamentary affairs.
sentences.cn: 她在国会事务方面拥有丰富的经验。

trans.tran: 帕玛森起司，一种硬质的意大利起司，常用于烹饪和装饰餐点。

sentences.en: The restaurant's menu highlights dishes featuring freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅的菜单重点介绍了使用新鲜磨碎的帕玛森起司的菜肴。

sentences.en: Could you please add a sprinkle of Parmesan to this pasta dish?
sentences.cn: 请问您能帮我在这份意大利面上撒上一些帕玛森起司吗？

trans.tran: 欧芹，一种常用于装饰或调味的香草植物。

sentences.en: The chef garnished the soup with fresh parsley for an appealing presentation.
sentences.cn: 厨师用新鲜的欧芹装饰汤品，使其更具吸引力。

sentences.en: Could you please add a little parsley to my salad? It enhances the flavor.
sentences.cn: 请问可以帮我加一点欧芹在沙拉里吗？它能提升风味。

trans.tran: （名词）部分；零件；角色；职责；份额；（动词）分开；离别；断裂；（副词）部分地；在某种程度上

sentences.en: Each team member needs to do their part to ensure the project's success.
sentences.cn: 每位团队成员都需要尽自己的本分来确保项目成功。

sentences.en: The broken part needs to be replaced immediately.
sentences.cn: 这个损坏的零件需要立即更换。

trans.tran: 部分的；不完整的；仅仅的

sentences.en: The report provides a partial overview of the company's financial performance.
sentences.cn: 这份报告提供了公司财务表现的部分概述。

sentences.en: Due to time constraints, we could only offer a partial refund.
sentences.cn: 由于时间限制，我们只能提供部分退款。

trans.tran: 部分地；不完全地

sentences.en: The project was completed partially due to unforeseen delays.
sentences.cn: 由于 непредвиденные задержки，该项目仅部分完成。

sentences.en: The report is partially based on data from last quarter.
sentences.cn: 这份报告部分内容基于上季的数据。

trans.tran: 参与者；参加者，尤指在活动、会议或调查中的。

sentences.en: All participants are required to register online before the conference begins.
sentences.cn: 所有参与者在会议开始前都必须在网上注册。

sentences.en: The survey results will be analyzed based on the responses from the participants.
sentences.cn: 根据参与者的回复，调查结果将会被分析。

trans.tran: 运行、表演、展现（技能或任务），在特定场合或情境下呈现。

sentences.en: The team is performing exceptionally well this quarter, exceeding all sales targets.
sentences.cn: 本季团队表现非常出色，远超所有销售目标。

sentences.en: The consultant is performing a thorough audit of the company's financial records.
sentences.cn: 顾问正在对公司财务记录进行全面审计。

trans.tran: 运行；展现；呈现；完成（任务或职责）

sentences.en: The marketing team performs market research to identify potential customers.
sentences.cn: 行销团队进行市场调查，以识别潜在客户。

sentences.en: The software engineer performs regular system maintenance to ensure optimal performance.
sentences.cn: 软件工程师运行定期的系统维护，以确保最佳性能。

trans.tran: 或许，可能，表示不确定的可能性

sentences.en: Perhaps we could schedule a follow-up meeting next week to discuss the proposal further.
sentences.cn: 或许我们下周可以安排一次追踪会议，以进一步讨论提案。

sentences.en: Perhaps the delay is due to unforeseen circumstances.
sentences.cn: 或许延迟是出于不可预见的情况。

trans.tran: 危险；冒险

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative peril procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的peril进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the peril implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了peril影响。

trans.tran: 一段时间；时期；周期

sentences.en: The project is scheduled to be completed within a six-month period.
sentences.cn: 该项目预计在六个月的周期内完成。

sentences.en: During the holiday period, our office will have reduced operating hours.
sentences.cn: 在假期期间，我们的办公室将缩短营业时间。

trans.tran: 周期的；定期的

sentences.en: The company conducts periodic performance reviews for all employees.
sentences.cn: 公司对所有员工进行定期的绩效评估。

sentences.en: We need to schedule periodic maintenance for the office equipment to ensure smooth operation.
sentences.cn: 我们需要安排办公设备的定期维护，以确保顺畅运作。

trans.tran: 定期发行的刊物，例如杂志、期刊或报告，通常以特定时间间隔发行。

sentences.en: The company distributes a quarterly periodical to keep employees updated on recent developments.
sentences.cn: 公司发行季刊，以确保员工了解最新的发展情况。

sentences.en: Researchers often publish their findings in academic periodicals.
sentences.cn: 研究人员经常将他们的发现发表在学术期刊上。

trans.tran: 周期性地；不时地；定期地（但间隔时间不固定）

sentences.en: The company updates its website periodically to reflect new product information.
sentences.cn: 公司会定期更新其网站，以反映最新的产品信息。

sentences.en: Employees are required to submit their expense reports periodically, typically on a monthly basis.
sentences.cn: 员工需要定期提交费用报表，通常是每月一次。

trans.tran: 时期划分；分期

sentences.en: The historian adopted a unique periodization for the ancient empire, dividing it into pre-dynastic, early, middle, and late periods.
sentences.cn: 这位历史学家对古老帝国采用了独特的时期划分，将其分为王朝前、早期、中期和晚期。

sentences.en: Effective project management often involves clear periodization, breaking down a large project into manageable phases with specific goals.
sentences.cn: 有效的项目管理通常涉及明确的时期划分，将大型项目分解为具有特定目标的易于管理的阶段。

trans.tran: 周边的；次要的；周边设备

sentences.en: The company is launching new peripheral devices, such as external hard drives and printers.
sentences.cn: 这家公司正在推出新的周边设备，例如外置硬盘和打印机。

sentences.en: We need to focus on the main issue and not get sidetracked by peripheral concerns.
sentences.cn: 我们需要专注于主要问题，而不是被次要的考量分散注意力。

trans.tran: 易腐烂的；容易变质的（通常指食品或货物，需要特殊的保存或运输条件以保持新鲜度）

sentences.en: The company needs to invest in refrigerated trucks to transport perishable goods efficiently.
sentences.cn: 公司需要投资冷藏车，以有效运输易腐烂的货物。

sentences.en: Due to the perishable nature of the ingredients, the restaurant emphasizes daily deliveries from local farms.
sentences.cn: 由于食材易腐烂，餐厅强调从当地农场每日送货。

trans.tran: 永久的；持续性的；不变的

sentences.en: The company offers permanent positions with benefits after a probationary period.
sentences.cn: 公司在试用期过后提供带有福利的永久职位。

sentences.en: Please submit a permanent solution to the software bug by the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 请在本周结束前提交解决软件错误的永久方案。

trans.tran: 永久地；不变地（表示状态或情况不会改变）

sentences.en: The company has decided to relocate its headquarters permanently.
sentences.cn: 公司已决定永久迁移其总部。

sentences.en: The software update will be installed permanently on all employee devices.
sentences.cn: 软件更新将永久安装在所有员工设备上。

trans.tran: 许可；允许；同意

sentences.en: Before using the company's equipment, you need to obtain permission from your supervisor.
sentences.cn: 在使用公司设备之前，您需要获得主管的许可。

sentences.en: The manager didn't permit the employee to leave early without a valid reason.
sentences.cn: 经理没有允许员工在没有正当理由的情况下提前离开。

trans.tran: 允许；许可；准许

sentences.en: The manager needs to permit the employee's request for a vacation.
sentences.cn: 经理需要批准员工休假的请求。

sentences.en: You need a permit to park your vehicle in this zone.
sentences.cn: 您需要在这个区域停车需要一张停车许可证。

trans.tran: 允许；被准许

sentences.en: Employees are permitted to use the company's gym during their lunch break.
sentences.cn: 员工在午休时间被允许使用公司的健身房。

sentences.en: Only authorized personnel are permitted access to the restricted area.
sentences.cn: 只有授权人员被允许进入限制区域。

trans.tran: 垂直的；成直角的；正交的

sentences.en: The two lines are perpendicular to each other, forming a 90-degree angle.
sentences.cn: 这两条线彼此垂直，形成一个90度角。

sentences.en: Ensure the shelf is perpendicular to the wall for stability.
sentences.cn: 请确保架子与墙壁垂直，以确保稳定性。

trans.tran: 持续不断的；永久的；永恒的

sentences.en: The company is committed to perpetual improvement of its products and services.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于持续改进其产品和服务。

sentences.en: The contract guarantees a perpetual right of use for the software.
sentences.cn: 该合约保证了软件的使用权永久有效。

trans.tran: 坚持；持续；持续进行（尤指在困难情况下）

sentences.en: Despite the technical difficulties, the team will persist in their efforts to complete the project on time.
sentences.cn: 尽管遇到技术困难，团队仍将坚持不懈地努力，确保项目按时完成。

sentences.en: The company decided to persist with the marketing campaign even though initial results were not promising.
sentences.cn: 尽管初步结果不尽如人意，公司决定继续推行营销活动。

trans.tran: 持续不断的；坚持不懈的

sentences.en: The sales team's persistent follow-up resulted in a significant increase in sales.
sentences.cn: 销售团队的持续追踪导致销售额显著增加。

sentences.en: Despite the technical difficulties, the project manager remained persistent in finding a solution.
sentences.cn: 尽管遇到技术困难，项目经理仍然坚持不懈地寻找解决方案。

trans.tran: 个人；人；人物

sentences.en: Each person is responsible for their own actions.
sentences.cn: 每个人都应为自己的行为负责。

sentences.en: We are looking for a reliable person to join our team.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找一位可靠的人才加入我们的团队。

trans.tran: 私人的；与个人相关的；非正式的

sentences.en: Please refrain from sharing personal information on the company's internal network.
sentences.cn: 请勿在公司内部网络中分享个人信息。

sentences.en: The manager requested a personal meeting with the employee to discuss performance.
sentences.cn: 经理要求与员工进行个人会面，以讨论绩效。

trans.tran: 人格特质；个性和风格

sentences.en: During the interview, the hiring manager assesses the candidate's personality to ensure a good team fit.
sentences.cn: 在面试过程中，招聘经理会评估候选人的个性和风格，以确保团队的良好配合。

sentences.en: A strong personality is often an asset in sales, allowing individuals to confidently present their products.
sentences.cn: 在销售领域，强烈的人格特质通常是一种优势，使个人能够自信地推销产品。

trans.tran: 个人化

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative personalization procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的personalization进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the personalization implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了personalization影响。

trans.tran: 客制化；针对个人或特定需求进行调整

sentences.en: Our marketing team is working to personalize the email campaign to increase engagement.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销团队正在努力客制化电子邮件行销活动，以提高参与度。

sentences.en: The software allows users to personalize their dashboards with the data most relevant to their roles.
sentences.cn: 该软件允许用户根据其职位，客制化仪表板上的数据。

trans.tran: 客制化；针对个人需求调整的

sentences.en: Our company offers personalized marketing campaigns to reach specific customer segments.
sentences.cn: 我们公司提供客制化的行销活动，以接触特定的客户群体。

sentences.en: The software allows users to create a personalized dashboard with their preferred data visualizations.
sentences.cn: 这款软件允许用户创建个人化的仪表板，其中包含他们偏好的数据可视化。

trans.tran: лично (俄语), 根据个人经验或观点

sentences.en: I believe that a personalized approach is essential for building strong customer relationships.
sentences.cn: 我认为，为了创建牢固的客户关系，个人化的方法至关重要。

sentences.en: Personally, I think the new marketing strategy is a great idea.
sentences.cn: 个人而言，我认为新的行销策略是一个很棒的想法。

trans.tran: 指公司或组织的员工或人力资源。

sentences.en: The HR department is responsible for managing all personnel records.
sentences.cn: 人事部门负责管理所有员工的记录。

sentences.en: We need to reduce personnel costs to improve profitability.
sentences.cn: 我们需要减少人事费用以提高盈利能力。

trans.tran: 观点；角度；看法

sentences.en: The project manager needs to consider the perspective of each team member before making a decision.
sentences.cn: 项目经理在做出决定之前，需要考虑每个团队成员的观点。

sentences.en: From a marketing perspective, this new campaign is highly innovative.
sentences.cn: 从行销的角度来看，这个新活动非常具有创新性。

trans.tran: （因紧张、疲劳或高温）冒汗；流汗

sentences.en: He was perspiring heavily during the presentation due to nervousness.
sentences.cn: 他因为紧张，在演示文稿时流了很多汗。

sentences.en: The air conditioning system needs repair; employees are perspiring in the office.
sentences.cn: 空调系统需要维修；办公室里的员工们都流了汗。

trans.tran: 说服

sentences.en: We need to persuade this carefully.
sentences.cn: 我们需要仔细说服。

sentences.en: The persuade is important for success.
sentences.cn: 说服对成功很重要。

trans.tran: 具有说服力的；能使人信服的

sentences.en: The salesperson used a persuasive argument to convince the client to sign the contract.
sentences.cn: 销售人员使用了有说服力的论点，说服客户签订合约。

sentences.en: A persuasive presentation is crucial for securing funding from investors.
sentences.cn: 一份有说服力的演示文稿对于从投资者那里获得资金至关重要。

trans.tran: 与…相关的；关于…的

sentences.en: The report contains information pertaining to the company's financial performance.
sentences.cn: 这份报告包含有关公司财务表现的信息。

sentences.en: Please review the documents pertaining to the upcoming merger.
sentences.cn: 请审阅与即将发生的并购相关的文档。

trans.tran: 相关的；切题的；与主题相关的

sentences.en: Please focus on the pertinent details in the report and disregard the irrelevant information.
sentences.cn: 请专注于报告中的相关细节，忽略不相关的信息。

sentences.en: The interviewer asked pertinent questions to assess the candidate's experience.
sentences.cn: 面试官提出了一些切题的问题来评估候选人的经验。

trans.tran: 心烦意乱的；不安的；困扰的

sentences.en: The sudden change in project scope perturbed the team, delaying the deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目范围的突然变更让团队心烦意乱，导致截止日期延迟。

sentences.en: He seemed perturbed by the negative feedback on his presentation.
sentences.cn: 他似乎对他演示文稿的负面回馈感到不安。

trans.tran: 比索（某些拉丁美洲国家和菲律宾的货币单位）

sentences.en: The exchange rate for the Argentine peso has been fluctuating significantly.
sentences.cn: 阿根廷比索的汇率波动剧烈。

sentences.en: Could you please convert these dollars into Mexican pesos?
sentences.cn: 请将这些美元兑换成墨西哥比索好吗？

trans.tran: 害虫；令人厌烦的人或事物（通常指干扰工作或进展的因素）

sentences.en: The company hired a professional exterminator to deal with the pest problem in the warehouse.
sentences.cn: 公司聘请了专业灭虫人员来处理仓库里的害虫问题。

sentences.en: We need to eliminate these time-wasting tasks; they're a real pest to our workflow.
sentences.cn: 我们需要消除这些浪费时间的任务；它们对我们的工作流程来说是个真正的麻烦。

trans.tran: 杀虫剂; 农药

sentences.en: The government has imposed stricter regulations on the use of pesticides in farming.
sentences.cn: 政府对农业中使用杀虫剂实施了更严格的规定。

sentences.en: Exposure to certain pesticides can be harmful to human health.
sentences.cn: 接触某些农药可能对人体健康有害。

trans.tran: 罗勒青酱，一种意大利传统酱料，由罗勒、松子、大蒜、帕玛森起司和橄榄油制成，常用于意大利面等餐点。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a variety of pasta dishes, including one with homemade pesto.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种意大利面，其中一道是使用自制青酱。

sentences.en: To enhance the flavor of the grilled chicken, try adding a dollop of pesto.
sentences.cn: 为了提升烤鸡的风味，可以试着加入一勺青酱。

trans.tran: 宠物；家畜（通常指陪伴型动物）

sentences.en: The company's policy allows employees to bring their pets to work on designated days.
sentences.cn: 公司政策允许员工在指定日将宠物带到办公室。

sentences.en: Many hotels now offer pet-friendly accommodations to attract a wider range of customers.
sentences.cn: 许多饭店现在提供宠物友善的住宿，以吸引更广泛的客户。

trans.tran: 彼得斯（Peters）是一家专注于供应链管理软件的公司，提供解决方案以优化库存、预测需求和提升整体效率。

sentences.en: Our company is considering implementing Peters' inventory management system to reduce warehousing costs.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在考虑导入 Peters 的库存管理系统以降低仓储成本。

sentences.en: The logistics team will evaluate Peters' software's ability to track shipments in real-time.
sentences.cn: 物流团队将评估 Peters 软件追踪货运的实时能力。

trans.tran: 正式的请求书，通常是写给政府或公司，表达多人对某议题的共同诉求。

sentences.en: The employees filed a petition requesting better working conditions and higher salaries.
sentences.cn: 员工提交了一份请求书，要求改善工作条件并提高薪资。

sentences.en: The company is reviewing the petition submitted by the customer group regarding the product recall.
sentences.cn: 公司正在审查客户群提交的关于产品召回的请求书。

trans.tran: 汽油 (主要用于英国英语)

sentences.en: I need to stop at the next station to get some petrol.
sentences.cn: 我需要在下一个加油站停车加油。

sentences.en: The price of petrol has increased significantly this month.
sentences.cn: 这个月汽油价格大幅上涨。

trans.tran: 宠物；家畜（通常指非生产性动物，用于陪伴或娱乐）

sentences.en: The company's pet-friendly policy attracts a wider range of employees.
sentences.cn: 公司友善宠物的政策吸引了更广泛的员工。

sentences.en: Employees are reminded that pets are not allowed in the office building for hygiene reasons.
sentences.cn: 提醒员工，由于卫生原因，宠物禁止进入办公楼。

trans.tran: 抚摸者；宠物主人（通常指对宠物有爱心的人）

sentences.en: The company is looking for petters to participate in a promotional campaign featuring adorable animals.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找宠物主人参与以可爱动物为主题的宣传活动。

sentences.en: As a petter, she understands the importance of animal welfare and responsible pet ownership.
sentences.cn: 作为一位宠物主人，她了解动物福利和负责任的宠物饲养的重要性。

trans.tran: 琐碎的; 不重要的; 小气的; 气量小的。

sentences.en: Don't waste time on petty arguments.
sentences.cn: 不要在琐碎的争吵上浪费时间。

sentences.en: It was a petty act to deliberately exclude her from the meeting.
sentences.cn: 故意将她排除在会议之外是一个小器的行为。

trans.tran: 制药的；与药品或制药产业相关的。

sentences.en: The company is investing heavily in pharmaceutical research and development.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在大力投资制药研究和开发。

sentences.en: The pharmaceutical industry is subject to strict regulations to ensure product safety.
sentences.cn: 为了确保产品安全，制药产业受到严格的法规约束。

trans.tran: 药师，负责调剂和销售药品，并提供药物相关咨询的专业人员。

sentences.en: The company is seeking a qualified pharmacist to manage the in-house pharmacy.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找一位合格的药师来管理公司内的药房。

sentences.en: Before leaving the store, please ask the pharmacist for advice on potential side effects.
sentences.cn: 离开商店前，请向药师咨询可能的副作用。

trans.tran: 药局；药房，指提供处方药和非处方药的商业场所。

sentences.en: The company is expanding its retail presence by opening new pharmacies in strategic locations.
sentences.cn: 该公司正透过在战略地点开设新的药局来扩展其零售业务。

sentences.en: Employees are required to present their health insurance cards at the pharmacy when filling prescriptions.
sentences.cn: 员工在领药时必须在药局出示他们的健康保险卡。

trans.tran: 阶段；时期；步骤

sentences.en: The project is currently in the planning phase.
sentences.cn: 项目目前处于规划阶段。

sentences.en: We need to phase in the new software to minimize disruption to daily operations.
sentences.cn: 我们需要逐步导入新软件，以减少对日常营运的干扰。

trans.tran: 分阶段的；逐步实施的

sentences.en: The company decided to implement the new software in a phased rollout to minimize disruption.
sentences.cn: 为了减少干扰，公司决定以分阶段的方式推出新软件。

sentences.en: The project will be phased according to the budget and resource availability.
sentences.cn: 项目将根据预算和资源可用性分阶段进行。

trans.tran: 野鸡；雉鸡（通常指饲养的野鸡，在餐饮业中常见）

sentences.en: The restaurant's menu features roasted pheasant with seasonal vegetables.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅的菜单特色是搭配时令蔬菜的烤野鸡。

sentences.en: We need to order more pheasant for the upcoming banquet.
sentences.cn: 我们需要为即将举行的宴会订购更多的野鸡。

trans.tran: 非凡的；杰出的；惊人的

sentences.en: Her ability to learn new languages quickly is truly phenomenal.
sentences.cn: 她快速学习新语言的能力确实是非凡的。

sentences.en: The company reported phenomenal growth in sales last quarter.
sentences.cn: 该公司报告称，上季度销售额实现了惊人的增长。

trans.tran: 现象；异常事件（通常指难以解释或不寻常的事件或情况）

sentences.en: The sudden drop in sales is a concerning phenomenon that requires immediate investigation.
sentences.cn: 销售额突然下降是一个令人担忧的现象，需要立即调查。

sentences.en: The company is studying the phenomenon of increased remote work to optimize its office space.
sentences.cn: 公司正在研究远程工作的现象，以优化其办公空间。

trans.tran: 哲学家

sentences.en: Socrates is widely regarded as one of the most influential philosophers in Western history.

sentences.en: Our company's data center is powered by renewable energy sources.
sentences.cn: 我们公司的数据中心由可再生能源供电。

trans.tran: 形容具有强大影响力或性能的；能够产生显著效果的

sentences.en: The new advertising campaign has proven to be a powerful tool for increasing brand awareness.
sentences.cn: 这项新的广告活动已证明是提升品牌知名度的有力工具。

sentences.en: Our sales team needs a powerful presentation to convince the client of the product's benefits.
sentences.cn: 我们的销售团队需要一个有说服力的演示文稿，以说服客户产品的优势。

trans.tran: PowerPoint 是一种由 Microsoft 提供的演示文稿软件，用于制作包含文字、图片、视频等多媒体元素的演示文稿。

sentences.en: The marketing team is preparing a PowerPoint presentation to showcase the new product line.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在准备一份 PowerPoint 演示文稿，以展示新的产品线。

sentences.en: Could you please send me the PowerPoint slides from yesterday's meeting?
sentences.cn: 您能请您传给我昨天会议的 PowerPoint 演示文稿吗？

trans.tran: 权力；能力；能源

sentences.en: The company is investing in renewable energy sources to reduce its carbon footprint and leverage its power in the market.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在投资可再生能源，以减少碳足迹并在市场上发挥其影响力。

sentences.en: Employees are empowered to make decisions within their area of responsibility, demonstrating the management's trust in their abilities.
sentences.cn: 员工被授权在其职责范围内做出决策，这体现了管理层对他们能力的信任。

trans.tran: 切合实际的；可操作的；实用的

sentences.en: The company is looking for practical solutions to reduce operational costs.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找降低营运成本的实际解决方案。

sentences.en: This training program focuses on providing participants with practical skills they can use immediately.
sentences.cn: 这个培训课程着重于提供参与者可以立即使用的实用技能。

trans.tran: 实际上；几乎

sentences.en: The new software is designed to streamline the workflow and make tasks practically effortless.
sentences.cn: 这款新软件旨在简化工作流程，使任务实际上变得毫不费力。

sentences.en: While the project faced some challenges, the team managed to complete it practically on time.
sentences.cn: 虽然项目面临了一些挑战，但团队几乎按时完成了它。

trans.tran: 练习；训练；实践

sentences.en: Regular practice is essential for improving your presentation skills.
sentences.cn: 定期练习对于提升您的演示文稿技巧至关重要。

sentences.en: The new employee needs to practice using the company's software before handling real customer data.
sentences.cn: 新员工需要在处理真实客户数据之前，练习使用公司的软件。

trans.tran: 惯例；实务；训练方法

sentences.en: The company's best practices for data security are regularly updated.
sentences.cn: 公司数据安全的最佳实务定期更新。

sentences.en: New employees are expected to follow established office practices.
sentences.cn: 新进员工预期将遵循既定的办公室惯例。

trans.tran: 练习；训练（技能或知识）

sentences.en: The new employee is currently practicing data entry skills to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 这位新进员工目前正在练习数据输入技巧，以提高效率。

sentences.en: Regular practicing of presentations is crucial for delivering a confident speech.
sentences.cn: 定期演练演示文稿对于发表自信的演讲至关重要。

trans.tran: 实务工作者；从业者（指在特定领域拥有经验和技能的人）

sentences.en: The company seeks experienced practitioners in the field of data analytics.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找数据分析领域的经验丰富的实务工作者。

sentences.en: As a legal practitioner, she is well-versed in contract law.
sentences.cn: 作为一名法律从业者，她对合约法非常熟悉。

trans.tran: 务实的；注重实际效果的；符合实际情况的

sentences.en: The manager's pragmatic approach to problem-solving led to a quick resolution.
sentences.cn: 经理务实的解决问题方式促使问题迅速得到解决。

sentences.en: We need a pragmatic solution that addresses the immediate challenges without incurring excessive costs.
sentences.cn: 我们需要一个务实的解决方案，在不产生过多成本的情况下，解决当前的挑战。

trans.tran: 赞扬；称赞；表扬

sentences.en: The manager praised her team's efforts to meet the project deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理称赞了他的团队为了达成项目期限所做的努力。

sentences.en: Receiving praise from a senior colleague boosted his confidence.
sentences.cn: 从资深同事那里得到赞扬，提升了他的信心。

trans.tran: 赞扬；称赞；表扬

sentences.en: The manager praised her team's dedication to completing the project ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 经理称赞他的团队为了提前完成项目所展现的奉献精神。

sentences.en: The company praised the employee's innovative solution to the challenging problem.
sentences.cn: 公司表扬了这位员工对棘手问题提出的创新解决方案。

trans.tran: 祈祷；向上帝或神灵表达愿望或请求

sentences.en: Before the important business meeting, the CEO took a moment to pray for success.
sentences.cn: 在重要的商业会议之前，首席执行官花了一点时间祈祷成功。

sentences.en: Many employees pray for a positive outcome during the company's annual performance review.
sentences.cn: 许多员工祈祷公司年度绩效审查能有积极的结果。

trans.tran: 祷告; 祈祷; 恳求; 祈祷文

sentences.en: She offered a silent prayer for the success of the project.
sentences.cn: 她为项目的成功默默地祈祷。

sentences.en: Their daily prayers bring them peace and comfort.
sentences.cn: 他们每天的祷告带给他们平安与慰藉。

trans.tran: 预先；事先

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to prepare a pre-launch campaign to generate initial buzz.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要准备一项上市前的宣传活动，以产生初步的讨论。

sentences.en: Please submit your pre-approval request at least one week before the deadline.
sentences.cn: 请在截止日期前至少一周提交您的预先批准申请。

trans.tran: （公开地）演讲、宣扬（观点或教条），通常带有说服的目的。

sentences.en: The CEO often preaches the importance of teamwork and collaboration to the entire company.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官经常向整个公司宣扬团队合作和协作的重要性。

sentences.en: During the training session, the manager preached the new safety protocols to ensure employee compliance.
sentences.cn: 在培训课程中，经理向员工宣讲了新的安全协议，以确保他们遵守。

trans.tran: 传教士；布道者

sentences.en: The preacher delivered a powerful sermon on compassion.
sentences.cn: 这位传教士发表了一场关于同情心的有力布道。

sentences.en: She decided to become a preacher after years of studying theology.
sentences.cn: 在学习多年神学之后，她决定成为一名传教士。

trans.tran: 预防措施；防护措施（为了避免潜在的风险或问题）

sentences.en: As a precaution, we're conducting a safety inspection before the shipment leaves the warehouse.
sentences.cn: 为了预防万一，我们在货物离开仓库前进行安全检查。

sentences.en: The company took the precaution of securing a backup generator in case of a power outage.
sentences.cn: 公司为了以防停电，采取了备用发电机的预防措施。

trans.tran: 在...之前；先于

sentences.en: Please precede your presentation with a brief introduction of the company.
sentences.cn: 请以简短的公司介绍来开场您的演示文稿。

sentences.en: The invoice number should precede the order number on the shipping label.
sentences.cn: 在运送标签上，发票号码应在订单号码之前。

trans.tran: 先例；类似案例；可资参考的案例

sentences.en: The company's legal team will review the case to see if there's a relevant precedent.
sentences.cn: 公司的法律团队将审查此案例，以查看是否有相关的先例。

sentences.en: Following the precedent set by last year's successful campaign, we're implementing a similar strategy.
sentences.cn: 我们正在实施类似的策略，遵循去年成功活动所创建的先例。

trans.tran: 极其珍贵的；具有很高价值的（通常指情感或非物质价值）

sentences.en: The company views its customer relationships as its most precious asset.
sentences.cn: 公司认为其客户关系是最宝贵的资产。

sentences.en: The marketing campaign highlighted the precious memories created with our product.
sentences.cn: 行销活动强调了使用我们产品所创造的珍贵回忆。

trans.tran: 小心翼翼地；珍视地；以高度重视的态度

sentences.en: The CEO handled the sensitive negotiation preciously, ensuring minimal disruption to the company's reputation.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官小心翼翼地处理这项敏感的谈判，确保公司声誉不受影响。

sentences.en: The consultant preciously reviewed the contract terms to identify any potential risks.
sentences.cn: 顾问仔细审阅合约条款，以识别任何潜在风险。

trans.tran: 促使...提前发生；（雨、雪等）骤然落下

sentences.en: The sudden drop in sales precipitated a review of the company's marketing strategy.
sentences.cn: 销售额的突然下降促使公司审查其行销策略。

sentences.en: The manager decided to precipitate a meeting to address the urgent project delays.
sentences.cn: 经理决定召开会议以解决紧急项目延迟。

trans.tran: 降水；（尤指）大量降雨

sentences.en: The company temporarily suspended operations due to heavy precipitation and potential flooding.
sentences.cn: 由于大量降水和潜在的洪水，公司暂停了营运。

sentences.en: The forecast predicts precipitation tomorrow, so please ensure all outdoor equipment is properly secured.
sentences.cn: 预报显示明天会有降水，请确保所有户外设备都已妥善固定。

trans.tran: 精确的；准确的；明确的，不含糊的

sentences.en: The report needs to include precise figures to support the budget proposal.
sentences.cn: 报告需要包含精确的数字来支持预算提案。

sentences.en: Please provide the exact date and time for the meeting, as we need to schedule accordingly.
sentences.cn: 请提供会议的确切日期和时间，以便我们能相应地安排。

trans.tran: 精确地；确切地；准确地（强调细节和无误）

sentences.en: Please specify the delivery date precisely in your order.
sentences.cn: 请在订单中准确地说明交货日期。

sentences.en: The report needs to state the figures precisely to avoid any misunderstandings.
sentences.cn: 为了避免任何误解，报告需要准确地说明数字。

trans.tran: 精确度；准确性，特指在技术、数据或量测中达到高度准确的程度。

sentences.en: The engineer emphasized the importance of precision in the manufacturing process.
sentences.cn: 这位工程师强调了制造过程中精确度的重要性。

sentences.en: The data entry specialist needs to ensure the precision of the financial records.
sentences.cn: 数据输入专员需要确保财务记录的准确性。

trans.tran: 预先阻止；排除可能性

sentences.en: The company's strict quality control measures preclude the possibility of defective products reaching the market.
sentences.cn: 公司严格的品质管制措施排除了有瑕疵产品进入市场的可能性。

sentences.en: Lack of funding may preclude the project from being completed on schedule.
sentences.cn: 缺乏资金可能会阻止项目按时完成。

trans.tran: 捕食者；掠夺者；利用他人弱点的人

sentences.en: A lion is a formidable predator in the savanna.
sentences.cn: 狮子是草原上令人生畏的捕食者。

sentences.en: The company was accused of being a market predator due to its aggressive pricing strategy.
sentences.cn: 这家公司因其激进的定价策略而被指控为市场掠夺者。

trans.tran: 前任者；前辈（通常指职位或职责上的前任者）

sentences.en: The new CEO has a lot to learn from his predecessor, who led the company through a period of significant growth.
sentences.cn: 新首席执行官需要向他的前任学习很多，他的前任带领公司度过了一个显著增长的时期。

sentences.en: The marketing team is reviewing the strategies implemented by its predecessor to identify areas for improvement.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在查看其前任实施的策略，以找出改进领域。

trans.tran: 预先决定；预先确定；预先注定

sentences.en: The results of the market survey will predetermine our marketing strategy.
sentences.cn: 市场调查的结果将预先决定我们的行销策略。

sentences.en: It's difficult to predetermine the exact timeline for a complex project.
sentences.cn: 很难预先确定一个复杂项目的确切时间表。

trans.tran: 困境；棘手局面

sentences.en: The company found itself in a difficult predicament after the sudden drop in sales.
sentences.cn: 在销售额突然下降后，公司面临着一个棘手的局面。

sentences.en: We need to find a solution to this predicament before it escalates further.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在情况进一步恶化之前找到这个困境的解决方案。

trans.tran: 预测；预估；预见

sentences.en: Our analysts predict a significant increase in sales next quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们的分析师预测下个季度销售额将显著增加。

sentences.en: The weather forecast predicts rain tomorrow, so please bring an umbrella.
sentences.cn: 天气预报预测明天会下雨，请记得带伞。

trans.tran: 可预测的；一成不变的；意料之中的

sentences.en: The team's performance has been very predictable lately, always delivering on time.
sentences.cn: 最近团队的表现非常可预测，总是能准时交付。

sentences.en: Her reaction to the news was completely predictable.
sentences.cn: 她对这个消息的反应完全在意料之中。

trans.tran: 可预期地；依照预期地

sentences.en: The project timeline was adhered to predictably, ensuring timely completion.
sentences.cn: 项目时程可预期地被遵守，确保了及时完成。

sentences.en: Due to the established procedures, the system updates are predictably scheduled for weekends.
sentences.cn: 由于既定的进程，系统更新可预期地排定在周末进行。

trans.tran: 预测；预估；预言

sentences.en: The market analysts predicted a significant increase in demand for electric vehicles next year.
sentences.cn: 市场分析师预测明年对电动汽车的需求将大幅增加。

sentences.en: Based on current trends, we predicted a 10% decrease in sales during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 根据目前的趋势，我们预测在假期期间销售额将下降 10%。

trans.tran: 预测；预估；预测结果

sentences.en: The market research team's prediction suggests a significant increase in sales next quarter.
sentences.cn: 市场研究团队的预测显示下个季度销售额将显著增加。

sentences.en: Based on the current data, our sales forecast and prediction are cautiously optimistic.
sentences.cn: 根据目前数据，我们的销售预测和预估持谨慎乐观的态度。

trans.tran: 预测因子；预报器；预测者

sentences.en: Age is often a strong predictor of health outcomes.
sentences.cn: 年龄通常是健康结果的一个强烈预测因子。

sentences.en: The company uses various economic indicators as predictors for market trends.
sentences.cn: 该公司利用各种经济指针作为市场趋势的预测因子。

trans.tran: 主要地；以…为主的；大体上

sentences.en: The company's revenue is predominantly derived from overseas sales.
sentences.cn: 该公司的收入主要来自海外销售。

sentences.en: The report predominantly focuses on the challenges faced by small businesses.
sentences.cn: 这份报告主要关注小型企业面临的挑战。

trans.tran: 卓越的；首屈一指的；在...方面具有支配地位的

sentences.en: Our company is the preeminent provider of cloud storage solutions in the region.
sentences.cn: 我们公司是该地区云存储解决方案的首屈一指供应商。

sentences.en: The CEO emphasized the company's preeminent position in the global market.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官强调了公司在全球市场中的卓越地位。

trans.tran: 较喜欢；在多个选项中选择较为愿意的方式或事物

sentences.en: I prefer to schedule the meeting after lunch to accommodate everyone's availability.
sentences.cn: 我较喜欢在午餐后安排会议，以配合所有人的时间。

sentences.en: Our clients prefer receiving invoices electronically rather than by mail.
sentences.cn: 我们的客户较喜欢以电子方式收取发票，而不是邮寄。

trans.tran: 较好地；宁愿

sentences.en: We would prefer to receive the report by email rather than by mail.
sentences.cn: 我们宁愿透过电子邮件而非邮寄方式收到报告。

sentences.en: Preferably, the meeting should be held in the conference room on the third floor.
sentences.cn: 最好是在三楼的会议室举行会议。

trans.tran: 偏好；选择；喜欢

sentences.en: The survey aims to determine customer preferences regarding new product features.
sentences.cn: 这项调查旨在确定客户对新产品功能的偏好。

sentences.en: Our company values employee preferences when designing the office layout.
sentences.cn: 我们公司在设计办公室布局时重视员工的偏好。

trans.tran: 偏好；选择；喜好

sentences.en: The survey aims to identify customer preferences regarding product features.
sentences.cn: 这项调查旨在了解客户对产品功能的偏好。

sentences.en: Our company values employee preferences when designing the office layout.
sentences.cn: 我们公司在设计办公室布局时重视员工的偏好。

trans.tran: 偏好的；优先选择的

sentences.en: The company's preferred method of payment is bank transfer.
sentences.cn: 公司偏好的付款方式是银行转帐。

sentences.en: Please submit your preferred dates for the training session by Friday.
sentences.cn: 请在星期五前提交您偏好的培训日期。

trans.tran: 偏好；更喜欢（某事物），通常表示选择或优先考虑

sentences.en: The company is preferring to outsource its IT support to a specialized firm.
sentences.cn: 公司更倾向于将其 IT 支持外包给一家专业公司。

sentences.en: Many employees are preferring to work remotely, leading to a shift in office space requirements.
sentences.cn: 许多员工更喜欢远程工作，导致办公空间需求发生变化。

trans.tran: 偏好；喜欢（某事物或方式），通常指更喜欢一种选择。

sentences.en: He prefers to communicate via email rather than phone calls.
sentences.cn: 他更喜欢通过电子邮件沟通，而不是电话。

sentences.en: The company prefers suppliers who offer competitive pricing and reliable delivery.
sentences.cn: 公司更喜欢提供具竞争力定价和可靠交货的供应商。

trans.tran: 怀孕

sentences.en: She announced her pregnancy to her family.
sentences.cn: 她向家人宣布了她的怀孕消息。

sentences.en: The company offers comprehensive benefits for employees during pregnancy.
sentences.cn: 公司为员工提供全面的怀孕期间福利。

trans.tran: 怀孕的；充满的；意味深长的

sentences.en: She is six months pregnant with her first child.
sentences.cn: 她怀孕六个月了，这是她的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: The company offers special benefits for pregnant employees.
sentences.cn: 公司为怀孕员工提供特殊福利。

trans.tran: 预热（烤箱、锅具等），使设备达到所需温度以利烹饪或操作。

sentences.en: Please preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit before baking the cake.
sentences.cn: 请在烘烤蛋糕前，将烤箱预热至华氏 350 度。

sentences.en: The chef instructed the kitchen staff to preheat the grill before starting the barbecue.
sentences.cn: 厨师指示厨房人员在开始烧烤前预热烤架。

trans.tran: 偏见；歧视；成见

sentences.en: It's important to overcome prejudice and treat everyone equally.
sentences.cn: 克服偏见并平等对待每个人是很重要的。

sentences.en: His biased comments prejudiced the jury against the defendant.
sentences.cn: 他带有偏见的言论使陪审团对被告产生了不利的看法。

trans.tran: 初步的；预备性的；为初步评估或准备而做的

sentences.en: The company conducted a preliminary market analysis before launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 公司在新产品上市前进行了初步市场分析。

sentences.en: This is a preliminary report; a final version will be submitted next week.
sentences.cn: 这是一份初步报告，最终版本将下周提交。

trans.tran: 首映；首秀；（电影、产品等）首发

sentences.en: The premier of the new product launch was a resounding success, generating significant buzz.
sentences.cn: 新产品发布的首映非常成功，产生了巨大的话题。

sentences.en: This is the premier hotel in the city, offering unparalleled luxury and service.
sentences.cn: 这家是市内最好的酒店，提供无与伦比的奢华和服务。

trans.tran: 首映；首场（演出、电影等）

sentences.en: The company is planning a grand premiere for its new product line next month.
sentences.cn: 公司计划下个月为其新产品线举办盛大的首映仪式。

sentences.en: The film's premiere was attended by numerous celebrities and industry professionals.
sentences.cn: 这部电影的首映式吸引了众多名人及业界人士。

trans.tran: 前提；假设；假定；房屋及所属土地（尤指营业场所）

sentences.en: The entire argument was based on a false premise.
sentences.cn: 整个论点都是创建在一个错误的前提之上。

sentences.en: To remain competitive, we need to ensure our pricemaxes are in line with industry standards.
sentences.cn: 为了保持竞争力，我们需要确保我们的最高价格与行业标准一致。

trans.tran: 价格；(多数)价格

sentences.en: The company is constantly monitoring market prices to ensure competitive pricing.
sentences.cn: 公司不断监控市场价格，以确保具有竞争力的定价。

sentences.en: We need to compare prices from different suppliers before placing the order.
sentences.cn: 在下单之前，我们需要比较不同供应商的价格。

trans.tran: 价格昂贵的；高价的

sentences.en: The imported machinery is quite pricey, so we need to carefully evaluate its ROI.
sentences.cn: 这批进口机器价格相当昂贵，我们需要仔细评估它的投资回报率。

sentences.en: We're looking for a cost-effective solution; these options are too pricey for our budget.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找性价比高的解决方案，这些选项超出我们的预算。

trans.tran: 价格策略；定价

sentences.en: The company is currently reviewing its pricing strategy to remain competitive in the market.
sentences.cn: 公司目前正在审查其价格策略，以在市场上保持竞争力。

sentences.en: Competitive pricing is essential for attracting new customers and increasing sales volume.
sentences.cn: 具有竞争力的定价对于吸引新客户和提高销售量至关重要。

trans.tran: 自豪感；荣誉感；骄傲

sentences.en: The company takes pride in its commitment to sustainable practices.
sentences.cn: 公司以其对永续发展的承诺感到自豪。

sentences.en: She felt a sense of pride after successfully completing the project.
sentences.cn: 她在成功完成项目后感到一种荣誉感。

trans.tran: 自豪；荣誉；骄傲

sentences.en: Our company prides itself on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.
sentences.cn: 我们公司以提供高品质产品和卓越的客户服务为荣。

sentences.en: The team prides itself on meeting all project deadlines.
sentences.cn: 团队以准时完成所有项目为荣。

trans.tran: 主要地；首要地；以...为主要目的

sentences.en: The company primarily focuses on developing sustainable energy solutions.
sentences.cn: 该公司主要专注于开发可持续能源解决方案。

sentences.en: The report primarily addresses the challenges faced by small businesses during the pandemic.
sentences.cn: 这份报告主要探讨了疫情期间小型企业面临的挑战。

trans.tran: 首要的；主要的；最初的

sentences.en: The primary objective of this project is to increase sales by 15%.
sentences.cn: 这个项目的首要目标是将销售额提高 15%。

sentences.en: The primary responsibility of the marketing team is to generate leads.
sentences.cn: 行销团队的首要责任是产生潜在客户。

trans.tran: 首要的；主要的；优良的（指产品或服务）

sentences.en: Our company aims to offer prime quality products at competitive prices.
sentences.cn: 我们公司旨在以具竞争力的价格提供优良品质的产品。

sentences.en: The prime objective of this marketing campaign is to increase brand awareness.
sentences.cn: 这次行销活动的首要目标是提高品牌知名度。

trans.tran: 入门书；基础读物；底漆；引发剂

sentences.en: This book serves as a primer on quantum physics for beginners.
sentences.cn: 这本书是为初学者准备的量子物理入门书。

sentences.en: Apply a primer before painting to ensure better adhesion and a smoother finish.
sentences.cn: 在油漆前先涂一层底漆，以确保更好的附着力和更平滑的表面效果。

trans.tran: 原始的；简陋的；未开化的；原始人；原始艺术品

sentences.en: The tools found at the archaeological site were very primitive.
sentences.cn: 在考古现场发现的工具非常原始。

sentences.en: Despite its primitive interface, the software is surprisingly powerful.
sentences.cn: 尽管它的界面很简陋，这款软件却出奇地强大。

trans.tran: 主要；首要；校长（指学校）

sentences.en: The principal reason for the project's delay is the lack of funding.
sentences.cn: 项目延迟的主要原因是缺乏资金。

sentences.en: The principal of the school announced a new policy regarding student attendance.
sentences.cn: 校长宣布了一项关于学生出勤的新政策。

trans.tran: 原则；准则；基本法则

sentences.en: Our company operates on the principle of fairness and transparency.
sentences.cn: 我们公司遵循公平和透明的原则运营。

sentences.en: The manager needs to principle the employee's actions to ensure compliance with company policy.
sentences.cn: 经理需要根据公司政策来指导员工的行为。

trans.tran: 打印；印出；出版

sentences.en: Could you please print out three copies of the contract for the meeting?
sentences.cn: 请帮忙打印三份合约副本，以便会议讨论。

sentences.en: The company decided to print a limited edition of the marketing brochure.
sentences.cn: 公司决定出版一份限量版的行销小册子。

trans.tran: 已打印的；印刷的

sentences.en: Please review the printed contract before signing it.
sentences.cn: 请在签署前审阅已打印的合约。

sentences.en: The marketing team needs the printed brochures for the trade show.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要这些印刷品用于贸易展览。

trans.tran: 复印机；打印机，用于将数字文档拷贝到纸张上。

sentences.en: The office manager needs to order more printer cartridges before they run out.
sentences.cn: 办公室经理需要在墨水耗尽前订购更多复印机墨水。

sentences.en: Please print three copies of the contract for the client's review.
sentences.cn: 请打印三份合约副本供客户审阅。

trans.tran: 复印机；打印机（复数）

sentences.en: The IT department is responsible for maintaining all office printers.
sentences.cn: 信息部门负责维护办公室的所有复印机。

sentences.en: We need to order more printer cartridges before the end of the week.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在本周结束前订购更多复印机墨盒。

trans.tran: 打印；印刷（文档、图像等）

sentences.en: The marketing department needs to finish the printing of the brochures before the conference.
sentences.cn: 行销部门需要在会议前完成小册子的印刷。

sentences.en: Please print out the contract and sign it before returning it to legal.
sentences.cn: 请将合约打印出来，签名后再交回法律部门。

trans.tran: 先前的；优先的；较早的

sentences.en: Please review the prior agreement before signing the new contract.
sentences.cn: 请在签署新合约之前，先审阅之前的协议。

sentences.en: The company prioritizes customer feedback prior to making any significant changes.
sentences.cn: 公司在做出任何重大变更之前，会优先考虑客户的回馈。

trans.tran: 将某事视为优先级；确定优先处理事项

sentences.en: The project manager needs to prioritize tasks based on their deadlines and importance.
sentences.cn: 项目经理需要根据截止日期和重要性来确定任务的优先级。

sentences.en: We need to prioritize customer feedback to improve our products and services.
sentences.cn: 我们需要优先处理客户回馈，以改进我们的产品和服务。

trans.tran: 将任务或目标按照重要性排序，优先处理较重要的事项。

sentences.en: The project manager is prioritizing tasks to meet the deadline.
sentences.cn: 项目经理正在优先处理任务以赶上截止日期。

sentences.en: We need to prioritize customer feedback to improve our products.
sentences.cn: 我们需要优先考虑客户回馈以改进我们的产品。

trans.tran: 优先级；首要任务

sentences.en: Our top priority is to ensure customer satisfaction.
sentences.cn: 我们的首要任务是确保客户满意度。

sentences.en: Please prioritize these tasks based on their deadlines.
sentences.cn: 请根据截止日期来安排这些任务的优先级。

trans.tran: 监狱，牢房；拘禁

sentences.en: The criminal was sentenced to five years in prison.
sentences.cn: 这名罪犯被判处五年徒刑。

sentences.en: Many inmates in the prison are seeking rehabilitation programs.
sentences.cn: 监狱中许多囚犯正在寻求康复计划。

trans.tran: 囚犯；犯人

sentences.en: The prisoner was granted parole after serving five years of his sentence.
sentences.cn: 这名囚犯在服刑五年后获得了假释。

sentences.en: They are holding the captured soldiers as prisoners of war.
sentences.cn: 他们将被俘的士兵作为战俘关押。

trans.tran: 隐私权；不公开的状态

sentences.en: The company is committed to protecting the privacy of its customers' personal data.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于保护客户个人数据的隐私。

sentences.en: Employees are expected to respect the privacy of their colleagues.
sentences.cn: 员工预期会尊重同事的隐私。

trans.tran: 私人的；仅限于特定人员或团体的，常用于指仅限于内部或机密的会议、信息或空间。

sentences.en: The manager scheduled a private meeting with the client to discuss confidential terms.
sentences.cn: 经理安排了一场私密会议与客户讨论机密条款。

sentences.en: Please keep this information private until the official announcement.
sentences.cn: 请在正式公告前将此信息保密。

trans.tran: 私下地；隐私地；非公开地

sentences.en: The company held a private meeting to discuss the merger.
sentences.cn: 公司举行了一次私下会议来讨论合并事宜。

sentences.en: Please keep this information private; it's confidential.
sentences.cn: 请将此信息保密，它是机密的。

trans.tran: 私有化；将公营事业转为私营的过程。

sentences.en: The government is considering the privatization of several state-owned enterprises to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 政府正在考虑将一些国营企业私有化，以提高效率。

sentences.en: The privatization process involved a thorough valuation of the company's assets.
sentences.cn: 私有化过程包括对公司资产的全面评估。

trans.tran: 将...私有化；使...私营化

sentences.en: The government decided to privatize the state-owned railway company.
sentences.cn: 政府决定将国有铁路公司私有化。

sentences.en: Critics argue that privatizing public services might lead to higher costs for consumers.
sentences.cn: 批评人士认为，将公共服务私有化可能会导致消费者费用更高。

trans.tran: 特权；享有…的权利或优待（通常指因身份、地位或财富而获得的）。

sentences.en: Senior employees often enjoy certain privileges, such as flexible working hours and company car.
sentences.cn: 资深员工通常享有某些特权，例如弹性工作时间和公司车。

sentences.en: The company is reviewing its policies to ensure all employees have equal opportunities and avoid any unfair privileges.
sentences.cn: 公司正在审查其政策，以确保所有员工享有平等机会，避免任何不公平的特权。

trans.tran: 奖品；奖励（通常指金钱、物品或荣誉，以表彰成就或参与活动）

sentences.en: The company offered a generous prize for the employee who generated the most sales leads.
sentences.cn: 公司为产生最多销售潜在客户的员工提供了一项丰厚的奖品。

sentences.en: Winning the industry award was the highest prize for our team's hard work.
sentences.cn: 获得该行业奖项是我们团队辛勤工作的最高奖励。

trans.tran: 奖品；奖励（通常指多个奖品）

sentences.en: The company offered attractive prizes to incentivize employee participation in the sales competition.
sentences.cn: 为了鼓励员工参与销售竞赛，公司提供了有吸引力的奖品。

sentences.en: The raffle prizes included a weekend getaway and a high-end camera.
sentences.cn: 抽奖的奖品包括周末度假和一台高级相机。

trans.tran: 专业人士；专家；支持者

sentences.en: The company hired several pros to consult on the new marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 公司聘请了几位专家来咨询新的行销活动。

sentences.en: This software offers a professional and pro interface, making it easy to use.
sentences.cn: 这款软件提供专业且简洁的用户界面，使其易于使用。

trans.tran: 可能性；概率

sentences.en: There's a high probability of rain this afternoon.
sentences.cn: 今天下午下雨的可能性很高。

sentences.en: We need to calculate the probability of success for this marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 我们需要计算这次行销活动成功的概率。

trans.tran: 很有可能；极有可能

sentences.en: It is probable that the shipment will be delayed due to the severe weather conditions.
sentences.cn: 由于严重的天气状况，货物很可能延迟送达。

sentences.en: The manager believes it's probable that the project will be completed ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 经理认为项目很可能在原定时间之前完成。

trans.tran: 很可能；大概

sentences.en: The shipment will probably arrive on Friday.
sentences.cn: 货物很可能在星期五抵达。

sentences.en: He's probably in a meeting right now.
sentences.cn: 他现在可能正在开会。

trans.tran: 试用期员工；受训人员

sentences.en: All new hires begin their employment as probationers for a period of six months.
sentences.cn: 所有新进员工都以试用期员工的身分开始工作，为期六个月。

sentences.en: The company will evaluate the probationer's performance at the end of the trial period.
sentences.cn: 公司将在试用期结束时评估试用期员工的表现。

trans.tran: 探究, 探查, 盘问 (动词); 探针, 探测器, 详细调查 (名词)

sentences.en: The detective continued to probe the suspect with difficult questions.
sentences.cn: 侦探继续用难题盘问嫌疑犯。

sentences.en: NASA launched a new space probe to study distant galaxies.
sentences.cn: 美国太空总署发射了一个新的太空探测器来研究遥远的星系。

trans.tran: 问题、困境；障碍

sentences.en: We need to identify the root problem causing the production delays.
sentences.cn: 我们需要找出造成生产延迟的根本问题。

sentences.en: The software is experiencing a problem that prevents users from logging in.
sentences.cn: 软件出现问题，导致用户无法登录。

trans.tran: 构成问题或困难的；令人担忧的

sentences.en: The new software has several problematic bugs that need to be addressed immediately.
sentences.cn: 这个新软件有一些令人担忧的错误，需要立即处理。

sentences.en: A problematic supply chain disruption could significantly impact our Q4 sales projections.
sentences.cn: 一个构成问题的供应链中断可能会对我们第四季的销售预测产生重大影响。

trans.tran: 问题；困境；障碍

sentences.en: We need to identify the root problems causing delays in the project.
sentences.cn: 我们需要找出造成项目延迟的根本问题。

sentences.en: The company is facing several problems related to supply chain disruptions.
sentences.cn: 公司正面临几个与供应链中断相关的问题。

trans.tran: 进程；步骤；操作流程

sentences.en: Please follow the standard procedure for submitting expense reports.
sentences.cn: 请依照标准进程提交费用报销。

sentences.en: The company is reviewing its hiring procedure to ensure fairness and efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在审查其招聘进程，以确保公平和效率。

trans.tran: 标准作业流程；进程

sentences.en: All employees must follow the company's safety procedures.
sentences.cn: 所有员工都必须遵守公司的安全进程。

sentences.en: The new return procedure will be implemented starting next month.
sentences.cn: 新的退货进程将从下个月开始实施。

trans.tran: 继续进行；按计划进行

sentences.en: Let's proceed with the next agenda item.
sentences.cn: 我们来进行下个议程项目吧。

sentences.en: If you have no objections, we can proceed with the contract signing.
sentences.cn: 如果没有异议，我们可以继续签订合约。

trans.tran: 会议记录、议事过程；正式的会议纪录或进程。

sentences.en: The conference proceedings will be published online next week.
sentences.cn: 会议记录下周将在网络上发布。

sentences.en: All participants are expected to adhere to the established proceedings of the meeting.
sentences.cn: 所有参与者都应遵守会议的既定进程。

trans.tran: 收益、收入（尤指从销售或活动中获得的）

sentences.en: The company will donate the proceeds from the charity event to local schools.
sentences.cn: 公司将从慈善活动中所得的收益捐给当地学校。

sentences.en: After deducting expenses, the proceeds were significantly lower than expected.
sentences.cn: 扣除费用后，收益远低于预期。

trans.tran: 流程；处理程序；步骤

sentences.en: The company is streamlining its order processing to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在简化订单处理流程以提高效率。

sentences.en: Please process the invoice and submit it to the accounting department.
sentences.cn: 请处理发票并提交至会计部门。

trans.tran: 经过处理的；加工过的（通常指食品或材料，强调经过改进或变更的状态）

sentences.en: The company is shifting towards using more processed foods to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 该公司正转向使用更多加工食品以降低成本。

sentences.en: The quality control department needs to ensure that all processed materials meet the required standards.
sentences.cn: 品质控制部门需要确保所有加工材料符合所需标准。

trans.tran: 流程；进程；处理方式（指一系列步骤或活动，用于达成特定目标）

sentences.en: The company is streamlining its order processing processes to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在简化其订单处理流程以提高效率。

sentences.en: We need to analyze our current business processes to identify areas for improvement.
sentences.cn: 我们需要分析我们目前的业务流程，以找出改进的领域。

trans.tran: 处理；对数据、文档、订单等进行分析、整理或转换的过程

sentences.en: Our accounting department is currently processing the payroll for all employees.
sentences.cn: 我们的会计部门正为全体员工处理薪资。

sentences.en: The system can process up to 10,000 transactions per hour, ensuring fast order processing.
sentences.cn: 该系统每小时可处理多达 10,000 笔交易，确保订单处理快速。

trans.tran: 处理器；中央处理单元 (CPU)，用于运行指令和处理数据。

sentences.en: The company is upgrading its servers with faster processors to improve system performance.
sentences.cn: 公司正在使用更快的处理器升级其服务器，以提高系统性能。

sentences.en: Our IT department is troubleshooting the issue, suspecting a faulty processor.
sentences.cn: 我们的 IT 部门正在处理问题，怀疑是处理器故障。

trans.tran: 正式声明；公开声明

sentences.en: The CEO proclaimed the company's commitment to sustainable practices.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官声明公司对永续发展的承诺。

sentences.en: The government proclaimed a state of emergency due to the severe weather conditions.
sentences.cn: 由于严重的天气状况，政府宣布进入紧急状态。

trans.tran: 延迟处理；拖延（任务或责任）

sentences.en: He tends to procrastinate on important projects, which often leads to missed deadlines.
sentences.cn: 他倾向于延迟重要的项目，这经常导致错过期限。

sentences.en: To improve productivity, employees are encouraged not to procrastinate and prioritize tasks effectively.
sentences.cn: 为了提高生产力，鼓励员工不要拖延，并有效优先处理任务。

trans.tran: 取得；采购；获得（通常指透过购买或订购）

sentences.en: The purchasing department needs to procure office supplies before the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 采购部门需要在月底前采购办公用品。

sentences.en: We need to procure a new software license to comply with the company's regulations.
sentences.cn: 我们需要采购新的软件授权以符合公司规定。

trans.tran: 采购

sentences.en: The procurement department negotiated better terms with suppliers this quarter.
sentences.cn: procurement部门本季与供应商谈判了更好的条款。

sentences.en: Streamlined procurement processes reduced purchasing costs by 15%.
sentences.cn: 简化的procurement流程将采购成本降低了15%。

trans.tran: 1. (动词) 戳；刺；捅；轻推。 2. (动词) 督促；激励；促使。 3. (名词) 戳；刺；捅；轻推。

sentences.en: She prodded him in the ribs to get his attention during the meeting.
sentences.cn: 在会议期间，她轻戳他的肋骨以引起他的注意。

sentences.en: The manager had to prod the team to submit their reports before the deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理不得不督促团队在截止日期前提交报告。

trans.tran: 生产；制造；（产品）成果；（公司/机构）产品

sentences.cn: 该工厂每月可以生产超过 10,000 个单位。

sentences.en: Our company produces high-quality office supplies for businesses worldwide.
sentences.cn: 我们公司为全球企业生产高品质的办公用品。

trans.tran: 制造、生产；（产品）产自

sentences.en: The factory produced over 1,000 units of the new smartphone last week.
sentences.cn: 工厂上周生产了超过 1,000 部新款智能型手机。

sentences.cn: 我们公司为汽车产业生产高品质的零件。
