sentences.en: The client requested a Texas-made product for their promotional event.
sentences.cn: 客户要求德克萨斯州制造的产品用于他们的促销活动。

trans.tran: 短信；文字消息；（电脑）文本

sentences.en: Could you please send me the meeting agenda as a text?
sentences.cn: 您能将会议议程以短信发送给我吗？

sentences.en: The manager asked the employee to proofread the text before sending it to the client.
sentences.cn: 经理请员工在发送给客户之前校对文本。

trans.tran: 教科书；课本

sentences.en: Students are required to purchase the textbook for this course.
sentences.cn: 学生必须购买这门课程的教科书。

sentences.en: The teacher recommended using an old textbook for reference.
sentences.cn: 老师建议使用一本旧教科书作为参考。

trans.tran: 纺织品；布料，尤指用于制造衣物或工业用途的织物。

sentences.en: The company sources high-quality textiles from overseas manufacturers.
sentences.cn: 该公司从海外制造商采购高品质的纺织品。

sentences.en: We need to review the textile samples to ensure they meet our specifications.
sentences.cn: 我们需要审查纺织品样本，以确保它们符合我们的规格。

trans.tran: 短信；消息（通常指电子消息）

sentences.en: The manager asked the team to send him daily progress texts.
sentences.cn: 经理要求团队每天发送进度短信给他。

sentences.en: Please review the texts from the marketing department before the meeting.
sentences.cn: 请在会议前审阅来自行销部门的短信。

trans.tran: 触感、质地；指物体的表面特性，例如粗糙度、光滑度等。

sentences.en: The supplier emphasized the importance of the fabric's texture for the new line of suits.
sentences.cn: 供应商强调了新系列西装的布料质地的重要性。

sentences.en: The quality control department rejected the batch of paper due to its inconsistent texture.
sentences.cn: 由于纸张质地不一致，品质控制部门拒绝了这批纸张。

trans.tran: 泰国，是东南亚的一个国家，在国际贸易和商业活动中经常被提及。

sentences.en: Our company is exploring potential partnerships with businesses in Thailand.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在探索与泰国企业创建合作伙伴关系。

sentences.en: The logistics team is coordinating shipments to Thailand and Vietnam.
sentences.cn: 物流团队正在协调向泰国和越南的货物运输。

trans.tran: 指前往泰国进行观光或商务旅行，通常包含多个地点和活动。

sentences.en: The company is considering organizing a thaitripping for its top sales performers.
sentences.cn: 公司正在考虑为其顶尖销售人员组织一次泰国之旅。

sentences.en: Due to budget constraints, the thaitripping has been postponed until next quarter.
sentences.cn: 由于预算限制，这次泰国之旅已延迟到下个季度。

trans.tran: 比；与...比较（用于比较级或表示差异）

sentences.en: She is taller than her sister.
sentences.cn: 她比她姐姐高。

sentences.en: It's more difficult than I thought.
sentences.cn: 这比我想像的还要困难。

trans.tran: 感谢；道谢

sentences.en: I want to thank you for your support.
sentences.cn: 我想要感谢您的支持。

sentences.en: Many thanks for your prompt reply.
sentences.cn: 非常感谢您的实时回复。

trans.tran: 心怀感激的；对…表示感谢

sentences.en: We are thankful for your continued support and partnership.
sentences.cn: 我们对贵公司的持续支持与合作深表感激。

sentences.en: The team was thankful for the opportunity to present their proposal to the board.
sentences.cn: 团队对有机会向董事会展示提案深感谢意。

trans.tran: 幸运地；值得庆幸地

sentences.en: Thankfully, the shipment arrived on time despite the unexpected delays.
sentences.cn: 值得庆幸的是，尽管出现了意想不到的延误，货物还是按时送达。

sentences.en: Thankfully, the project manager identified the potential issue before it escalated.
sentences.cn: 幸运的是，项目经理在问题恶化之前就发现了潜在的问题。

trans.tran: 感恩节，感谢之情；表示感谢的行为或场合

sentences.en: The company sent a Thanksgiving card to its clients to express gratitude for their continued business.
sentences.cn: 公司向客户寄送了感恩卡，以感谢他们持续的支持。

sentences.en: As a token of our Thanksgiving, we're offering a 10% discount on all products this month.
sentences.cn: 作为我们感恩的回馈，本月所有产品将提供 10% 的折扣。

trans.tran: 融化；解冻

sentences.en: The shipment of frozen goods will thaw during transit if the temperature control system fails.
sentences.cn: 如果温度控制系统故障，这批冷冻货物在运输途中将会解冻。

sentences.en: We need to thaw the meat before we can prepare it for the company luncheon.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在公司午宴前解冻肉类。

trans.tran: 剧场；戏院（通常指表演艺术的场所）

sentences.en: The company rented a theater for the product launch event.
sentences.cn: 公司租下了一间剧场，用于产品发布活动。

sentences.en: The theater group is known for its innovative and engaging performances.
sentences.cn: 这个剧团以其创新且引人入胜的表演而闻名。

trans.tran: 戏剧性的；具有舞台效果的；（指表演或呈现方式）夸张的

sentences.en: The presentation included a theatrical introduction with dramatic lighting and sound effects to capture the audience's attention.
sentences.cn: 为了吸引观众的注意力，演示文稿包含了一个具有戏剧性的介绍，使用了引人注目的灯光和音效。

sentences.en: While the sales pitch was persuasive, the overly theatrical gestures and expressions felt insincere to the potential client.
sentences.cn: 虽然销售演讲很有说服力，但潜在客户觉得过于夸张的手势和表情显得不真诚。

trans.tran: 盗窃；窃盗行为

sentences.en: The company is investigating the theft of confidential documents.
sentences.cn: 公司正在调查机密文档被盗窃的事件。

sentences.en: To prevent theft, security cameras have been installed throughout the office.
sentences.cn: 为了防止盗窃，办公室已安装了监控摄像头。

trans.tran: 主题；主旨；中心思想

sentences.en: The presentation's theme was corporate social responsibility.
sentences.cn: 本次演示文稿的主题是企业社会责任。

sentences.en: Our marketing campaign will revolve around the theme of innovation and sustainability.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销活动将围绕创新和永续发展的主题展开。

trans.tran: 以特定主题为设计或规划的

sentences.en: The hotel offers a variety of themed rooms, such as a Parisian suite and a tropical getaway.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店提供多种主题客房，例如巴黎套房和热带度假村。

sentences.en: The marketing campaign was themed around sustainability to appeal to environmentally conscious consumers.
sentences.cn: 为了吸引重视环境的消费者，行销活动以永续发展为主题。

trans.tran: 主题；主题思想；主旨

sentences.en: The presentation focused on the key themes of sustainability and innovation.
sentences.cn: 本次演示文稿的重点是永续发展和创新的主题。

sentences.en: Our marketing campaign will explore the themes of family and community.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销活动将探讨家庭和社区的主题。

trans.tran: 他们自己；用于指代先前已提及的主体，强调其自行完成的行为。

sentences.en: The team members reviewed the report themselves before submitting it to the manager.
sentences.cn: 团队成员在提交给经理之前，亲自审阅了报告。

sentences.en: Employees are expected to resolve minor technical issues themselves before calling IT support.
sentences.cn: 员工应先自行解决小型技术问题，再联系信息技术支持部门。

trans.tran: 那时；然后；那么；此外

sentences.en: First, complete the report, then send it to your manager.
sentences.cn: 首先，完成报告，然后将其发送给你的经理。

sentences.en: If you can't attend the meeting, then please inform us in advance.
sentences.cn: 如果你无法参加会议，那么请提前通知我们。

trans.tran: (数学) 定理；原理；学说

sentences.en: Pythagoras' theorem is a fundamental concept in geometry.
sentences.cn: 毕氏定理是几何学中的一个基本概念。

sentences.en: The proof of this theorem is quite complex.
sentences.cn: 这个定理的证明相当复杂。

trans.tran: 理论的；理论上的；推想的

sentences.en: The theoretical maximum speed of the internet connection is 1 Gbps, but in practice, it's often lower.
sentences.cn: 网络连接的理论最大速度是每秒1吉比特，但实际上通常会比较低。

sentences.en: From a theoretical perspective, the new system offers significant improvements in efficiency.
sentences.cn: 从理论的角度来看，这个新系统在效率方面提供了显著的改进。

trans.tran: 理论；假说；学说（通常指经过研究或分析提出的解释）

sentences.en: The marketing team is currently testing various theories to determine the most effective advertising campaign.
sentences.cn: 行销团队目前正在测试各种理论，以确定最有效的广告活动。

sentences.en: The project manager needs to analyze the existing theories to identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies.
sentences.cn: 项目经理需要分析现有的理论，以识别潜在风险并制定缓解策略。

trans.tran: 理论家；理论工作者

sentences.en: She is a leading political theorist who has published several influential books.
sentences.cn: 她是一位领先的政治理论家，出版了几本有影响力的著作。

sentences.en: As a scientific theorist, he dedicated his life to developing new hypotheses.
sentences.cn: 作为一名科学理论家，他毕生致力于发展新的假设。

trans.tran: 理论；假说；学说（用以解释现象或解决问题的观点）

sentences.en: The marketing team is developing a new theory to explain the decline in sales.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在发展一个新的理论来解释销售额下降。

sentences.en: Based on the current data, the prevailing theory suggests a shift in consumer preferences.
sentences.cn: 根据目前数据，普遍的理论表明消费者偏好正在转变。

trans.tran: 心理治疗师；咨商师，通常提供心理健康方面的专业协助。

sentences.en: The company offers employees access to a therapist to help manage stress and improve work-life balance.
sentences.cn: 公司为员工提供心理治疗师的服务，以帮助他们管理压力并改善工作与生活平衡。

sentences.en: To ensure employee well-being, the HR department is exploring partnerships with local therapists.
sentences.cn: 为了确保员工的福祉，人力资源部门正在探索与当地心理治疗师合作。

trans.tran: 治疗法；心理辅导

sentences.en: The company offers employee assistance programs, including counseling and therapy services.
sentences.cn: 公司提供员工协助计划，包括咨询和心理辅导服务。

sentences.en: After the stressful merger, several employees sought therapy to manage their anxiety.
sentences.cn: 在压力巨大的并购后，许多员工寻求心理辅导以应对焦虑。

trans.tran: 此后;然后;从那时起

sentences.en: The agreement was signed, and thereafter, the company's market share significantly increased.
sentences.cn: 协议签署后，此后公司的市场份额显著增长。

sentences.en: He completed his training in May and was deployed to the new project site thereafter.
sentences.cn: 他于五月完成训练，此后被部署到新的项目地点。

trans.tran: 因此；从而；借此

sentences.en: He presented a strong argument, thereby convincing the board to approve the project.
sentences.cn: 他提出了有力的论证，因此说服了董事会批准该项目。

sentences.en: The company implemented new security measures, thereby reducing the risk of data breaches.
sentences.cn: 公司实施了新的安全措施，从而降低了数据泄露的风险。

trans.tran: 因此；所以；总之（表示因果关系或逻辑推论）

sentences.en: The project budget was exceeded; therefore, we need to find ways to reduce costs.
sentences.cn: 项目预算超支了；因此，我们需要找到降低成本的方法。

sentences.en: The company's profits increased significantly this quarter; therefore, bonuses will be distributed to all employees.
sentences.cn: 本季公司利润显著增加；因此，将向所有员工发放奖金。

trans.tran: 热的；与热有关的；保暖的

sentences.en: The house has excellent thermal insulation to save energy.
sentences.cn: 这栋房子有极佳的隔热效果以节省能源。

sentences.en: A thermal camera can detect heat signatures from objects.
sentences.cn: 热像仪可以侦测物体发出的热信号。

trans.tran: 论文；学位论文，通常用于表达研究成果或观点。

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to review the thesis on consumer behavior before launching the new campaign.
sentences.cn: 在推出新活动之前，营销团队需要审阅关于消费者行为的论文。

sentences.en: After completing her thesis, she will be eligible for graduation.
sentences.cn: 完成她的论文后，她将有资格毕业。

trans.tran: 厚的；浓的；密的；稠的；粗的

sentences.en: The book is very thick, with over 800 pages.
sentences.cn: 这本书很厚，超过800页。

sentences.en: The fog was so thick that visibility was almost zero.
sentences.cn: 雾非常浓，能见度几乎为零。

trans.tran: 浓密地；厚重地（形容状态或程度，通常指液体、物质或声音等）

sentences.en: The fog rolled in, making it difficult to see the road ahead.
sentences.cn: 浓雾弥漫，使得前方道路难以看清。

sentences.en: He applied the paint thickly to create a textured finish.
sentences.cn: 他厚重地涂上油漆，以创造出带有纹理的表面。

trans.tran: 厚度；浓密；粗细

sentences.en: The thickness of the ice made it safe to walk on.
sentences.cn: 冰的厚度使其可以安全行走。

sentences.en: We need to check the thickness of the steel plate before cutting it.
sentences.cn: 在切割之前，我们需要检查钢板的厚度。

trans.tran: 窃贼；盗贼（指偷窃财物的人）

sentences.en: The company is implementing stricter security measures to prevent theft by employees or thieves.
sentences.cn: 公司正在实施更严格的安全措施，以防止员工或窃贼盗窃。

sentences.en: The investigation revealed that a thief had stolen confidential documents from the office.
sentences.cn: 调查显示，一名窃贼从办公室偷走了机密文档。

trans.tran: 大腿

sentences.en: The runner developed strong thigh muscles.
sentences.cn: 这位跑者练就了强壮的大腿肌肉。

sentences.en: She wore a dress with a high slit on the thigh.
sentences.cn: 她穿了一件大腿处开高衩的洋装。

trans.tran: 稀薄的；纤细的；（文档、材料等）轻薄的

sentences.en: The report needs to be concise and thin, focusing only on the key findings.
sentences.cn: 这份报告需要简洁且轻薄，仅关注主要发现。

sentences.en: We need a thinner packaging material to reduce shipping costs.
sentences.cn: 我们需要更薄的包装材料以降低运输成本。

trans.tran: 事物;东西;事情;用品;情况

sentences.en: Please put your things away after you've finished using them.
sentences.cn: 用完后请把你的东西收起来。

sentences.en: The most important thing is to communicate clearly with your team.
sentences.cn: 最重要的事情是与你的团队清晰地沟通。

trans.tran: 思考;认为;觉得

sentences.en: I think we should discuss this further in the meeting.
sentences.cn: 我认为我们应该在会议中进一步讨论这件事。

sentences.en: She is thinking about new strategies to improve sales.
sentences.cn: 她正在思考改善销售的新策略。

trans.tran: 第三；接着，作为第三点

sentences.en: Firstly, we need to analyze the market trends. Secondly, we should develop a marketing strategy. Thirdly, we'll implement the plan.
sentences.cn: 首先，我们需要分析市场趋势。其次，我们应该制定营销策略。第三，我们将实施计划。

sentences.en: Thirdly, the company will invest in employee training to improve productivity.
sentences.cn: 第三，公司将投资员工培训以提高生产力。

trans.tran: 口渴；渴望，渴求

sentences.en: She quenched her thirst with a glass of water.
sentences.cn: 她用一杯水解了渴。

sentences.en: The team has a great thirst for success.
sentences.cn: 这个团队对成功有着巨大的渴望。

trans.tran: 口渴的；渴望的，渴求的

sentences.en: After jogging for an hour, I was very thirsty.
sentences.cn: 慢跑一小时后，我非常口渴。

sentences.en: The company is thirsty for new talent to join their team.
sentences.cn: 这家公司渴望新人才加入他们的团队。

trans.tran: 三十（个/元/等）；三十的数量

sentences.en: The project budget is approximately thirty thousand dollars.
sentences.cn: 这个项目的预算大约是三万美元。

sentences.en: We need thirty employees to cover the holiday rush.
sentences.cn: 我们需要三十名员工来应付节假日期间的业务高峰。

trans.tran: 彻底的；详尽周到的；仔细的

sentences.en: The auditor conducted a thorough review of the company's financial records.
sentences.cn: 审计员对公司的财务记录进行了彻底的审查。

sentences.en: Before launching the new product, the marketing team needs to conduct thorough market research.
sentences.cn: 在推出新产品之前，营销团队需要进行彻底的市场调查。

trans.tran: 彻底地；完全地；仔细地（表示某事被运行或检查非常周到、详细）

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to research the target market thoroughly before launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 在推出新产品之前，行销团队需要彻底研究目标市场。

sentences.en: The auditor reviewed all financial records thoroughly to ensure accuracy.
sentences.cn: 审计员仔细审阅了所有财务记录，以确保准确性。

trans.tran: 虽然；即使；尽管

sentences.en: Though the project faced some delays, the team managed to deliver it on time.
sentences.cn: 尽管项目遇到了一些延迟，团队还是成功地按时交付了它。

sentences.en: Though the sales figures were lower than expected, we remain optimistic about future growth.
sentences.cn: 虽然销售数字低于预期，我们仍然对未来的增长持乐观态度。

trans.tran: 深思熟虑地；经过仔细考虑地

sentences.en: The manager reviewed the proposal thoughtfully before making a decision.
sentences.cn: 经理在做出决定前，深思熟虑地审阅了提案。

sentences.en: Please respond to the email thoughtfully, considering the potential impact on our reputation.
sentences.cn: 请深思熟虑地回复这封电子邮件，考虑到这可能对我们声誉造成的影响。

trans.tran: 一千；数千

sentences.en: The small business secured a loan for a thousand dollars.
sentences.cn: 这家小型企业获得了一千美元的贷款。

sentences.en: Thousands of people attended the annual conference.
sentences.cn: 数千人参加了这次年度会议。

trans.tran: 数千；成千上万（指数量庞大，通常用于商务情境中表示销售量、预算、员工数量等）

sentences.en: The company sold thousands of units during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 该公司在节假日期间售出了成千上万的产品。

sentences.en: The project budget exceeds thousands of dollars.
sentences.cn: 这个项目的预算超过了数千美元。

trans.tran: 线，细丝；螺纹；（谈话、讨论、故事等的）主线，思路，脉络；（电脑）线程；线索

sentences.en: Could you please review the entire email thread before our meeting?
sentences.cn: 在我们开会前，您能审阅整个电子邮件的讨论串吗？

sentences.en: She carefully threaded the needle to start sewing.
sentences.cn: 她小心翼翼地把线穿过针眼，开始缝纫。

trans.tran: 潜在的危险或威胁，可能导致损害或不利后果。

sentences.en: The company is taking steps to mitigate the threat of cyberattacks.
sentences.cn: 公司正在采取措施来降低网络攻击的威胁。

sentences.en: The supplier threatened to discontinue service if payment wasn't received by the deadline.
sentences.cn: 如果未能在截止日期前收到付款，供应商威胁要停止服务。

trans.tran: 威胁；恐吓；使…受到威胁

sentences.en: The company threatened to take legal action if the supplier failed to meet the delivery deadline.
sentences.cn: 如果供应商未能达到交货期限，公司威胁将采取法律行动。

sentences.en: The manager warned the employee that their job was threatened if productivity didn't improve.
sentences.cn: 经理警告员工，如果生产力没有改善，他们的职位将受到威胁。

trans.tran: 门槛；极限；最低限度（通常指需要达到才能获得某种结果的标准或数值）

sentences.en: The company's sales threshold for bonuses is $1 million per quarter.
sentences.cn: 该公司的季度奖金销售门槛为 100 万美元。

sentences.en: We need to lower the minimum order threshold to attract more small businesses.
sentences.cn: 我们需要降低最低订单门槛，以吸引更多小型企业。

trans.tran: 节俭的；精打细算的，尤其指在花费上

sentences.en: Our company is committed to being thrifty with resources to maximize profits.
sentences.cn: 我们公司致力于精打细算地使用资源，以最大化利润。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense reports by Thursday to ensure timely reimbursement.
sentences.cn: 请在星期四前提交您的费用报表，以确保及时报销。

sentences.cn: 该员工因访问公司网络上的未经授权文件而被训诫。

sentences.en: All software installations must be approved by IT to prevent unauthorized access.
sentences.cn: 为了防止未经授权的访问，所有软件安装都必须由 IT 部门批准。

trans.tran: 不可用的；无法取得的；没有空闲的

sentences.en: The project manager informed the team that the key software license was unavailable due to a system upgrade.
sentences.cn: 项目经理告知团队，由于系统升级，关键软件授权目前不可用。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, the conference room is unavailable for booking until next week.
sentences.cn: 抱歉，会议室在下周之前无法预订。

trans.tran: 不可避免的；无法避免的

sentences.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances, the project deadline is unavoidable.
sentences.cn: 由于突发状况，项目截止日期不可避免。

sentences.en: The company accepted the unavoidable costs associated with the restructuring.
sentences.cn: 公司接受了与重组相关的不可避免的成本。

trans.tran: 无可匹敌的；胜无可胜的；极其优秀

sentences.en: Our new product's features are unbeatable, giving us a significant advantage in the market.
sentences.cn: 我们新产品的功能无可匹敌，使我们在市场上拥有显著优势。

sentences.en: The company's reputation for quality and reliability makes its services unbeatable in the industry.
sentences.cn: 公司在品质和可靠性方面的声誉，使其在行业内提供无可匹敌的服务。

trans.tran: 难以置信的；令人难以相信的，通常指超出常理或期望。

sentences.en: The company's quarterly profits were unbelievable, exceeding all previous forecasts.
sentences.cn: 该公司的季度利润令人难以置信，远超所有之前的预测。

sentences.en: The speed at which the project was completed was unbelievable, thanks to the team's dedication.
sentences.cn: 由于团队的奉献精神，该项目的完成速度令人难以置信。

trans.tran: 公正的；客观的；不带偏见的

sentences.en: The report aims to provide an unbiased assessment of the company's performance.
sentences.cn: 这份报告旨在对公司的绩效提供公正的评估。

sentences.en: We need an unbiased third party to mediate the dispute between the two departments.
sentences.cn: 我们需要公正的第三方来调解两个部门之间的争端。

trans.tran: 不确定的；未经肯定的；存在疑虑的

sentences.en: The project timeline is uncertain due to potential supply chain disruptions.
sentences.cn: 由於潜在的供应链中断，项目时间表尚不明确。

sentences.en: The company's future plans remain uncertain until the market stabilizes.
sentences.cn: 直到市场稳定，公司的未来计划仍然不确定。

trans.tran: 不确定性；不确定状态；不确定因素

sentences.en: There is still much uncertainty about the economic outlook for next year.
sentences.cn: 关于明年的经济前景，仍存在很多不确定性。

sentences.en: The manager addressed the team's uncertainty regarding the new project deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理解决了团队对于新项目截止日期的不确定性。

trans.tran: 未改变的; 保持原样的

sentences.en: Despite the market fluctuations, the company's policy remained unchanged.
sentences.cn: 尽管市场波动，公司的政策保持不变。

sentences.en: His opinion on the matter has been unchanged for years.
sentences.cn: 他对这件事的看法多年来一直没有改变。

trans.tran: 伯父; 叔父; 舅父; 姑父; 姨父 (泛指父亲或母亲的兄弟或他们的配偶的兄弟)

sentences.en: My uncle is coming to visit us next week.
sentences.cn: 我的叔叔下周要来看我们。

sentences.en: She always enjoys spending time with her favorite uncle.
sentences.cn: 她总是喜欢和她最喜欢的舅舅一起度过时光。

trans.tran: 不清楚的；不明确的；模糊的

sentences.en: The instructions for the new software were unclear, causing confusion among the users.
sentences.cn: 新软件的说明不清楚，造成用户之间的困惑。

sentences.en: It's still unclear whether the project will be approved by the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 目前仍不清楚该项目是否会在月底前获得批准。

trans.tran: 不舒服的；不自在的；令人不安的

sentences.en: I felt uncomfortable in the tight suit during the presentation.
sentences.cn: 在演示文稿期间，我穿着那件紧身西装感到很不舒服。

sentences.en: She felt uncomfortable discussing her personal life with her new colleagues.
sentences.cn: 她与新同事讨论个人生活时感到不自在。

trans.tran: 不舒服地；令人感到不适地

sentences.en: The air conditioning was set too low, and the attendees felt uncomfortably cold during the presentation.
sentences.cn: 空调设置过低，导致与会者在演示文稿过程中感到不舒服的寒冷。

sentences.en: He leaned uncomfortably close to the client, making her feel uneasy.
sentences.cn: 他靠近客户的距离太近，让客户感到不自在。

trans.tran: 无条件地；完全地；不附加任何条件地

sentences.en: The company offers an unconditional guarantee on all its products.
sentences.cn: 公司对所有产品提供无条件保证。

sentences.en: We unconditionally support your decision to pursue this new project.
sentences.cn: 我们完全支持您推动这个新项目的决定。

trans.tran: 揭露；发现；探明真相

sentences.en: The investigation team hopes to uncover any fraudulent activities within the company.
sentences.cn: 调查团队希望揭露公司内部的任何欺诈活动。

sentences.en: The journalist's research uncovered a significant flaw in the product's design.
sentences.cn: 这位记者的研究揭示了产品设计中的一个重大缺陷。

trans.tran: 无可否认的；显而易见的；不容置疑的

sentences.en: The company's success is undeniable, thanks to its innovative marketing strategies.
sentences.cn: 凭借其创新的行销策略，公司的成功是无可否认的。

sentences.en: The data clearly shows an undeniable increase in sales following the product launch.
sentences.cn: 数据清楚地显示，产品上市后销售额显著增加。

trans.tran: 在...下方；低于；在...控制下；在...情况下；根据...

sentences.en: The cat is sleeping under the table.
sentences.cn: 猫咪在桌子下面睡觉。

sentences.en: The project is still under development and will be launched next quarter.
sentences.cn: 该项目仍在开发中，预计下个季度推出。

trans.tran: 低估收费；收取过低的费用

sentences.en: The accounting department discovered that the vendor was undercharging us for the raw materials.
sentences.cn: 会计部门发现供应商为我们提供的原材料收取了过低的费用。

sentences.en: We need to review the pricing structure to ensure we aren't undercharging our clients for the premium services.
sentences.cn: 我们需要审查定价结构，以确保我们没有为我们的客户收费过低。

trans.tran: 低估；评估不足，未充分认识到其重要性或程度

sentences.en: The project manager underestimated the time required to complete the task.
sentences.cn: 项目经理低估了完成任务所需的时间。

sentences.en: We shouldn't underestimate the impact of this new regulation on our sales figures.
sentences.cn: 我们不应低估这项新规对我们销售数字的影响。

trans.tran: 经历；承受；接受（某种过程或变化）

sentences.en: The company is undergoing a significant restructuring to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 公司正在进行重大的重组以提高效率。

sentences.en: All new employees must undergo a thorough background check.
sentences.cn: 所有新员工都必须接受彻底的背景调查。

trans.tran: 正在经历；处于进行中

sentences.en: The company is undergoing a major restructuring to improve efficiency.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在进行一项重大的重组，以提高效率。

sentences.en: The project is undergoing final testing before its official launch.
sentences.cn: 在正式发布之前，该项目正在进行最后的测试。

trans.tran: 大学生（指尚未取得学士学位者），通常指就读大学或学院的学生。

sentences.en: The company offers internship opportunities specifically for undergraduate students.
sentences.cn: 公司提供特别为大学生设计的实习机会。

sentences.en: Many undergraduate applicants are eager to gain practical experience before graduation.
sentences.cn: 许多大学生申请者都渴望在毕业前获得实务经验。

trans.tran: 地下的；位于地下的；（交通）地铁

sentences.en: The company is exploring the possibility of building an underground parking facility.
sentences.cn: 公司正在探讨建造地下停车设施的可能性。

sentences.en: The subway system provides an underground route to avoid traffic congestion.
sentences.cn: 地铁系统提供地下路线以避免交通拥堵。

trans.tran: 作为…的基础；构成…的基础；在…的下面

sentences.en: The fundamental principles that underlie her management style are strong communication and trust.
sentences.cn: 构成她管理风格的基本原则是强而有力的沟通和信任。

sentences.en: Several complex factors underlie the current economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 当前经济衰退的背后有几个复杂的因素。

trans.tran: 划线强调；在...下划线

sentences.en: Please underline the key terms in the contract to ensure clarity.
sentences.cn: 请在合约中划线强调重点条款，以确保清晰。

sentences.en: The editor asked me to underline any grammatical errors in the draft report.
sentences.cn: 编辑请我划线标记草稿报告中的任何语法错误。

trans.tran: 潜在的；根本的；基础的（指事物背后隐藏的或未被明确表达的原因或因素）

sentences.en: The underlying cause of the project's delay was a lack of communication between departments.
sentences.cn: 项目延迟的根本原因在于各部门之间的沟通不足。

sentences.en: The company's success is based on the underlying principles of innovation and customer satisfaction.
sentences.cn: 该公司的成功创建在创新和客户满意度的基础之上。

trans.tran: 削弱；损害；逐渐破坏（尤指悄悄地破坏某人的权威或信心，或某事物的根基）

sentences.en: Constant criticism can undermine an employee's confidence.
sentences.cn: 持续的批评会削弱员工的自信心。

sentences.en: The new policy could undermine the company's efforts to reduce waste.
sentences.cn: 这项新政策可能会损害公司减少浪费的努力。

trans.tran: 在...下方；位于...之下

sentences.en: The server room is located underneath the main office building.
sentences.cn: 服务器室位于主要办公楼的下方。

sentences.en: Please store the documents underneath the desk for safekeeping.
sentences.cn: 请将文档放在桌子下方妥善保管。

trans.tran: 涵洞；人行地下通道（通常用于交通繁忙的区域，让行人或车辆安全通过）

sentences.en: To avoid the heavy traffic, pedestrians can use the underpass.
sentences.cn: 为了避开严重的交通，行人可以使用涵洞。

sentences.en: The construction company is responsible for building a new underpass to improve traffic flow.
sentences.cn: 该建设公司负责建造新的涵洞以改善交通流量。

trans.tran: 支撑；巩固；作为…的基础

sentences.en: A strong economy underpins the government's social welfare programs.
sentences.cn: 强劲的经济支撑着政府的社会福利计划。

sentences.en: The research findings underpin the new policy recommendations.
sentences.cn: 这些研究结果巩固了新的政策建议。

trans.tran: 能力不足以胜任职位或任务，缺乏必要的技能或资历。

sentences.en: The HR department decided not to hire him because he was underqualified for the position.
sentences.cn: 人事部门决定不雇用他，因为他缺乏胜任该职位所需的资历。

sentences.en: Despite his enthusiasm, he admitted he felt a bit underqualified to lead the project.
sentences.cn: 尽管他充满热情，但他坦承自己对领导这个项目感到有些力不足。

trans.tran: 人员不足，人力短缺，导致工作负荷过重。

sentences.en: The department is currently understaffed due to several employees taking extended leave.
sentences.cn: 由于多名员工长期请假，部门目前人员不足。

sentences.en: To improve customer satisfaction, we need to address the issue of being understaffed during peak hours.
sentences.cn: 为了提高客户满意度，我们需要解决在高峰时段人员不足的问题。

trans.tran: 理解；领会；明白

sentences.en: Could you please clarify the terms of the contract so I can fully understand the agreement?
sentences.cn: 您能请解释一下合约的条款，以便我能完全理解这项协议吗？

sentences.en: The manager needs to understand the team's concerns before making a decision.
sentences.cn: 经理在做出决定之前，需要了解团队的顾虑。

trans.tran: 易于理解的；容易被理解的，通常指信息或说明清晰明了，能够被对方接收和理解。

sentences.en: The presentation was very understandable, thanks to the clear visuals and concise explanations.
sentences.cn: 由于视觉效果清晰且解释简洁，演示文稿非常易于理解。

sentences.en: To ensure effective communication, the instructions must be understandable to all team members.
sentences.cn: 为了确保有效的沟通，说明必须让所有团队成员都能理解。

trans.tran: 理解；领悟；洞察力

sentences.en: A clear understanding of the contract terms is essential before signing.
sentences.cn: 签署合约前，对合约条款的充分理解至关重要。

sentences.en: The manager needs to ensure that all team members have a shared understanding of the project goals.
sentences.cn: 经理需要确保所有团队成员对项目目标有共同的理解。

trans.tran: 理解；领会；明白

sentences.en: The client understands the revised contract terms and conditions.
sentences.cn: 客户理解了修改后的合约条款和条件。

sentences.en: Does the manager understand the urgency of this project?
sentences.cn: 经理是否理解这个项目的紧急性？

trans.tran: 低估；简略陈述；委婉语（指故意或无意地将某事的重要性或程度淡化）

sentences.en: Saying the project was slightly delayed is a significant understatement; it's actually three months behind schedule.
sentences.cn: 说这个项目稍微延迟是个很大的低估，实际上它已经延迟了三个月。

sentences.en: To say the company's profits increased modestly is an understatement considering the record-breaking sales figures.
sentences.cn: 说公司利润仅适度增加是个低估，因为销售额创下了历史新高。

trans.tran: 承担；负责；致力于（某项任务或计划）

sentences.en: The company undertakes to deliver the goods within 10 business days.
sentences.cn: 公司承诺在 10 个工作天内交付商品。

sentences.en: We undertake a thorough market analysis before launching the new product.
sentences.cn: 我们在推出新产品之前，会进行全面的市场分析。

trans.tran: 低估价值；轻视；贬低

sentences.en: Many companies undervalue the importance of employee training.
sentences.cn: 许多公司低估了员工培训的重要性。

sentences.en: The property was undervalued by the appraiser, leading to a lower sale price.
sentences.cn: 该房产被估价师低估了价值，导致售价降低。

trans.tran: 水下的；位于水面以下的

sentences.en: The company is exploring the possibility of underwater construction for the new port facility.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在探讨为新的港口设施进行水下施工的可能性。

sentences.en: Divers carefully inspected the underwater pipeline for any signs of damage.
sentences.cn: 潜水员仔细检查水下管道，以寻找任何损坏迹象。

trans.tran: 在进行中的；正在发生的；已开始的

sentences.en: The construction project is well underway and expected to finish on schedule.
sentences.cn: 这项建设项目正顺利进行中，预计将如期完成。

sentences.en: Discussions for the new partnership are already underway.
sentences.cn: 关于新合作伙伴关系的讨论已经在进行中了。

trans.tran: 承保；为…提供保险；为…提供财政支持；为…提供担保

sentences.en: The bank agreed to underwrite the new company's stock offering.
sentences.cn: 银行同意承销这家新公司的股票发行。

sentences.en: Many insurance companies refuse to underwrite policies for houses in flood-prone areas.
sentences.cn: 许多保险公司拒绝为洪水易发地区的房屋承保。

trans.tran: 承销商；保险核保人

sentences.en: The investment bank acted as the lead underwriter for the IPO.
sentences.cn: 该投资银行担任首次公开募股（IPO）的主承销商。

sentences.en: An underwriter evaluates the risk of insuring clients and determines policy terms.
sentences.cn: 核保人评估为客户提供保险的风险并确定保单条款。

trans.tran: 毫不退缩的；意志坚定的

sentences.en: Despite the initial setbacks, the team remained undeterred in their pursuit of the project's completion.
sentences.cn: 尽管一开始遇到挫折，团队仍然毫不退缩地致力于完成项目。

sentences.en: The company's undeterred commitment to innovation has led to significant market growth.
sentences.cn: 公司对创新的毫不退缩的承诺已导致市场显著增长。

trans.tran: 毫无疑问地；确实地；肯定地

sentences.en: The project was completed ahead of schedule, undoubtedly a result of the team's dedication.
sentences.cn: 项目提前完成，毫无疑问这是团队奉献的结果。

sentences.en: The company's commitment to sustainability is undoubtedly a key factor in attracting investors.
sentences.cn: 公司对永续发展的承诺毫无疑问是吸引投资者的关键因素。

trans.tran: 不安感；焦虑感，通常源于不确定性或潜在的威胁。

sentences.en: The manager sensed an unease among the team members regarding the new project timeline.
sentences.cn: 经理察觉到团队成员对于新的项目时程表感到不安。

sentences.en: Despite the company's assurances, a lingering unease remained about the potential layoffs.
sentences.cn: 尽管公司保证，但对於潜在的裁员，仍然存在着一种挥之不去的焦虑。

trans.tran: 失业的；没有工作的

sentences.en: Due to the company's restructuring, a significant number of employees are now unemployed.
sentences.cn: 由于公司重组，相当多员工目前失业了。

sentences.en: The government is offering job training programs to help unemployed individuals find new employment.
sentences.cn: 政府正在提供就业培训计划，以帮助失业人士找到新工作。

trans.tran: 失业率；失业状态，指劳动力市场中找不到工作的人的比例或状态。

sentences.en: The company is offering retraining programs to combat rising unemployment rates.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在提供再培训计划以应对不断上升的失业率。

sentences.en: Due to the economic downturn, unemployment has significantly increased in the manufacturing sector.
sentences.cn: 由于经济下滑，制造业的失业人数显著增加。

trans.tran: 出乎意料的；未预期的

sentences.en: The project faced an unexpected delay due to a supplier's issue.
sentences.cn: 由于供应商的问题，项目面临了出乎意料的延迟。

sentences.en: The company announced an unexpected profit increase, surprising investors.
sentences.cn: 公司宣布利润意外增加，令投资者感到惊讶。

trans.tran: 出乎意料地；意外地

sentences.en: The project was completed unexpectedly ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 这个项目出乎意料地提前完成。

sentences.en: The company experienced an unexpectedly high demand for its new product.
sentences.cn: 该公司对其新产品的需求出乎意料地高。

trans.tran: 不公平的；不公正的；不合理的

sentences.en: The promotion process seemed unfair, as seniority was not considered.
sentences.cn: 晋升流程显得不公平，因为没有考虑到资历。

sentences.en: It's unfair to penalize employees for mistakes made due to inadequate training.
sentences.cn: 因缺乏适当培训而犯错的员工受到惩罚是不公平的。

trans.tran: 不公平地；以不公正的方式

sentences.en: The employee felt he was unfairly dismissed without proper notice.
sentences.cn: 这位员工认为自己没有得到适当通知就被不公平地解雇了。

sentences.en: The company is being accused of unfairly favoring certain vendors in the bidding process.
sentences.cn: 该公司被指控在招标过程中不公平地偏袒某些供应商。

trans.tran: 不熟悉的；陌生的

sentences.en: The new employee felt a bit unfamiliar with the company's internal procedures.
sentences.cn: 这位新进员工对公司的内部流程感到有些陌生。

sentences.en: Despite the unfamiliar terminology, the training materials were easy to understand.
sentences.cn: 尽管使用了不熟悉的术语，但训练材料却很容易理解。

trans.tran: 不利的；不好的；不尽如人意的

sentences.en: The company's financial performance was unfavorable due to the economic downturn.
sentences.cn: 由于经济衰退，公司的财务表现不佳。

sentences.en: Despite the unfavorable weather conditions, the construction project is still on schedule.
sentences.cn: 尽管天气状况不佳，但施工项目仍在按计划进行。

trans.tran: 难以忘怀的；令人难以忘怀的，通常指经历或体验。

sentences.en: The conference was an unforgettable experience for all attendees, thanks to the insightful speakers and networking opportunities.
sentences.cn: благодаря insightful speakers и возможности для общения, конференция стала незабываемым опытом для всех участников.

sentences.en: The company hopes to create an unforgettable brand image that resonates with customers.
sentences.cn: 公司希望创造出令人难忘的品牌形象，与客户产生共鸣。

trans.tran: 不幸的；令人遗憾的；遭遇不幸的

sentences.en: It was unfortunate that the shipment was delayed due to the unexpected weather conditions.
sentences.cn: 由于突如其来的恶劣天气状况，货物延迟非常遗憾。

sentences.en: The company expressed its unfortunate situation regarding the project's budget overrun.
sentences.cn: 公司表达了关于项目预算超支的不幸情况。

trans.tran: 遗憾地；不幸的是

sentences.en: Unfortunately, the shipment will be delayed due to unforeseen circumstances.
sentences.cn: 不幸的是，由于突发状况，货物将会延迟送达。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, we are unable to offer you the position at this time.
sentences.cn: 很遗憾，我们目前无法提供您这个职位。

trans.tran: 不快乐的；不满意的；沮丧的

sentences.en: The team was unhappy with the project's delayed launch.
sentences.cn: 团队对于项目延迟推出感到不满。

sentences.en: He seemed unhappy about the budget cuts.
sentences.cn: 他似乎对于预算削减感到沮丧。

trans.tran: 不健康的；对健康有害的

sentences.en: The company is promoting healthier food options to combat an unhealthy work environment.
sentences.cn: 为了改善不健康的职场环境，公司正在推广更健康的食物选择。

sentences.en: Regular exercise and a balanced diet are essential for maintaining an unhealthy lifestyle.
sentences.cn: 规律的运动和均衡的饮食对于避免不健康的的生活方式至关重要。

trans.tran: 制服；统一的，一致的

sentences.en: All security guards are required to wear a uniform while on duty.
sentences.cn: 所有保全人员在值勤时都必须穿着制服。

sentences.en: The company aims to provide a uniform customer experience across all its branches.
sentences.cn: 公司旨在为所有分公司的客户提供一致的服务体验。

trans.tran: 制服；员工制服

sentences.en: All employees are required to wear the company uniforms while on duty.
sentences.cn: 所有员工在工作时都必须穿着公司制服。

sentences.en: The HR department is responsible for ordering and distributing new uniforms to staff.
sentences.cn: 人力资源部门负责订购并向员工发放新的制服。

trans.tran: 统一；使联合；使一致

sentences.en: The company decided to unify all its branding under a single logo.
sentences.cn: 该公司决定将其所有品牌统一在一个标志之下。

sentences.en: Their efforts helped unify the team and improve overall performance.
sentences.cn: 他们的努力有助于团结团队并提高整体绩效。

trans.tran: 未被居住的；荒无人烟的

sentences.en: The company is considering purchasing the uninhabited island for a resort development.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在考虑购买该荒岛，以发展度假村。

sentences.en: Despite its remote location and uninhabited status, the property offers stunning views.
sentences.cn: 尽管其位置偏远且荒无人烟，该房产却提供令人惊叹的景色。

trans.tran: 难以理解的；含糊不清的；费解的；无法听懂或辨认的

sentences.en: His handwriting was almost unintelligible, so I couldn't read the note.
sentences.cn: 他的笔迹几乎难以辨认，所以我无法阅读那张便条。

sentences.en: The speaker's voice became unintelligible due to the poor microphone quality.
sentences.cn: 由于麦克风品质不佳，演讲者的声音变得难以听懂。

trans.tran: 对...不感兴趣；漠不关心

sentences.en: The manager noticed that several employees were uninterested in the new training program.
sentences.cn: 经理注意到，几位员工对新的培训计划不感兴趣。

sentences.en: Despite the incentives, many potential investors remained uninterested in the startup's proposal.
sentences.cn: 尽管有奖励，许多潜在投资人仍然对初创公司的提案不感兴趣。

trans.tran: 工会；联合会；结合

sentences.en: The company is negotiating a new contract with the employees' union.
sentences.cn: 公司正在与员工工会协商新的合约。

sentences.en: To ensure fair labor practices, the union representatives will be present at the meeting.
sentences.cn: 为了确保公平的劳工实践，工会代表将出席会议。

trans.tran: 工会；劳工联合会

sentences.en: The company is negotiating a new contract with the unions to improve employee benefits.
sentences.cn: 公司正在与工会协商新的合约，以改善员工福利。

sentences.en: The unions are demanding better working conditions and higher wages for their members.
sentences.cn: 工会要求为其成员提供更好的工作条件和更高的工资。

trans.tran: 独特的；前所未有的，与众不同的

sentences.en: This marketing campaign features a unique approach to reach a wider audience.
sentences.cn: 这项行销活动采用独特的策略来接触更广泛的受众。

sentences.en: The company's unique selling proposition is its commitment to sustainable practices.
sentences.cn: 该公司的独特销售主张是其对永续发展的承诺。

trans.tran: 独特性

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative uniqueness procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的uniqueness进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the uniqueness implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了uniqueness影响。

trans.tran: 单位；指组织内的独立部门或部份，也可指计量的基本量。

sentences.en: Our marketing unit will launch the new campaign next month.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销部门将于下个月推出新活动。

sentences.en: Each unit of the product is packaged in a recyclable box.
sentences.cn: 每个产品单位都装在可回收的盒子里。

trans.tran: 联合；结合；使团结

sentences.en: The company aims to unite its departments to streamline operations.
sentences.cn: 公司旨在联合各部门以简化营运流程。

sentences.en: The merger will unite two leading firms in the industry.
sentences.cn: 这项并购将联合业界两家领先企业。

trans.tran: 联合的；团结的；由多个部门或公司共同合作的

sentences.en: The united sales team exceeded its quarterly target by 15%.
sentences.cn: 联合的销售团队将季度目标超过了 15%。

sentences.en: We need to unite the marketing and product departments to launch the new campaign.
sentences.cn: 我们需要将行销部门与产品部门结合起来，以推出新活动。

trans.tran: 单位；单元（指数量、时间、部门等的分划）

sentences.en: We need to produce 1000 units of this product per month.
sentences.cn: 我们每月需要生产 1000 个这个产品的单位。

sentences.en: The company is divided into several departments, each operating as a separate unit.
sentences.cn: 公司被划分为几个部门，每个部门都以独立单位运作。

trans.tran: 统一；团结；和谐；整体

sentences.en: The team's unity was key to their success in the project.
sentences.cn: 团队的团结是他们在项目中取得成功的关键。

sentences.en: We need to work towards greater unity among all departments.
sentences.cn: 我们需要努力促进所有部门之间更紧密的团结。

trans.tran: 普遍的；宇宙

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative universal procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的universal进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the universal implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了universal影响。

trans.tran: 宇宙；天地万物；领域；范围

sentences.en: Scientists are constantly seeking to understand the vastness of the universe.
sentences.cn: 科学家们不断地寻求理解宇宙的浩瀚。

sentences.en: The company operates in a highly competitive digital universe.
sentences.cn: 这家公司在一个竞争激烈的数字领域中运营。

trans.tran: 大学；高等教育机构（通常指多所大学）

sentences.en: The company offers tuition reimbursement for employees pursuing degrees at accredited universities.
sentences.cn: 公司为员工在认可的大学攻读学位提供学费补助。

sentences.en: Our recruitment team actively partners with leading universities to identify promising graduates.
sentences.cn: 我们的招募团队积极与顶尖大学合作，以寻找有潜力的毕业生。

trans.tran: 大学；学府（通常指提供高等教育的机构）

sentences.en: The company offers tuition reimbursement for employees pursuing degrees at a university.
sentences.cn: 公司为员工在大学进修提供学费补助。

sentences.en: Many graduates from the university are highly sought after by multinational corporations.
sentences.cn: 许多来自该大学的毕业生受到跨国公司的青睐。

trans.tran: 未知的；不熟悉的；尚未被发现的

sentences.en: The report identified several unknown factors that could affect the project's timeline.
sentences.cn: 这份报告指出了几个可能影响项目进度的未知因素。

sentences.en: Due to the unknown nature of the situation, we recommend proceeding with caution.
sentences.cn: 由于情况不明朗，我们建议谨慎行事。

trans.tran: 释放；发挥（潜力、力量等）；让…自由

sentences.en: The new marketing campaign is expected to unleash a wave of customer interest.
sentences.cn: 新的行销活动预计将引发一波客户兴趣。

sentences.en: The company needs to unleash the full potential of its employees to improve productivity.
sentences.cn: 公司需要发挥员工的全部潜力，以提高生产力。

trans.tran: 除非；如果不

sentences.en: You won't understand it unless you read the instructions carefully.
sentences.cn: 除非你仔细阅读说明，否则你不会理解它。

sentences.en: We cannot proceed with the project unless we receive client approval by Friday.
sentences.cn: 除非我们在周五前获得客户批准，否则我们无法推进该项目。

trans.tran: 与...不同；与...不一样

sentences.en: Unlike our competitor, we offer 24/7 customer support.
sentences.cn: 与我们的竞争对手不同，我们提供全天候客户支持。

sentences.en: Unlike the previous model, this new software includes enhanced security features.
sentences.cn: 与之前的型号不同，这个新的软件包含增强的安全性功能。

trans.tran: 不太可能；可能性很小

sentences.en: It's unlikely that the project will be completed on time given the current delays.
sentences.cn: 考虑到目前的延迟，这个项目按时完成的可能性不大。

sentences.en: Due to the company's financial situation, it's unlikely we'll receive a bonus this year.
sentences.cn: 由于公司的财务状况，今年我们不太可能获得奖金。

trans.tran: 无限的；不受限制的；没有上限的

sentences.en: The company offers unlimited access to online training resources for all employees.
sentences.cn: 公司为所有员工提供在线培训资源的无限访问权。

sentences.en: We are currently offering an unlimited data plan for our mobile devices.
sentences.cn: 我们目前为我们的行动设备提供无限流量的方案。

trans.tran: 未列出于公开名录的；未公开的（例如电话号码、地址等）

sentences.en: The company's phone number is unlisted to protect the privacy of its employees.
sentences.cn: 为了保护员工的隐私，该公司的电话号码未列于公开名录。

sentences.en: Please note that this address is unlisted and should not be shared publicly.
sentences.cn: 请注意，此地址未列于公开名录，不应公开分享。

trans.tran: 卸货；将货物从运输工具上卸下

sentences.en: The truck will unload the shipment at the warehouse tomorrow morning.
sentences.cn: 卡车将在明天早上在仓库卸货。

sentences.en: Please ensure all containers are unloaded carefully to avoid damage.
sentences.cn: 请确保所有货柜小心卸载，以避免损坏。

trans.tran: 解除锁定；打开（锁）；解锁；激活

sentences.en: Please unlock your account using the password reset link sent to your email.
sentences.cn: 请使用发送到您电子邮件的密码重置链接来解锁您的帐户。

sentences.en: The IT department will unlock the software license once the payment is confirmed.
sentences.cn: 确认付款后，IT部门将解锁软件授权。

trans.tran: 未满足的；尚未实现的

sentences.en: Despite the company's efforts, several customer needs remain unmet.
sentences.cn: 尽管公司尽了努力，但仍有许多客户需求尚未得到满足。

sentences.en: The project's objectives were not fully met due to unforeseen circumstances.
sentences.cn: 由于一些不可预见的情况，项目目标未能完全实现。

trans.tran: 未命名的；没有名称的

sentences.en: The project file was saved as 'unnamed_document.docx' until a proper title was assigned.
sentences.cn: 在给予正式标题之前，项目文件被保存为 'unnamed_document.docx'。

sentences.en: The company is working to identify and name the unnamed sources of the data leak.
sentences.cn: 公司正在努力识别并命名数据泄露的未命名来源。

trans.tran: 不必要的；多余的

sentences.en: Please review the report and remove any unnecessary details.
sentences.cn: 请审阅报告并删除任何不必要的细节。

sentences.en: We're trying to streamline the process and eliminate unnecessary steps.
sentences.cn: 我们正在努力简化流程并消除不必要的步骤。

trans.tran: 未被占用；空置的；无人的

sentences.en: The conference room is currently unoccupied, so you can use it for your meeting.
sentences.cn: 会议室目前空置中，你可以用来开会。

sentences.en: We need to find a new office space because our current one is becoming increasingly unoccupied due to downsizing.
sentences.cn: 由于裁员，我们需要寻找新的办公空间，因为我们目前的办公室越来越空置。

trans.tran: 卸货；拆开行李箱

sentences.en: The shipping department will unpack the new inventory upon arrival.
sentences.cn: 新货到货后，运输部门将会将其卸货。

sentences.en: After a long flight, the first thing I want to do is unpack my suitcase.
sentences.cn: 长途飞行后，我最想做的事情就是拆开我的行李箱。

trans.tran: 未付清的；未偿还的

sentences.en: The company has a significant amount of unpaid invoices from overseas clients.
sentences.cn: 公司有来自海外客户的许多未付清的发票。

sentences.en: Employees are required to submit timesheets to ensure accurate calculation of unpaid overtime.
sentences.cn: 员工需要提交工时表，以确保准确计算未付加班费。

trans.tran: 令人不快的；不愉快的；不舒服的

sentences.en: The meeting was unpleasant due to the heated argument between the two managers.
sentences.cn: 由于两位经理之间的激烈争论，会议气氛令人不快。

sentences.en: We apologize for the unpleasant experience you had with our product; we are working to improve it.
sentences.cn: 对于您在使用我们产品时的不愉快体验，我们深表歉意；我们正在努力改进。

trans.tran: 拔掉插头；断开电源

sentences.en: Before cleaning the server, remember to unplug it from the power outlet.
sentences.cn: 在清洁服务器之前，请记得从电源插座上拔掉插头。

sentences.en: To conserve energy, please unplug your laptop charger when it's fully charged.
sentences.cn: 为了节省能源，请在笔记本电脑充电完成后拔掉充电器。

trans.tran: 不受欢迎的

sentences.en: The company's new policy proved to be very unpopular with its employees.
sentences.cn: 公司的新政策在员工中非常不受欢迎。

sentences.en: His unpopular opinions often led to heated debates during meetings.
sentences.cn: 他不受欢迎的观点经常在会议中引发激烈的辩论。

trans.tran: 前所未有的；空前的；史无前例的

sentences.en: The company faced unprecedented challenges due to the global pandemic.
sentences.cn: 由于全球疫情，公司面临前所未有的挑战。

sentences.en: This quarter's sales figures are unprecedented, exceeding all previous records.
sentences.cn: 本季的销售数字空前绝后，超越了所有之前的纪录。

trans.tran: 不可预测的；变幻莫测的

sentences.en: The weather in this region is notoriously unpredictable.
sentences.cn: 这个地区的天气出了名的变幻莫测。

sentences.en: The market can be unpredictable, so it's wise to diversify your investments.
sentences.cn: 市场可能不可预测，所以分散投资是明智之举。

trans.tran: 解开（谜团、复杂问题）；阐明；瓦解；（线团或织物）散开

sentences.en: The investigators worked hard to unravel the complex web of financial fraud.
sentences.cn: 调查人员努力解开这错综复杂的金融诈骗网。

sentences.en: Their carefully constructed argument began to unravel under close questioning.
sentences.cn: 他们精心建构的论点在仔细盘问下开始瓦解。

trans.tran: 不真实的；虚幻的；难以置信的

sentences.en: The special effects in the movie were so good, they made the fantasy world seem almost unreal.
sentences.cn: 电影中的特效非常出色，让奇幻世界看起来几乎不真实。

sentences.en: It feels unreal to finally achieve this goal after years of hard work.
sentences.cn: 经过多年的努力，终于达成这个目标，感觉很不真实。

trans.tran: 不合理；不合逻辑；过于严苛

sentences.en: The company found the supplier's pricing demands unreasonable.
sentences.cn: 公司认为供应商的价格要求不合理。

sentences.en: The employee felt the deadline was unreasonable given the scope of the project.
sentences.cn: 员工认为考虑到项目的范围，这个期限不合理。

trans.tran: 不相关的；无关的

sentences.en: The two incidents appear to be completely unrelated.
sentences.cn: 这两起事件似乎完全不相关。

sentences.en: His comments were unrelated to the main topic of the meeting.
sentences.cn: 他的评论与会议的主要议题无关。

trans.tran: 不可靠的；不值得信赖的，容易出错的

sentences.en: The vendor's delivery record is unreliable, so we need to find an alternative supplier.
sentences.cn: 供应商的交货记录不可靠，因此我们需要寻找其他供应商。

sentences.en: Due to the unreliable internet connection, the online meeting was frequently interrupted.
sentences.cn: 由于网络连接不稳定，在线会议经常中断。

trans.tran: 不安全；危险的；缺乏保障的

sentences.en: The company halted production due to unsafe working conditions.
sentences.cn: 由于工作环境不安全，公司暂停了生产。

sentences.en: Employees are required to report any unsafe equipment or procedures immediately.
sentences.cn: 员工必须立即报告任何不安全的设备或进程。

trans.tran: 不卫生、不洁，指环境或条件不符合卫生标准，可能导致疾病传播。

sentences.en: The health inspector found the kitchen unsanitary and ordered it to be closed until it met the required standards.
sentences.cn: 卫生检验员发现厨房不卫生，并要求其在符合所需标准之前关闭。

sentences.en: Our company is committed to maintaining a sanitary and safe working environment for all employees, ensuring it is free from unsanitary conditions.
sentences.cn: 我们公司致力于为所有员工维护卫生和安全的工作环境，确保其没有不卫生的情况。

trans.tran: 未达标的；令人不满意的

sentences.en: The customer complained that the product's performance was unsatisfactory.
sentences.cn: 客户投诉该产品的性能令人不满意。

sentences.en: We received an unsatisfactory report on the project's progress, requiring immediate action.
sentences.cn: 我们收到一份关于项目进度的令人不满意的报告，需要立即采取行动。

trans.tran: 不满意；未被满足的

sentences.en: The client expressed that he was unsatisfied with the delayed delivery.
sentences.cn: 客户表示对延迟交货感到不满意。

sentences.en: We strive to provide excellent service to ensure our customers are never unsatisfied.
sentences.cn: 我们努力提供优质服务，以确保客户永远感到满意。

trans.tran: 无担保的；不安全的；未受保护的

sentences.en: Many startups rely on unsecured loans, which typically have higher interest rates due to the lack of collateral.
sentences.cn: 许多新创公司仰赖无担保贷款，由于缺乏抵押品，这类贷款通常利率较高。

sentences.en: Using an unsecured Wi-Fi network can expose your personal data to risks.
sentences.cn: 使用不安全的 Wi-Fi 网络可能会使您的个人数据面临风险。

trans.tran: 未指明的；未详细说明的；未经特别指定的

sentences.en: The exact location of the new office is currently unspecified.
sentences.cn: 新办公室的确切位置目前尚未确定。

sentences.en: Due to unspecified technical issues, the launch has been postponed.
sentences.cn: 由于一些未指明的技术问题，发布会已延期。

trans.tran: 不稳定的；摇摇欲坠的；容易变化的

sentences.en: The company's financial situation is currently unstable due to the recent market fluctuations.
sentences.cn: 由于最近市场波动，该公司的财务状况目前不稳定。

sentences.en: The project's timeline is unstable and may need adjustments based on resource availability.
sentences.cn: 项目的时间表不稳定，可能需要根据资源可用性进行调整。

trans.tran: 未成功的；没有达到预期目标的

sentences.en: Despite the extensive marketing campaign, the product launch proved unsuccessful.
sentences.cn: 尽管进行了广泛的行销活动，产品上市却没有成功。

sentences.en: The negotiations were unsuccessful, and the company decided to postpone the merger.
sentences.cn: 谈判未能达成共识，公司决定延迟合并。

trans.tran: 不确定的；犹豫的；对...感到怀疑

sentences.en: I'm unsure whether we should proceed with the project without further market research.
sentences.cn: 我对是否在没有进一步市场调查的情况下继续这个项目感到犹豫。

sentences.en: The client seemed unsure about the proposed changes to the contract.
sentences.cn: 客户似乎对合约中提出的变更感到不确定。

trans.tran: 直到…为止；在…之前

sentences.en: I will wait here until you return.
sentences.cn: 我会在这里等你回来。

sentences.en: The store is open until 9 PM every day.
sentences.cn: 这家店每天营业到晚上9点。

trans.tran: 不合时宜的；过早的；过于及时的（通常指令人遗憾的事件）

sentences.en: The project's untimely termination resulted in significant financial losses.
sentences.cn: 项目的不合时宜终止导致了显著的财务损失。

sentences.en: Her untimely departure left a void in the team and disrupted the workflow.
sentences.cn: 她过早的离职在团队中留下了空缺，并扰乱了工作流程。

trans.tran: 未使用的；尚未利用的

sentences.en: The company has a significant amount of unused office space that could be subleased.
sentences.cn: 公司有大量的未使用的办公室空间，可以考虑转租。

sentences.en: We need to assess the unused budget for the quarter and determine if we can allocate it to a new project.
sentences.cn: 我们需要评估本季未使用的预算，并确定是否可以将其分配给新项目。

trans.tran: 不寻常的；异常的；非凡的

sentences.en: It's unusual for him to be late for a meeting, he's usually very punctual.
sentences.cn: 他开会迟到很不寻常，他通常都很准时。

sentences.en: The museum features an unusual collection of contemporary art from various cultures.
sentences.cn: 该博物馆展出了一个来自不同文化的非凡当代艺术收藏。

trans.tran: 不寻常地；出乎意料地

sentences.en: The project was completed unusually quickly, thanks to the team's dedication.
sentences.cn: 由于团队的投入，这个项目出乎意料地快速完成。

sentences.en: Sales figures for this quarter are unusually high, indicating a successful marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 本季的销售数字不寻常地高，显示行销活动非常成功。

trans.tran: 揭露；正式发布；公开展示

sentences.en: The company will unveil its new product line at the industry trade show next month.
sentences.cn: 公司将在下个月的行业贸易展览上发布其新的产品线。

sentences.en: The CEO is scheduled to unveil the company's financial results during the press conference.
sentences.cn: 首席运行官预计将在新闻发布会上公布公司的财务结果。

trans.tran: 不受欢迎的；不需要的；未被请求的

sentences.en: The company sent out a mass email, but most of it was unwanted by the recipients.
sentences.cn: 公司发送了一封群发邮件，但大多数收件人都不需要它。

sentences.en: We need to filter out unwanted applications to streamline the hiring process.
sentences.cn: 我们需要过滤掉不需要的申请，以简化招聘流程。

trans.tran: 坚定不移的；毫不动摇的

sentences.en: The CEO gave an unwavering commitment to the project's success.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官对项目的成功给予坚定不移的承诺。

sentences.en: Despite the challenging market conditions, the company maintained an unwavering focus on customer satisfaction.
sentences.cn: 尽管市场环境充满挑战，公司仍保持对客户满意的坚定关注。

trans.tran: 不愿意的；不情愿的

sentences.en: The company was unwilling to invest more resources into the failing project.
sentences.cn: 公司不愿再向这个失败的项目投入更多资源。

sentences.en: Many employees are unwilling to work overtime without additional compensation.
sentences.cn: 许多员工不愿在没有额外报酬的情况下加班。

trans.tran: 放松、舒缓压力，通常指在工作或繁忙的活动后恢复平静。

sentences.en: After a long day of meetings, I like to unwind by listening to music.
sentences.cn: 经过一天的会议后，我喜欢听音乐来放松心情。

sentences.en: The company offers a wellness program to help employees unwind and reduce stress.
sentences.cn: 公司提供健康计划，帮助员工放松心情，减轻压力。

trans.tran: 向上；往上；升高；在上面；起床；醒着；完成；（价格、数量等）上涨；振作；完全地

sentences.en: Could you please turn the volume up a little?
sentences.cn: 请问您可以把音量调大一点吗？

sentences.en: He climbed up the ladder to fix the roof.
sentences.cn: 他爬上梯子去修理屋顶。

trans.tran: 上下；波动；起伏（指价格、数据或表现的变化）

sentences.en: The stock market has been extremely up-and-down this week due to economic uncertainty.
sentences.cn: 由于经济不确定性，本周股市波动剧烈。

sentences.en: The company's sales figures have been up-and-down over the past quarter, requiring a review of our marketing strategy.
sentences.cn: 过去一个季度，公司的销售数据起伏不定，需要审查我们的营销策略。

trans.tran: 最新的；最新的信息

sentences.en: To stay competitive, our marketing team needs to keep its strategies up-to-date with the latest trends.
sentences.cn: 为了保持竞争力，我们的行销团队需要将其策略与最新的趋势保持一致。

sentences.en: Before presenting the report, please ensure all the data is up-to-date.
sentences.cn: 在提交报告之前，请确保所有数据都是最新的。

trans.tran: 积极、乐观的；充满活力的

sentences.en: The team leader delivered an upbeat presentation, boosting employee morale.
sentences.cn: 团队领导人发表了一场充满活力的演示文稿，提升了员工士气。

sentences.en: Despite the challenging market conditions, the company maintained an upbeat outlook.
sentences.cn: 尽管市场状况充满挑战，公司仍然保持乐观的态度。

trans.tran: 即将到来的；预计发生的

sentences.en: The company announced several upcoming product launches at the conference.
sentences.cn: 公司在会议上宣布了几个即将发布的新产品。

sentences.en: Please review the upcoming training schedule and confirm your attendance.
sentences.cn: 请审阅即将到来的培训日程并确认您的出席情况。

trans.tran: 更新；改进；通知最新信息

sentences.en: The IT department will update the software to fix the security vulnerabilities.
sentences.cn: 信息部门将更新软件以修复安全漏洞。

sentences.en: Please check your email for the latest updates on the project timeline.
sentences.cn: 请查看您的电子邮件，以了解项目时间表的最新更新。

trans.tran: 已更新的；已修订的；使…保持最新的（动词）

sentences.en: The sales report has been updated with the latest quarterly figures.
sentences.cn: 销售报告已更新，加入最新的季度数据。

sentences.en: Please ensure that all employees have updated their contact information in the system.
sentences.cn: 请确保所有员工已在系统中更新联系信息。

trans.tran: 更新；最新信息（通常指软件、系统或数据的修正或增补）

sentences.en: The IT department will release software updates every month to ensure system security.
sentences.cn: 信息部门将每月发布软件更新，以确保系统安全。

sentences.en: Please check for updates to your operating system to avoid compatibility issues.
sentences.cn: 请检查操作系统的更新，以避免兼容性问题。

trans.tran: 更新；使现代化；改进

sentences.en: The IT department is currently updating the company's software to the latest version.
sentences.cn: 信息部门目前正在将公司的软件更新到最新版本。

sentences.en: Please ensure your resume is updating with your most recent skills and experience.
sentences.cn: 请确保您的履历已更新您的最新技能和经验。

trans.tran: 升级：将设备、系统或服务提升至较新或较高的版本，以改善性能或功能。

sentences.en: The IT department will upgrade the company's server software next weekend.
sentences.cn: 信息部门将于下周末升级公司的服务器软件。

sentences.en: We need to upgrade our subscription plan to access the premium features.
sentences.cn: 我们需要升级订阅方案以使用高级功能。

trans.tran: 升级；改进（设备、系统、服务等）

sentences.en: The company upgraded its software to the latest version to enhance security.
sentences.cn: 公司将其软件升级到最新版本以增强安全性。

sentences.en: Our premium plan offers upgraded features like priority support and unlimited storage.
sentences.cn: 我们的高级方案提供升级功能，例如优先支持和无限保存空间。

trans.tran: 升级；改进（设备、系统、服务等）

sentences.en: The company is offering free upgrades to the latest software version for all its clients.
sentences.cn: 公司为所有客户提供免费升级到最新软件版本的服务。

sentences.en: We need to upgrade our IT infrastructure to handle the increasing data traffic.
sentences.cn: 我们需要升级我们的 IT 基础架构以处理不断增加的数据流量。

trans.tran: 维护；坚持；遵守（原则、法律、协议等）

sentences.en: The company is committed to upholding the highest ethical standards in all its operations.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于在其所有营运中坚持最高的道德标准。

sentences.en: The contract clearly states that both parties must uphold their obligations.
sentences.cn: 合约明确指出双方必须遵守其义务。

trans.tran: 动词：提高；提升（精神、士气）；改善；使振奋。名词：提升；增长（尤指销售额或利润）；鼓舞；精神振奋。

sentences.en: The new marketing strategy is designed to uplift sales by 20% in the next quarter.
sentences.cn: 新的行销策略旨在将下一季的销售额提升20%。

sentences.en: There was a noticeable uplift in team morale after the successful project launch.
sentences.cn: 项目成功启动后，团队士气有显著的提升。

trans.tran: 将文件或数据上传至网络或服务器。

sentences.en: Please upload your presentation slides to the shared drive by the end of the day.
sentences.cn: 请在今天结束前将您的演示文稿投视频上传至共享云端硬盘。

sentences.en: The IT department is experiencing high traffic as many users are uploading large files simultaneously.
sentences.cn: 由于许多用户同时上传大型文件，IT 部门正在经历高流量。

trans.tran: 在…之上；在…期间；根据

sentences.en: The report is based upon thorough research and analysis.
sentences.cn: 这份报告是根据彻底的研究和分析而成的。

sentences.en: Upon arrival, please proceed to the registration desk.
sentences.cn: 抵达后，请前往报名处。

trans.tran: 位于较高位置的；较高级的；高级的

sentences.en: The upper management team approved the budget proposal.
sentences.cn: 高层管理团队批准了预算提案。

sentences.en: Please submit your report to the upper floors of the building.
sentences.cn: 请将您的报告提交到大楼的较高楼层。

trans.tran: (拳击中) 上钩拳；上击拳

sentences.en: The boxer delivered a powerful uppercut, knocking out his opponent.
sentences.cn: 这位拳击手打出了一记强劲的上钩拳，将对手击倒。

sentences.en: He tried to uppercut his opponent but missed.
sentences.cn: 他试图用上钩拳攻击对手，但没有击中。

trans.tran: 直立的；垂直的；正直的；诚实的

sentences.en: The injured player was helped to an upright position.
sentences.cn: 受伤的球员被扶成直立的姿势。

sentences.en: She is known for her upright character and strong ethical values.
sentences.cn: 她以其正直的品格和坚强的道德观而闻名。

trans.tran: （UPS）联合包裹服务，全球知名的快递公司。

sentences.en: We're using UPS to ship the samples to our overseas clients.
sentences.cn: 我们使用联合包裹服务（UPS）将样品运送给我们海外的客户。

sentences.en: Please track your package using the UPS tracking number provided in the email.
sentences.cn: 请使用电子邮件中提供的联合包裹服务（UPS）追踪编号追踪您的包裹。

trans.tran: 因不满或失望而感到焦虑、烦躁或不高兴。

sentences.en: The manager was upset by the team's failure to meet the deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理对团队未能按时完成期限感到失望。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to hear that you're upset about the delayed shipment. Let me see what I can do.
sentences.cn: 听到您对延迟的货运感到不满，我很抱歉。让我看看我能做些什么。

trans.tran: 楼上；在楼上的位置

sentences.en: The executive offices are upstairs, please take the elevator to the 10th floor.
sentences.cn: 行政办公室在楼上，请搭电梯到 10 楼。

sentences.en: The storage room is upstairs, so you'll need to carry the boxes carefully.
sentences.cn: 保存室在楼上，所以您需要小心地搬运箱子。

trans.tran: 向上地；上升地；往上地

sentences.en: The company's profits have been trending upward for the past two years.
sentences.cn: 公司利润在过去两年里一直呈现上升趋势。

sentences.en: There has been an upward revision of the sales forecast.
sentences.cn: 销售预测已经向上修正。

trans.tran: 铀 (一种放射性化学元素，用于核能发电和核武器)

sentences.en: Uranium is a key component in nuclear power generation.
sentences.cn: 铀是核能发电的关键组成部分。

sentences.en: The price of uranium can fluctuate based on global demand for nuclear energy.
sentences.cn: 铀的价格可能因全球对核能的需求而波动。

trans.tran: 欧拉西克（Urasic）是一种用于数据压缩的算法，尤其适用于文本数据。

sentences.en: Our IT department is exploring the use of Urasic to reduce storage costs for our document archives.
sentences.cn: 我们的信息技术部门正在研究使用欧拉西克来降低我们文档文件的保存成本。

sentences.en: The software engineer recommended Urasic as a viable option for compressing the large dataset.
sentences.cn: 软件工程师推荐欧拉西克作为压缩大型数据集的有效选择。

trans.tran: 指城市或都市的，与乡村相对。

sentences.en: The company is expanding its operations into several urban centers.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在将其业务扩展到几个都市中心。

sentences.en: The urban planning department is responsible for managing the city's infrastructure.
sentences.cn: 都市规划部门负责管理城市的基础设施。

trans.tran: 强烈建议；敦促

sentences.en: The manager urged the team to complete the project before the deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理敦促团队在截止日期前完成项目。

sentences.en: We urge all suppliers to submit their bids by Friday.
sentences.cn: 我们敦促所有供应商在周五前提交他们的报价。

trans.tran: 紧急；急迫

sentences.en: The department implemented innovative urgency procedures to improve operational efficiency.
sentences.cn: 部门实施创新的urgency进程以提高营运效率。

sentences.en: Senior executives discussed the urgency implications during the monthly board meeting.
sentences.cn: 高级主管在月度董事会会议中讨论了urgency影响。

trans.tran: 紧急的；迫切的，指需要立即处理或解决的问题。

sentences.en: The manager emphasized that the matter was urgent and required immediate attention.
sentences.cn: 经理强调这件事非常紧急，需要立即处理。

sentences.en: Please urgently submit your expense reports by the end of the month.
sentences.cn: 请务必在月底前紧急提交您的费用报销单。

trans.tran: 紧急地；迫切地（表示某事需要立即处理或关注）

sentences.en: Please submit your expense report urgently, as the deadline is approaching.
sentences.cn: 请尽快提交您的费用报表，因为截止日期即将到来。

sentences.en: The manager requested that the IT department address the server issue urgently to avoid further disruptions.
sentences.cn: 经理要求 IT 部门紧急处理服务器问题，以避免进一步的中断。

trans.tran: 尿液；小便

sentences.en: The nurse collected a urine sample for the laboratory tests.
sentences.cn: 护士收集了尿液样本以进行实验室检测。

sentences.en: The color of your urine can sometimes indicate your hydration level.
sentences.cn: 尿液的颜色有时可以指示您的水合程度。

trans.tran: 骨灰坛；存放骨灰的容器

sentences.en: The estate agent confirmed that the property included a family urn containing the ashes of the previous owner.
sentences.cn: 房地产经纪人确认，该房产包含一个骨灰坛，存放着前业主的骨灰。

sentences.en: Due to the sensitivity of the matter, the funeral home requested that the urn be handled with utmost care during the relocation.
sentences.cn: 由于事态的敏感性，殡葬业者要求在搬迁过程中小心处理骨灰坛。

trans.tran: 美国（United States of America），指美国联邦政府管辖的国家。

sentences.en: Our company is expanding its operations into the USA next quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们公司下个季度将扩展业务至美国。

sentences.en: The USA is a major trading partner for many countries around the world.
sentences.cn: 美国是许多国家重要的贸易伙伴。

trans.tran: 使用；用法；使用量；惯例

sentences.en: The new software has improved data usage efficiency.
sentences.cn: 新软件提高了数据使用的效率。

sentences.en: Please refer to the manual for proper usage instructions.
sentences.cn: 请参考手册以了解正确的使用说明。

trans.tran: 美元（United States Dollar），美国的官方货币。

sentences.en: The contract stipulates that all payments must be made in USD.
sentences.cn: 合约规定所有付款必须以美元支付。

sentences.en: The exchange rate between USD and EUR fluctuates daily.
sentences.cn: 美元与欧元的汇率每天都在波动。

trans.tran: 使用；利用；应用 (动词); 用途；使用；利用；益处 (名词)

sentences.en: Please use the provided template for your report.
sentences.cn: 请使用提供的范本撰写您的报告。

sentences.en: What is the primary use of this new software feature?
sentences.cn: 这个新软件功能的主要用途是什么？

trans.tran: 有用的；实用的；能发挥作用的

sentences.en: This software is incredibly useful for managing large datasets.
sentences.cn: 这个软件对于管理大型数据集非常有用。

sentences.en: The training session provided useful tips for improving customer service skills.
sentences.cn: 这个培训课程提供了改善客户服务技能的实用技巧。

trans.tran: 用户；顾客；客户

sentences.en: Our software is designed for ease of use by all users, regardless of their technical expertise.
sentences.cn: 我们的软件设计易于所有用户使用，无论他们具备多大的技术专业知识。

sentences.en: The company is conducting a survey to gather feedback from its users and improve the product.
sentences.cn: 公司正在进行一项调查，以收集用户回馈并改进产品。

trans.tran: 易于使用；用户友善的，设计直观且方便用户操作。

sentences.en: The new software interface is designed to be user-friendly for all employees, regardless of their technical expertise.
sentences.cn: 新软件界面设计成对所有员工都易于使用，无论他们具备多少技术专业知识。

sentences.en: We prioritize user-friendly design to ensure a positive customer experience with our online platform.
sentences.cn: 我们优先考虑用户友善的设计，以确保我们的在线平台提供正面的客户体验。

trans.tran: 用户；客户（指产品或服务的用户）

sentences.en: The software company is conducting a survey to gather feedback from its users.
sentences.cn: 该软件公司正在进行一项调查，以收集用户回馈。

sentences.en: We need to prioritize the features that our users have requested the most.
sentences.cn: 我们需要优先考虑用户最常要求的特性。

trans.tran: 使用；运用

sentences.en: The company uses a cloud-based system for data storage.
sentences.cn: 该公司使用云端系统来保存数据。

sentences.en: Our team uses project management software to track progress and deadlines.
sentences.cn: 我们的团队使用项目管理软件来追踪进度与截止日期。

trans.tran: 引导人员；引导员（通常在戏院、体育场馆等场所），亦可指引导顾客到指定位置的人。

sentences.en: The usher directed us to our seats in the concert hall.
sentences.cn: 引导员将我们引导到音乐厅的座位。

sentences.en: Please wait here, an usher will usher you to the conference room.
sentences.cn: 请在此等候，引导员会将您引导到会议室。

trans.tran: 平常的；惯例的；典型的

sentences.en: The meeting is held on the usual day, which is the first Tuesday of each month.
sentences.cn: 会议在惯例的日期举行，也就是每个月的第一个星期二。

sentences.en: We usually process invoices within 10 business days.
sentences.cn: 我们通常在 10 个工作天内处理发票。

trans.tran: 通常，一般而言

sentences.en: The manager usually approves expense reports within a week.
sentences.cn: 经理通常在一周内核准费用报告。

sentences.en: We usually ship orders within 48 hours of receiving them.
sentences.cn: 我们通常在收到订单后 48 小时内发货。

trans.tran: 餐具；炊具（通常指厨房或餐厅使用的工具）

sentences.en: The hotel kitchen is well-equipped with various utensils for preparing meals.
sentences.cn: 饭店厨房配备了各种炊具，以准备餐点。

sentences.en: Please ensure all utensils are cleaned and sanitized after each use.
sentences.cn: 请确保每次使用后都清洗和消毒所有餐具。

sentences.en: The company is trying to reduce its utility costs by implementing energy-saving measures.
sentences.cn: 公司正透过实施节能措施来降低公用事业费用。

sentences.en: Please submit your expense report, including utility bills, by the end of the month.
