trans.tran: 小提琴，一种弦乐乐器，常在音乐会、演出或公司活动中使用。

sentences.en: The company hired a string quartet, including a violinist, for the annual corporate gala.
sentences.cn: 公司为年度企业晚宴聘请了弦乐四重奏团，其中包含一位小提琴手。

sentences.en: During the product launch event, a live violinist provided elegant background music.
sentences.cn: 在产品发布活动期间，一位现场小提琴手提供了优雅的背景音乐。

trans.tran: 非常重要的人 (VIP)；尊贵的顾客或会员，通常享有特殊待遇。

sentences.en: Our hotel offers exclusive amenities and personalized service for all VIP guests.
sentences.cn: 我们饭店为所有尊贵顾客提供独家设施和个人化服务。

sentences.en: The sales team should prioritize contacting VIP clients to ensure their continued loyalty.
sentences.cn: 销售团队应优先联系尊贵客户，以确保他们持续的忠诚度。

trans.tran: 虚拟的；模拟的；不存在于实体空间的

sentences.en: The company held a virtual meeting to discuss the quarterly results.
sentences.cn: 公司举行了虚拟会议来讨论季度业绩。

sentences.en: The software allows users to virtually experience the product before purchasing.
sentences.cn: 这款软件让用户在购买前可以虚拟体验产品。

trans.tran: 几乎；实际上；实质上（表示某事物在某方面与真实情况非常接近，或在某种程度上等同于真实）

sentences.en: The meeting was held virtually due to travel restrictions.
sentences.cn: 由于旅行限制，会议以虚拟方式举行。

sentences.en: The company virtually eliminated paper waste by implementing a digital document management system.
sentences.cn: 公司通过实施数字文档管理系统，几乎消除了纸张浪费。

trans.tran: 美德；优点；贞洁

sentences.en: Patience is a virtue that is hard to acquire.
sentences.cn: 耐心是一种很难获得的美德。

sentences.en: One of the virtues of this new system is its simplicity.
sentences.cn: 这个新系统的优点之一是它的简洁性。

trans.tran: 病毒；（电脑）恶意程序，可能导致系统故障或数据遗失。

sentences.en: The IT department is working to remove the virus from the company network.
sentences.cn: 信息部门正在努力将病毒从公司网络中移除。

sentences.en: To protect your data, always scan any downloaded files for viruses before opening them.
sentences.cn: 为了保护您的数据，请务必在打开任何下载文件之前扫描病毒。

trans.tran: 签证，许可证（指政府核发的允许某人进入或停留某国的官方文档）

sentences.en: The sales team needs to ensure all foreign clients have the necessary visas before the conference.
sentences.cn: 销售团队需要确保所有外国客户在会议前都已取得必要的签证。

sentences.en: Please submit your visa application at least two weeks prior to your business trip.
sentences.cn: 请在商务旅行至少两周前提交您的签证申请。

trans.tran: 能见度；能清楚看见的范围

sentences.en: Due to the dense fog, the visibility on the highway was severely reduced, causing traffic delays.
sentences.cn: 由于浓雾，高速公路的能见度大幅降低，导致交通延迟。

sentences.en: The company's visibility in the market has increased significantly after the successful marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 在成功的行销活动后，该公司的市场能见度显著提高。

trans.tran: 可见的；能被看见的

sentences.en: The company's logo is prominently visible on the building's facade.
sentences.cn: 该公司的标志在建筑外墙上非常显眼。

sentences.en: Due to the fog, the runway was barely visible to the pilots.
sentences.cn: 由于雾，跑道对飞行员来说几乎看不见。

trans.tran: 愿景；远景；对未来的展望（通常指公司或组织的长期目标）

sentences.en: Our company's vision is to become a global leader in sustainable energy solutions.
sentences.cn: 我们公司的愿景是成为可持续能源解决方案的全球领导者。

sentences.en: The CEO presented a compelling vision for the company's future during the annual meeting.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官在年度会议上呈现了公司未来的一个引人入胜的愿景。

trans.tran: 拜访；参观（公司、客户等）；探视

sentences.en: The sales team will visit potential clients next week to present our new product.
sentences.cn: 销售团队将下周拜访潜在客户，以介绍我们的最新产品。

sentences.en: We appreciate your visit to our company and hope to collaborate on future projects.
sentences.cn: 感谢您拜访我们的公司，并希望未来能与您合作。

trans.tran: 拜访；参观（通常指正式或有目的的拜访）

sentences.en: The CEO visited our branch office in Tokyo to review the quarterly performance.
sentences.cn: 首席执行官前往东京的分公司视察，以检讨本季的业绩表现。

sentences.en: Our sales team plans to visit potential clients in Southeast Asia next month.
sentences.cn: 我们的销售团队计划下个月拜访东南亚的潜在客户。

trans.tran: 拜访；参观（通常指商务或正式场合的拜访）

sentences.en: The sales team is visiting potential clients next week to present our new product.
sentences.cn: 销售团队下周将拜访潜在客户，以介绍我们的最新产品。

sentences.en: A visiting executive from headquarters will be attending the project review meeting.
sentences.cn: 总部一位莅临的干部将出席项目审查会议。

trans.tran: 访客；顾客（通常指拜访公司或场所的顾客）

sentences.en: We expect a large number of visitors to our booth at the trade show.
sentences.cn: 我们预计在贸易展览会上会有大量的访客到访我们的摊位。

sentences.en: Please issue a visitor badge to each visitor upon arrival.
sentences.cn: 请在访客抵达时为每位访客发放访客证。

trans.tran: 访客；浏览者（通常指拜访公司、展览等场所的人）

sentences.en: The conference attracted over 500 visitors from various industries.
sentences.cn: 这场会议吸引了来自各行各业的 500 多位访客。

sentences.en: Please sign in as a visitor at the reception desk upon arrival.
sentences.cn: 请在抵达时在接待处登记成为访客。

trans.tran: 视觉上的；与视觉相关的；基于图像或图表的。

sentences.en: The presentation included several visual aids, such as charts and graphs, to illustrate the data.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿包含多种视觉辅助工具，例如图表和图像，以说明数据。

sentences.en: The company is investing in visual marketing to attract a younger demographic.
sentences.cn: 公司正在投资视觉行销以吸引年轻族群。

trans.tran: 想像、可视化，将抽象概念或数据转化为图像或模型以便理解。

sentences.en: The project manager asked the team to visualize the workflow to identify potential bottlenecks.
sentences.cn: 项目经理要求团队可视化工作流程，以找出潜在的瓶颈。

sentences.en: To better understand the data, the analyst used charts and graphs to visualize the sales trends.
sentences.cn: 为了更好地理解数据，分析师使用图表和图形来可视化销售趋势。

trans.tran: 至关重要的；不可或缺的；攸关全局的

sentences.en: Maintaining a strong supply chain is vital for the company's continued success.
sentences.cn: 维持稳健的供应链对公司的持续成功至关重要。

sentences.en: Regular safety checks are vital to prevent accidents in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 定期安全检查对于防止工作场所发生意外至关重要。

trans.tran: 至关重要地；极其重要地

sentences.en: The project's success vitally depends on securing funding by the end of the quarter.
sentences.cn: 项目的成功极其依赖在季末前获得资金。

sentences.en: It is vitally important to review the contract terms before signing.
sentences.cn: 签署合约前审查条款至关重要。

trans.tran: 维生素

sentences.en: Eating a variety of fruits and vegetables ensures you get essential vitamins.
sentences.cn: 摄取多种水果和蔬菜可以确保你获得必需的维生素。

sentences.en: Vitamin C is known for boosting the immune system.
sentences.cn: 维生素C以增强免疫系统而闻名。

trans.tran: 鲜明生动的；引人注目的

sentences.en: The marketing campaign featured a vivid description of the product's benefits to attract potential customers.
sentences.cn: 行销活动以鲜明生动地描述产品的优点，以吸引潜在客户。

sentences.en: The presentation included vivid visuals to illustrate the company's growth and market share.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿包含引人注目的视觉效果，以说明公司的增长和市场份额。

trans.tran: 词汇；词汇量；词典

sentences.en: Reading extensively is a great way to expand your vocabulary.
sentences.cn: 大量阅读是扩充词汇量的好方法。

sentences.en: The technical vocabulary used in this report is quite specialized.
sentences.cn: 这份报告中使用的技术词汇非常专业。

trans.tran: 天职、志业；职业（通常指有意义且充满热情的职业）

sentences.en: Many young professionals are seeking a vocation that aligns with their values.
sentences.cn: 许多年轻专业人士正在寻找符合其价值观的志业。

sentences.en: The company offers career counseling to help employees discover their true vocation.
sentences.cn: 该公司提供职业咨询，以帮助员工发掘他们的真正志向。

trans.tran: 声音；语气；表达意见的方式

sentences.en: The CEO's voice conveyed a sense of confidence and optimism during the annual report presentation.
sentences.cn: 在年度报告发表会上，首席执行官的声音传达了信心和乐观的气氛。

sentences.en: Please voice your concerns about the project timeline to the project manager.
sentences.cn: 请将您对项目进度的疑虑向项目经理表达。

trans.tran: （声音）有声的；发声的

sentences.en: The voiced consonants, like 'b' and 'd', vibrate the vocal cords.
sentences.cn: 像 'b' 和 'd' 这些有声辅音，会使声带震动。

sentences.en: During the presentation, the speaker used a voiced tone to convey empathy.
sentences.cn: 在演示文稿中，演讲者使用有声的语气来传达同理心。

trans.tran: 语音留言信箱；语音留言服务

sentences.en: I'm sorry I missed your call. Please leave a voicemail and I'll get back to you as soon as possible.
sentences.cn: 很抱歉我错过了您的来电。请留下语音留言，我会尽快回复您。

sentences.en: The receptionist will forward all voicemails to the relevant department.
sentences.cn: 接待员会将所有语音留言转发至相关部门。

trans.tran: 空缺；空白；无效

sentences.en: The contract contained a void clause, making it unenforceable.
sentences.cn: 这份合约包含一个无效条款，使其无法运行。

sentences.en: Please void the transaction if you notice any discrepancies.
sentences.cn: 如果您发现任何差异，请取消这笔交易。

trans.tran: 易变的；不稳定的（指价格、市场、情势等），容易快速改变。

sentences.en: The stock market is highly volatile, so investors need to be cautious.
sentences.cn: 股市波动剧烈，投资者需要谨慎。

sentences.en: Due to the volatile currency exchange rates, the company decided to hedge its foreign currency exposure.
sentences.cn: 由于汇率波动剧烈，公司决定对冲其外汇风险。

trans.tran: 波动性；不稳定性

sentences.en: The stock market experienced significant volatility last week due to economic uncertainties.
sentences.cn: 由于经济不确定性，股市上周经历了显著的波动性。

sentences.en: High volatility can make it difficult to predict future price movements of a currency.
sentences.cn: 高波动性会使预测货币未来价格走势变得困难。

trans.tran: 火山，一种地质构造，通常指地表裂缝中喷发熔岩、火山灰和气体的山。

sentences.en: The company's marketing campaign highlighted the region's natural beauty, including its majestic volcanoes.
sentences.cn: 该公司的行销活动强调了该地区的自然美景，包括其雄伟的火山。

sentences.en: Due to the volcanic eruption, the tour operator had to cancel all excursions to the affected area.
sentences.cn: 由于火山爆发，旅行社不得不取消前往受影响地区的所有旅游进程。

trans.tran: 意志；决断力；自愿选择

sentences.en: He made the decision of his own volition, without any pressure from others.
sentences.cn: 他完全是出于自愿做出这个决定，没有受到任何人的压力。

sentences.en: The employee's resignation was an act of pure volition, not a result of any disciplinary action.
sentences.cn: 这名员工的辞职是完全出于其自由意志的行为，而非任何纪律处分的结果。

trans.tran: 排球

sentences.en: She plays volleyball every weekend at the community center.
sentences.cn: 她每个周末都在社区中心打排球。

sentences.en: The team won the championship in a thrilling volleyball match.
sentences.cn: 该队在一场惊心动魄的排球比赛中赢得了冠军。

trans.tran: 电压，电位差，指电路中驱动电荷的力。

sentences.en: The technician needs to check the voltage of the power supply before installing the new server.
sentences.cn: 技术人员需要在安装新的服务器之前检查电源供应器的电压。

sentences.en: The product specifications clearly state the required voltage for optimal performance.
sentences.cn: 产品规格清楚地说明了最佳性能所需的电压。

trans.tran: 音量；容量；数量

sentences.en: Could you please turn down the volume on your speaker during the conference call?
sentences.cn: 在视频会议期间，您能请将喇叭的音量调低吗？

sentences.en: The sales team needs to increase the volume of leads generated through online marketing.
sentences.cn: 销售团队需要透过在线行销产生更多潜在客户。

trans.tran: 大量；数目庞大

sentences.en: The company has accumulated volumes of data from various sources.
sentences.cn: 公司已从各个来源累积了大量数据。

sentences.en: We need to process these volumes of paperwork before the end of the quarter.
sentences.cn: 我们需要在季度结束前处理这些大量的文档。

trans.tran: 自愿地；主动地（表示出于个人意愿，而非强制或要求）

sentences.en: Employees are welcome to volunteer for the company's charity events.
sentences.cn: 员工可以自愿参加公司的慈善活动。

sentences.en: He voluntarily took on the extra workload to help the team meet the deadline.
sentences.cn: 他主动承担额外的任务，以帮助团队按时完成。

trans.tran: 自愿的；义不容辞的；主动的

sentences.en: The company encourages employees to participate in voluntary training programs to enhance their skills.
sentences.cn: 公司鼓励员工自愿参加培训计划，以提升技能。

sentences.en: Voluntary overtime is available for those who wish to complete the project ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 对于希望提前完成项目的人，可提供自愿加班。

trans.tran: 自愿担任；义工，志愿者

sentences.en: Our company encourages employees to volunteer their time for community service projects.
sentences.cn: 我们公司鼓励员工自愿参与社区服务项目。

sentences.en: We are looking for volunteers to assist with the upcoming trade show.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找志愿者协助即将到来的贸易展览。

trans.tran: 志愿者；自愿协助者（通常指为非营利组织或社区服务提供无偿劳动的人员）

sentences.en: The company encourages employees to volunteer their time for community outreach programs.
sentences.cn: 公司鼓励员工参与社区服务计划，贡献时间。

sentences.en: We are seeking volunteers to assist with the upcoming charity event.
sentences.cn: 我们正在寻找志愿者协助即将举办的慈善活动。

trans.tran: 投票；表决

sentences.en: Shareholders will vote on the proposed merger at the annual meeting.
sentences.cn: 股东们将在年度会议上投票表决拟议的合并案。

sentences.en: The employees were given the opportunity to vote on the new benefits package.
sentences.cn: 员工们有机会投票表决新的福利方案。

trans.tran: 投票人；选民

sentences.en: Every registered voter has the right to cast their ballot in the election.
sentences.cn: 每个登记的选民都有权在选举中投下他们的选票。

sentences.en: The political campaign is working hard to engage young voters.
sentences.cn: 这场政治竞选活动正努力争取年轻选民的参与。

trans.tran: 凭证、代金券，通常用于折扣或特定服务的兑换。

sentences.en: Employees can use the company voucher to purchase office supplies.
sentences.cn: 员工可以使用公司代金券购买办公用品。

sentences.en: The hotel offered a voucher for a complimentary dinner to compensate for the inconvenience.
sentences.cn: 为了弥补不便，饭店提供了一张免费晚餐的代金券。

trans.tran: 誓言；发誓，立誓；郑重承诺

sentences.en: She took a vow of silence for one day to raise money for charity.
sentences.cn: 她发誓沉默一天，为慈善机构募款。

sentences.en: The company CEO vowed to improve customer satisfaction.
sentences.cn: 公司首席执行官发誓要提高客户满意度。

trans.tran: 元音

sentences.en: The English alphabet has five main vowels: A, E, I, O, U.
sentences.cn: 英文字母有五个主要元音：A、E、I、O、U。

sentences.en: Each syllable must contain at least one vowel sound.
sentences.cn: 每个音节至少要包含一个元音。

trans.tran: 一趟长途旅行，通常指海上或太空的旅程。

sentences.en: The company is planning a corporate voyage to boost employee morale.
sentences.cn: 公司计划进行一次公司旅行以提升员工士气。

sentences.en: The cargo ship completed its voyage to Europe ahead of schedule.
sentences.cn: 这艘货船比原定时间提前完成了前往欧洲的旅程。

trans.tran: 易受攻击的；脆弱的；易受伤害的

sentences.en: Elderly people are often more vulnerable to cold weather and flu.
sentences.cn: 老年人往往更容易受到寒冷天气和流感的影响。

sentences.en: The company's outdated software made its systems vulnerable to cyberattacks.
sentences.cn: 该公司过时的软件使其系统容易受到网络攻击。

trans.tran: 一种由格子状面糊烤制成的早餐或甜点，通常搭配糖浆、水果或奶油。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a complimentary breakfast buffet including waffles, eggs, and pastries.
sentences.cn: 这家饭店提供免费的早餐自助餐，包括松饼、鸡蛋和糕点。

sentences.en: To attract more customers, the cafe decided to add a special waffle menu for the weekend.
sentences.cn: 为了吸引更多顾客，咖啡店决定在周末推出特别松饼菜单。

trans.tran: 工资；薪水（通常指按小时或按工作量支付的报酬）

sentences.en: The company announced a wage increase for all employees to boost morale.
sentences.cn: 公司宣布提高所有员工的工资，以提高士气。

sentences.en: Employees are paid a minimum wage of $15 per hour.
sentences.cn: 员工的最低工资是每小时 15 美元。

trans.tran: 一辆拉货或运输物品的马车或手推车，通常用于运输货物或农产品。

sentences.en: The logistics team is responsible for loading the wagons with the finished products.
sentences.cn: 物流团队负责将成品的装载到马车上。

sentences.en: The company invested in new wagons to improve the efficiency of its delivery service.
sentences.cn: 公司投资了新的马车，以提高其送货服务的效率。

trans.tran: 腰；腰部

sentences.en: She tied a belt around her waist.
sentences.cn: 她将皮带系在腰上。

sentences.en: The dress was fitted at the waist.
sentences.cn: 这件洋装在腰部很合身。

trans.tran: 腰围

sentences.en: She is trying to reduce her waistline by exercising more.
sentences.cn: 她正努力透过多运动来减小腰围。

sentences.en: The dress accentuated her slender waistline.
sentences.cn: 这件洋装凸显了她纤细的腰身。

trans.tran: 等待；延迟

sentences.en: Please wait for the manager's approval before submitting the report.
sentences.cn: 请在提交报告前等待经理的批准。

sentences.en: Due to unforeseen circumstances, there will be a slight wait for your order.
sentences.cn: 由于突发情况，您的订单将会略有延迟。

trans.tran: 等待；候待

sentences.en: The manager waited for the report to be finalized before presenting it to the board.
sentences.cn: 经理在将报告提交给董事会之前，等待报告最终定稿。

sentences.en: We'll wait for your confirmation before proceeding with the shipment.
sentences.cn: 我们会在收到您的确认后再进行货物发送。

trans.tran: （餐厅、咖啡馆等的）服务生，侍者（尤指男性）

sentences.en: The waiter promptly brought us water and menus.
sentences.cn: 服务生很快就为我们送上了水和菜单。

sentences.en: He used to work as a waiter at a busy Italian restaurant.

sentences.cn: 我们公司提供远程工作机会，所以您可以到任何让您感觉最有生产力的地点工作。

sentences.en: We're expanding our sales network, and we're looking for partners wherever there's potential for growth.
sentences.cn: 我们正在扩展销售网络，并且我们正在寻找有成长潜力的任何地方的合作伙伴。

trans.tran: 是否，无论...与...（引导疑问句，表示选择或可能性）

sentences.en: The manager needs to decide whether to approve the project proposal or not.
sentences.cn: 经理需要决定是否批准项目提案。

sentences.en: We need to determine whether the new software is compatible with our existing systems.
sentences.cn: 我们需要确定新软件是否与我们现有的系统兼容。

trans.tran: 乳清；乳浆

sentences.en: Whey protein is a popular supplement among athletes and bodybuilders.
sentences.cn: 乳清蛋白是运动员和健身者之间流行的补充品。

sentences.en: During the cheese-making process, the milk separates into curds and whey.
sentences.cn: 在起司制作过程中，牛奶会分离成凝乳和乳清。

trans.tran: 无论哪个；任何一个

sentences.en: You can choose whichever seat you prefer.
sentences.cn: 你可以选择任何一个你喜欢的座位。

sentences.en: Whichever decision you make, please inform us in advance.
sentences.cn: 无论你做出哪个决定，请务必提前告知我们。

trans.tran: 在...期间；当...时候；然而，尽管；与此同时；一会儿，一段时间；消磨时间

sentences.en: While the manager was reviewing the proposal, the team was preparing the presentation.
sentences.cn: 当经理审核提案时，团队正在准备演示文稿。

sentences.en: We need to wait for a while before the system restarts.
sentences.cn: 我们需要等一会儿，系统才会重启。

trans.tran: 当...的时候；与...同时；然而；尽管

sentences.en: I often listen to music whilst I am working.
sentences.cn: 我工作的时候经常听音乐。

sentences.en: Some people prefer to work from home, whilst others prefer the office environment.
sentences.cn: 有些人喜欢在家工作，然而其他人则偏好办公室环境。

trans.tran: （厨房用具）打蛋器；快速混合（成分）

sentences.en: The chef used a whisk to quickly combine the eggs and sugar.
sentences.cn: 厨师用打蛋器快速混合鸡蛋和糖。

sentences.en: Please whisk the cream until it forms soft peaks before adding the flavorings.
sentences.cn: 请将鲜奶油打至形成软性发泡，再加入调味。

trans.tran: 耳语；私语；窃窃私语；轻声说；低声说

sentences.en: She leaned in to whisper a secret in his ear.
sentences.cn: 她凑近他耳边轻声说了一个秘密。

sentences.en: I heard a whisper about a new policy change.
sentences.cn: 我听到一个关于新政策变动的传闻。

trans.tran: 白色；纯色；（文档、报告等）空白的

sentences.en: The report needs to be printed on white paper for clarity.
sentences.cn: 为了清晰，报告需要印在白色的纸张上。

sentences.en: The company's logo is predominantly white, conveying a sense of cleanliness and modernity.
sentences.cn: 该公司的标志以白色为主，传达干净和现代的感觉。

trans.tran: 白板，通常用于会议、演示文稿或教学时书写或绘制。

sentences.en: The presenter used a whiteboard to illustrate the project timeline.
sentences.cn: 演示文稿者使用白板来阐述项目时间表。

sentences.en: Could you please erase the whiteboard after the meeting?
sentences.cn: 会议结束后，您能请擦掉白板吗？

trans.tran: 惊叹词，表示惊讶、震惊或赞赏，通常伴随停顿。

sentences.en: Whoa! That's a significant increase in sales figures.
sentences.cn: 哇！销售数字大幅增加。

sentences.en: Whoa, I didn't realize the project was so far behind schedule.
sentences.cn: 哇，我没想到这个项目已经严重落后进度。

trans.tran: 无论是谁；任何人

sentences.en: Whoever wants to join the team must submit their application by Friday.
sentences.cn: 任何想加入团队的人都必须在周五前提交申请。

sentences.en: I'll give the prize to whoever solves the riddle first.
sentences.cn: 我会把奖品送给第一个解开这个谜语的人。

trans.tran: 全部；完整；整个

sentences.en: The company needs to review the whole process to identify areas for improvement.
sentences.cn: 公司需要审查整个流程，以找出需要改进的领域。

sentences.en: We need to allocate the whole budget to the marketing campaign.
sentences.cn: 我们需要将整个预算分配给行销活动。

trans.tran: 批发

sentences.en: The company shifted from retail to wholesale distribution to increase profit margins.
sentences.cn: 公司从零售转向wholesale分销以增加利润率。

sentences.en: Our wholesale clients appreciate competitive pricing and reliable delivery schedules.
sentences.cn: 我们的wholesale客户喜欢有竞争力的价格和可靠的交付时间表。

trans.tran: 批发商

sentences.en: The company's new wholesaler initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
sentences.cn: 公司的新wholesaler计划在第一季度超出了预期。

sentences.en: Department heads discussed the wholesaler strategy during yesterday's executive meeting.
sentences.cn: 部门主管在昨天的高层会议中讨论了wholesaler策略。

trans.tran: 完全地；彻底地；十足地

sentences.en: The success of the project was not wholly unexpected.
sentences.cn: 这个项目的成功并非完全出乎意料。

sentences.en: I'm not wholly convinced by his explanation.
sentences.cn: 我并不完全相信他的解释。

trans.tran: 宽广的；广阔的；涵盖范围广的

sentences.en: The conference room is wide enough to accommodate all attendees comfortably.
sentences.cn: 这个会议室足够宽敞，可以舒适地容纳所有与会者。

sentences.en: The company has a wide range of products to meet diverse customer needs.
sentences.cn: 该公司拥有广泛的产品线，以满足不同的客户需求。

trans.tran: 广泛地；普遍地；在广大范围内

sentences.en: The company's products are widely distributed throughout Asia.
sentences.cn: 该公司的产品在亚洲广泛分销。

sentences.en: The new software is widely used by employees across all departments.
sentences.cn: 新软件广受各部门员工使用。

trans.tran: 扩大；变宽；放宽

sentences.en: The company plans to widen its product range to attract more customers.
sentences.cn: 该公司计划扩大其产品范围以吸引更多顾客。

sentences.en: The road was widened to accommodate increased traffic.
sentences.cn: 为了容纳增加的交通量，道路被拓宽了。

trans.tran: 扩大；增宽；扩展

sentences.en: The company is planning a widening of the distribution network to reach more customers.
sentences.cn: 公司计划扩展配送网络，以接触更多的客户。

sentences.en: The widening gap between the rich and the poor is a serious concern for the government.
sentences.cn: 贫富差距的扩大是政府关注的一个严肃问题。

trans.tran: 广泛的；普遍存在的

sentences.en: The company is facing a widespread problem with its outdated software.
sentences.cn: 这家公司正面临其过时软件所造成的广泛问题。

sentences.en: Widespread adoption of the new system is crucial for the project's success.
sentences.cn: 新系统的广泛采用对于项目的成功至关重要。

trans.tran: 宽度；广度；幅度

sentences.en: The architect specified the exact width for the new doorway.
sentences.cn: 建筑师精确指定了新门口的宽度。

sentences.en: We need to consider the full width of the problem to find a comprehensive solution.
sentences.cn: 我们需要考虑问题的全部广度以找到一个全面的解决方案。

trans.tran: 妻子；配偶（指女性）

sentences.en: The company offers generous benefits, including maternity leave for employees and their wives.
sentences.cn: 公司提供慷慨的福利，包括员工及其妻子们的产假。

sentences.en: Mr. Smith mentioned that his wife is a successful businesswoman.
sentences.cn: 史密斯先生提到他的妻子是一位成功的商务女性。

trans.tran: 扭动；摆动；蠕动；（俚语）回旋余地

sentences.en: The child wiggled with excitement when he saw the ice cream.
sentences.cn: 那个孩子看到冰淇淋时兴奋地扭动着身子。

sentences.en: There's not much wiggle room in the budget for unexpected expenses.
sentences.cn: 预算没有太多回旋余地来应付意外开支。

trans.tran: 维基百科：一个由志愿者共同编辑的在线百科全书，提供广泛主题的信息，常被用于快速查找背景知识。

sentences.en: Before the presentation, I quickly checked Wikipedia for some background information on the company.
sentences.cn: 在演示文稿前，我快速地在维基百科上查阅了一些关于该公司的背景信息。

sentences.en: While Wikipedia can be a useful resource, always double-check the information with reliable sources for accuracy.
sentences.cn: 虽然维基百科可能是一个有用的资源，但务必使用可靠来源核实信息的准确性。

trans.tran: 野生的，未驯服的；未开垦的；狂野的，激烈的；失控的；野外，荒野

sentences.en: The wild animals roamed freely in the vast forest.
sentences.cn: 野生动物在广阔的森林中自由漫步。

sentences.en: They decided to explore the wilds of the Amazon rainforest.
sentences.cn: 他们决定探索亚马逊雨林的荒野地带。

trans.tran: 最疯狂的；最极端的；最不可能的（指想法、计划或情况）

sentences.en: The marketing team proposed the wildest ideas to attract new customers, but the CEO preferred a more conservative approach.
sentences.cn: 行销团队提出了最疯狂的点子来吸引新客户，但首席执行官更偏好更保守的方法。

sentences.en: We're exploring the wildest scenarios for potential supply chain disruptions to prepare for any eventuality.
sentences.cn: 我们正在探讨供应链中断的最极端情况，以应对任何可能性。

trans.tran: 野生动物；自然生态系统中的动物。

sentences.en: The eco-tourism package includes guided tours to observe local wildlife.
sentences.cn: 生态旅游套餐包含导览进程，以观赏当地的野生动物。

sentences.en: The company is committed to protecting wildlife habitats and promoting sustainable practices.
sentences.cn: 该公司致力于保护野生动物栖息地并推广可持续发展的措施。

trans.tran: 愿意、乐意，表示主动接受或同意。

sentences.en: The team is willing to work overtime to meet the project deadline.
sentences.cn: 团队愿意加班以赶上项目期限。

sentences.en: We are willing to consider your proposal, but we need more details.
sentences.cn: 我们愿意考虑您的提案，但我们需要更多细节。

trans.tran: 愿意；乐意；情愿

sentences.en: We appreciate your willingness to work extra hours on this project.
sentences.cn: 我们很感谢你愿意为这个项目加班。

sentences.en: Her willingness to learn new skills impressed the hiring manager.
sentences.cn: 她学习新技能的意愿让招聘经理印象深刻。

trans.tran: 赢得；获胜；取得胜利

sentences.en: Our marketing campaign aims to win over new customers and increase brand loyalty.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销活动旨在赢得新客户并提高品牌忠诚度。

sentences.en: The company hopes to win the contract with its competitive pricing and excellent service.
sentences.cn: 公司希望凭借其具有竞争力的价格和优质服务赢得这份合约。

trans.tran: 风；（尤指）风向，风速；（比喻）趋势，气流

sentences.en: The company is carefully monitoring market winds to anticipate potential shifts in consumer demand.
sentences.cn: 公司正密切关注市场趋势，以预测消费者需求的潜在变化。

sentences.en: The strong winds delayed the delivery of the shipment, causing a backlog at the warehouse.
sentences.cn: 强风延迟了货物的交付，导致仓库积压。

trans.tran: 窗户；窗口；机会

sentences.en: Please close the window; it's getting cold outside.
sentences.cn: 请关上窗户；外面越来越冷了。

sentences.en: We have a small window of opportunity to submit the proposal.
sentences.cn: 我们有很短的时间来提交这份提案。

trans.tran: 橱窗购物；浏览橱窗而不购买商品

sentences.en: During the holiday season, many people enjoy window-shopping along the main street.
sentences.cn: 在节假日期间，许多人喜欢在主街上橱窗购物。

sentences.en: The store hopes that window-shopping will attract customers and increase sales.
sentences.cn: 该店希望橱窗购物能吸引顾客并提高销售额。

trans.tran: 窗户；（电脑）窗口

sentences.en: The office building has large windows to maximize natural light.
sentences.cn: 这栋办公大楼的窗户很大，以最大限度地利用自然光。

sentences.en: Please close all windows before leaving the computer unattended.
sentences.cn: 请在离开电脑前关闭所有窗口。

trans.tran: 窗台；窗户下方的水平平台

sentences.en: The maintenance team needs to repair the cracked windowsill in the conference room.
sentences.cn: 维护团队需要维修会议室的窗台裂缝。

sentences.en: The architect suggested wider windowsills to provide more space for plants and decorations in the office.
sentences.cn: 建筑师建议更宽的窗台，以便在办公室里放置更多植物和装饰品。

trans.tran: 挡风玻璃，汽车前挡风镜

sentences.en: The technician is inspecting the windshield for any cracks before the car is released.
sentences.cn: 技师在将车辆释放前，正在检查挡风玻璃是否有任何裂痕。

sentences.en: Please be careful when cleaning the windshield to avoid scratches.
sentences.cn: 清洁挡风玻璃时请小心，避免刮伤。

trans.tran: 强风暴；狂风暴雨，通常伴随强风和暴雨，可能造成严重损害。

sentences.en: The company temporarily suspended operations due to the approaching windstorm.
sentences.cn: 由于即将到来的强风暴，公司暂停营运。

sentences.en: The logistics team is working to secure all outdoor equipment to prevent damage from the windstorm.
sentences.cn: 物流团队正在努力确保所有室外设备，以防止风暴造成的损坏。

trans.tran: 形容风势强劲，有大风；受风吹动。

sentences.en: The flight was delayed due to the windy conditions at the airport.
sentences.cn: 由于机场风势强劲，航班延误了。

sentences.en: Please secure all outdoor equipment as it's expected to be very windy today.
sentences.cn: 今天预计风势会很大，请确保所有室外设备都已固定。

trans.tran: 葡萄酒；酒（通常指红酒或白酒，在商务场合指供应餐饮的酒类）

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a wide selection of wines to complement the menu.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种葡萄酒，以搭配菜单。

sentences.en: Could we please see the wine list before we place our order?
sentences.cn: 在我们点餐之前，可以请看看酒单吗？

trans.tran: 葡萄酒（复数）；多种葡萄酒的选择。

sentences.en: The restaurant offers a wide selection of wines from around the world.
sentences.cn: 这家餐厅提供来自世界各地的多种葡萄酒选择。

sentences.en: Our company is expanding its wine portfolio to include both red and white wines.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在扩展葡萄酒组合，包括红葡萄酒和白葡萄酒。

trans.tran: 翅膀；（飞机的）机翼；（建筑物的）厢房、侧翼；（组织或政治团体的）派别；助飞；（非正式）即兴发挥

sentences.en: The new wing of the hospital will increase its capacity for patients.
sentences.cn: 医院的新厢房将增加其病患收容量。

sentences.en: He had to wing his speech when his notes went missing just before the conference.
sentences.cn: 在会议前他的笔记不见了，他不得不即兴演讲。

trans.tran: 得胜者；赢家；优胜者

sentences.en: Our team is determined to be the winner of this year's sales competition.
sentences.cn: 我们团队决心赢得今年的销售比赛。

sentences.en: The company announced the winner of the innovation award at the annual conference.
sentences.cn: 公司在年度会议上宣布了创新奖的得主。

trans.tran: 获胜的；胜利的；赢得的

sentences.en: The company's winning strategy resulted in a significant increase in sales.
sentences.cn: 该公司的得胜策略导致销售额显著增加。

sentences.en: The winning bid for the project was submitted by Global Solutions.
sentences.cn: Global Solutions 提交了该项目的得标标单。

trans.tran: 冬季；寒冷的季节

sentences.en: Due to the severe winter weather, all flights to Chicago have been canceled.
sentences.cn: 由于严重的冬季天气，所有前往芝加哥的航班都已取消。

sentences.en: The company is offering discounts on winter clothing to boost sales during the holiday season.
sentences.cn: 为了在节假日期间提高销售额，公司正在提供冬季服装的折扣。

trans.tran: 擦拭；清除（污垢、液体等）

sentences.en: Please wipe down the conference room table before the meeting.
sentences.cn: 请在会议前擦拭会议室的桌子。

sentences.en: The cleaning staff is responsible for wiping spills immediately to prevent accidents.
sentences.cn: 清洁人员负责立即擦拭溢出的液体，以防止发生意外。

trans.tran: 雨刷；擦拭器

sentences.en: The car's wipers weren't working well during the heavy rain.
sentences.cn: 在倾盆大雨中，汽车的雨刷表现不佳。

sentences.en: He used a special wiper to clean the delicate camera lens.
sentences.cn: 他使用特殊的擦拭器清洁精密的相机镜头。

trans.tran: 电线；金属线；电报；电汇（名词） 将…电汇；给…接电线；窃听（动词）

sentences.en: The technician found a loose wire that was causing the problem.
sentences.cn: 技术人员发现了一条松脱的电线，导致了这个问题。

sentences.en: I need to wire the payment to the supplier by tomorrow.
sentences.cn: 我需要在明天之前将款项电汇给供应商。

trans.tran: 无线的；不使用电缆或线的

sentences.en: Our company is transitioning to a wireless network to improve employee mobility and reduce cabling costs.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在转向无线网络，以提高员工的移动性并降低电缆成本。

sentences.en: The wireless headset allows for hands-free communication during conference calls.
sentences.cn: 无线耳机允许在电话会议期间进行免提通信。

trans.tran: 智能，才智；明智，英明；知识，学问；至理名言，格言

sentences.en: True leadership requires not just authority, but also wisdom and empathy.
sentences.cn: 真正的领导力不仅需要权威，还需要智能和同理心。

sentences.en: Her grandmother imparted many words of wisdom that guided her throughout her life.
sentences.cn: 她的祖母传授了许多智能之言，引导她一生。

trans.tran: 聪明的；明智的；有智能的

sentences.en: It was a wise decision to invest in renewable energy.
sentences.cn: 投资再生能源是一个明智的决定。

sentences.en: She is known for her wise advice.
sentences.cn: 她以其明智的建议而闻名。

trans.tran: 明智地；聪明地

sentences.en: She wisely invested her savings in a diversified portfolio.
sentences.cn: 她明智地将储蓄投资于多元化的投资组合。

sentences.en: The team decided to proceed cautiously and wisely to avoid any potential risks.
sentences.cn: 团队决定谨慎且明智地进行，以避免任何潜在风险。

trans.tran: 希望、期望；祝愿

sentences.en: I wish to confirm my reservation for tomorrow morning.
sentences.cn: 我希望确认我明天早上的预订。

sentences.en: We wish you a successful business trip and a profitable quarter.
sentences.cn: 祝您旅途顺利，本季度业绩丰厚。

trans.tran: 愿望；期望（通常指无法实现或不太可能实现的愿望）

sentences.en: The company wishes its employees a happy and prosperous New Year.
sentences.cn: 公司祝愿所有员工新年快乐，万事如意。

sentences.en: I wish our negotiations could lead to a mutually beneficial agreement.
sentences.cn: 我希望我们的谈判能达成互利的协议。

trans.tran: 机智；幽默的智能，通常用于巧妙地表达或回应。

sentences.en: The negotiator's quick wit helped diffuse the tense situation.
sentences.cn: 谈判员的机智有助于化解紧张局势。

sentences.en: She displayed a sharp wit during the presentation, keeping the audience engaged.
sentences.cn: 她在演示文稿中展现了敏锐的机智，让听众保持参与。

trans.tran: 1. 取回，提领（钱）；2. 撤回，收回（声明、提议等）；3. 退出，离开（组织、活动、地方）；4. 撤退，后退

sentences.en: You can withdraw cash from the ATM at any time.

sentences.cn: 她左手腕戴着一块漂亮的手表。

sentences.en: The doctor examined the patient's injured wrist.
sentences.cn: 医生检查了病患受伤的手腕。

trans.tran: 腕表；手表

sentences.en: He glanced at his wristwatch to check the time before the meeting started.
sentences.cn: 会议开始前，他瞥了一眼腕表以确认时间。

sentences.en: She wears a vintage leather wristwatch that complements her style.
sentences.cn: 她戴着一只复古皮革腕表，与她的风格相得益彰。

trans.tran: 书写；记录；撰写

sentences.en: Please write a formal email to the vendor regarding the delayed shipment.
sentences.cn: 请撰写一封正式电子邮件给供应商，说明货物延迟的情况。

sentences.en: The secretary is responsible for writing meeting minutes and distributing them to the attendees.
sentences.cn: 秘书负责记录会议纪要并发送给与会者。

trans.tran: 撰稿人；作家，通常指专业的写作者或记者。

sentences.en: Our company is seeking a skilled writer to create engaging marketing content.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在寻找一位技巧娴熟的撰稿人，以创建引人入胜的行销内容。

sentences.en: The writer spent weeks researching the topic before drafting the report.
sentences.cn: 撰稿人在撰写报告之前花了几周的时间研究这个主题。

trans.tran: 作家；撰写者（通常指专业或频繁写作的人）

sentences.en: The company is seeking experienced writers to create marketing materials.
sentences.cn: 该公司正在寻找有经验的作家来制作行销材料。

sentences.en: Several writers contributed articles to the company newsletter.
sentences.cn: 几位作家为公司电子报投稿了文章。

trans.tran: 书写；撰写（文档、信件等）

sentences.en: The marketing team needs to write a compelling proposal to secure the contract.
sentences.cn: 行销团队需要撰写一份引人注目的提案，以确保签订合约。

sentences.en: Please write a brief email summarizing the key points of the meeting.
sentences.cn: 请撰写一封简短的电子邮件，总结会议的重点。

trans.tran: 错误的；不正确的；错误答案

sentences.en: I'm afraid there's been a wrong entry in the invoice.
sentences.cn: 恐怕发票上有错误的数据。

sentences.en: You're wrong to assume that the project is already completed.
sentences.cn: 你认为项目已经完成是错误的。

trans.tran: 对外族人或不同文化抱持恐惧、厌恶或偏见的态度。

sentences.en: The company strives to create an inclusive work environment, free from xenophobic attitudes.
sentences.cn: 公司致力于创造一个包容的工作环境，避免任何排外态度。

sentences.en: The HR department addressed the employee's xenophobic comments during the sensitivity training session.
sentences.cn: 人力资源部门在敏感性培训课程中处理了员工的排外言论。

trans.tran: 雅虎（Yahoo!）是一个全球知名的网络科技公司，提供搜索引擎、新闻、电子邮件等服务。

sentences.en: Our IT department uses Yahoo! Mail for internal communication.
sentences.cn: 我们的信息技术部门使用雅虎邮件进行内部沟通。

sentences.en: The marketing team is analyzing Yahoo! search trends to optimize our online advertising campaign.
sentences.cn: 行销团队正在分析雅虎搜索趋势，以优化我们的在线广告活动。

trans.tran: 庭院；码数（英制单位）

sentences.en: The company is planning to expand its operations by purchasing a property with a large yard.
sentences.cn: 公司计划透过购买拥有大庭院的物业来扩展其业务。

sentences.en: The landscaping team will measure the yard to determine the amount of grass seed needed.
sentences.cn: 景观团队将测量庭院，以确定所需的人工草坪数量。

trans.tran: 表示肯定、同意或肯定的口语表达。

sentences.en: Client: Do you confirm the delivery date?  Representative: Yeah, it's scheduled for next Tuesday.
sentences.cn: 客户：您确认交货日期吗？ 代表：是的，已排定下周二交货。

sentences.en: Manager: Are you ready to start the presentation? Employee: Yeah, I'm all set.
sentences.cn: 经理：您准备好开始演示文稿了吗？ 员工：是的，我已准备就绪。

trans.tran: 年；年份；学年；年度

sentences.en: The company reported record profits this year.
sentences.cn: 公司今年实现了创纪录的利润。

sentences.en: He has been working here for five years.
sentences.cn: 他已经在这里工作五年了。

trans.tran: 年度末；年末

sentences.en: The year-end financial report is due by December 15th.
sentences.cn: 年度财务报告的截止日期是 12 月 15 日。

sentences.en: We're planning a year-end party to celebrate our team's achievements.
sentences.cn: 我们正在规划一个年末派对来庆祝团队的成就。

trans.tran: 每年的；一年一次的

sentences.en: The company's annual report is released yearly.
sentences.cn: 公司年度报告每年发布一次。

sentences.en: We conduct a yearly performance review for all employees.
sentences.cn: 我们每年为所有员工进行绩效考核。

trans.tran: 渴望；强烈期盼（通常指非物质的需求，如成就、认可或归属感）

sentences.en: Many employees yearn for opportunities for professional development and advancement within the company.
sentences.cn: 许多员工渴望在公司内部获得专业发展和晋升的机会。

sentences.en: The team yearned for recognition of their hard work and dedication to the project.
sentences.cn: 团队渴望对他们为项目付出的辛勤工作和奉献获得认可。

trans.tran: 酵母；酵母菌

sentences.en: Yeast is an essential ingredient for making bread rise.
sentences.cn: 酵母是面包发酵的必需成分。

sentences.en: Many types of beer are brewed using different strains of yeast.
sentences.cn: 许多种类的啤酒都是使用不同菌株的酵母酿造的。

trans.tran: 大声喊叫；斥责

sentences.en: The manager yelled at the employee for missing the deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理因为错过期限而斥责了这位员工。

sentences.en: Please refrain from yelling in the office; it disrupts the work environment.
sentences.cn: 请勿在办公室大声喊叫，这会干扰工作环境。

trans.tran: 大声喊叫，咆哮（通常带有愤怒或不满的情绪）

sentences.en: The manager was yelling at the employee for missing the deadline.
sentences.cn: 经理因为错过期限而大声斥责这位员工。

sentences.en: The client stopped yelling when he realized he had misunderstood the contract.
sentences.cn: 当这位客户意识到他误解了合约后，就停止了咆哮。

trans.tran: 黄色的；黄色

sentences.en: The company logo uses a bright yellow color to stand out.
sentences.cn: 公司的标志使用鲜黄色来突显。

sentences.en: She preferred the yellow folders for urgent documents.
sentences.cn: 她偏爱用黄色文档夹来放紧急文档。

trans.tran: 日圆 (日本的货币单位); 渴望，热衷 (非正式)

sentences.en: The Japanese yen strengthened against the US dollar today.
sentences.cn: 日圆今天对美元走强。

sentences.en: She has a yen for spicy food.
sentences.cn: 她非常喜欢吃辣的食物。

trans.tran: 是的；对；没错（非正式）

sentences.en: Are you ready to go?
sentences.cn: 你准备好出发了吗？

sentences.en: Yep, I'm all set.
sentences.cn: 是的，我准备好了。

trans.tran: 是；好的；可以；对；用于表示肯定、同意、允许或回应

sentences.en: Do you agree with the proposal?
sentences.cn: 你同意这项提案吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I think it's a good plan.
sentences.cn: 是的，我认为这是个好计划。

trans.tran: 昨天

sentences.en: I completed the report yesterday afternoon.
sentences.cn: 我昨天下午完成了报告。

sentences.en: Yesterday was a public holiday, so the office was closed.
sentences.cn: 昨天是国定假日，所以办公室休息。

trans.tran: 至今；还；尚未；仍然；但是；然而

sentences.en: Has the new software update been released yet?
sentences.cn: 新的软件更新发布了吗？

sentences.en: She was tired, yet she continued to work on the presentation.
sentences.cn: 她很累，但她仍然继续制作演示文稿。

trans.tran: （生产、农作物等）产出；屈服；让步

sentences.en: The factory's annual yield of widgets increased by 15% this year.
sentences.cn: 今年工厂的零件产量增加了 15%。

sentences.en: The supplier agreed to yield to our request for a lower price per unit.
sentences.cn: 供应商同意屈从于我们降低单价的要求。

trans.tran: 瑜伽，一种结合体位法、呼吸控制和冥想的健身和精神练习。

sentences.en: The company offers yoga classes to employees as part of its wellness program.
sentences.cn: 公司将瑜伽课程作为其健康计划的一部分提供给员工。

sentences.en: To improve productivity, we encourage employees to incorporate short yoga breaks into their workday.
sentences.cn: 为了提高生产力，我们鼓励员工在工作日中加入短暂的瑜伽休息。

trans.tran: 瑜伽修行者；瑜伽士

sentences.en: The yogi demonstrated various advanced postures with ease.
sentences.cn: 这位瑜伽修行者轻松地展示了各种高难度姿势。

sentences.en: Many people find that being a yogi helps them achieve mental peace and physical flexibility.
sentences.cn: 许多人发现成为瑜伽修行者有助于他们获得心灵平静和身体柔韧性。

trans.tran: 优格，一种发酵乳制品，常作为健康早餐或点心。

sentences.en: The hotel offers a complimentary yogurt and fruit breakfast for all guests.
sentences.cn: 饭店为所有住客提供免费的优格和水果早餐。

sentences.en: Our company is considering adding a yogurt parfait option to the employee cafeteria menu.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在考虑将优格杯添加到员工餐厅的菜单中。

trans.tran: 约克郡（英国的郡名）；约克郡的，属于约克郡的

sentences.en: The company is considering opening a new branch in York, a popular tourist destination.
sentences.cn: 公司正在考虑在约克开设一家新分店，约克是一个受欢迎的旅游胜地。

sentences.en: Many visitors enjoy exploring the historic city of York and its surrounding Yorkshire countryside.
sentences.cn: 许多游客喜欢探索历史悠久的约克市以及周围的约克郡乡村。

trans.tran: （日本游戏公司）任天堂，通常指任天堂公司及其产品。

sentences.en: The IT department is troubleshooting issues with the Nintendo Switch, a product from Yoshi.
sentences.cn: IT 部门正在处理任天堂 Switch 的问题，这是一款由任天堂（Yoshi）出品的产品。

sentences.en: Our marketing campaign will feature popular characters from Yoshi's games to attract younger consumers.
sentences.cn: 我们的行销活动将以任天堂游戏中的热门角色为特色，以吸引年轻消费者。

trans.tran: 年轻的；年幼的；初期的；经验不足的

sentences.en: She is a young professional with a lot of potential.
sentences.cn: 她是一位充满潜力、年轻的专业人士。

sentences.en: The company is looking for young talent to join its innovative team.
sentences.cn: 公司正在寻找年轻人才加入其创新团队。

trans.tran: 指代自己；亲自

sentences.en: Please review the document yourself before submitting it to your supervisor.
sentences.cn: 请在提交给您的主管之前，亲自审阅文档。

sentences.en: Make sure you familiarize yourself with the company's policies and procedures.
sentences.cn: 请务必熟悉公司的政策和流程。

trans.tran: 年轻时期；青春岁月；年轻一代

sentences.en: The company is actively seeking young talent to drive innovation and growth.
sentences.cn: 该公司正积极寻找年轻人才以推动创新和增长。

sentences.en: Our mentorship program aims to support the professional development of youth entering the workforce.
sentences.cn: 我们的导师计划旨在支持进入职场的年轻人专业发展。

trans.tran: 人民币，中国的官方货币。

sentences.en: The company's revenue increased by 15% when converted from dollars to yuan.
sentences.cn: 将美元转换为人民币后，公司的收入增加了 15%。

sentences.en: Please note that all payments must be made in yuan.
sentences.cn: 请注意，所有付款必须以人民币支付。

trans.tran: 裕子 (日文女性名); 尤姬子 (罕见)

sentences.en: Ms. Yukiko from the Tokyo branch will be attending the conference.
sentences.cn: 来自东京分公司的裕子小姐将会出席会议。

sentences.en: Please direct all inquiries regarding the project to Yukiko’s email address.
sentences.cn: 请将所有关于项目的询问寄至裕子的电子邮件地址。

trans.tran: 美味的; 好吃的

sentences.en: This cake is really yummy!
sentences.cn: 这蛋糕真好吃！

sentences.en: The children said the cookies were very yummy.
sentences.cn: 孩子们说饼干非常好吃。

trans.tran: 零碎、小片；（尤指）剩余的材料或零件

sentences.en: The warehouse manager instructed the team to sort through the zacs of fabric and identify usable pieces.
sentences.cn: 仓库经理指示团队筛选出这些剩余的布料碎片，并辨识可用的部分。

sentences.en: Despite the damaged packaging, the zacs of electronic components arrived safely at the factory.
sentences.cn: 尽管包装受损，这些电子零件的碎片仍然安全地抵达工厂。

trans.tran: （俚语）非常；极其；惊人地

sentences.en: The project was completed zack quickly, thanks to the team's dedication.
sentences.cn: 由于团队的奉献，这个项目以惊人的速度完成。

sentences.en: The sales figures for this quarter are zack impressive!
sentences.cn: 本季的销售数字非常令人印象深刻！

trans.tran: 赞比西亚，是位于非洲东南部的国家，以其丰富的自然资源和发展中的经济体而闻名。

sentences.en: Our company is exploring opportunities to invest in infrastructure projects in Zambia.
sentences.cn: 我们公司正在考虑在赞比西亚投资基础设施项目。

sentences.en: The travel agency offers guided tours to Victoria Falls, a major attraction in Zambia.
sentences.cn: 旅行社提供前往维多利亚瀑布的导览旅行，这是赞比西亚的一个主要景点。

trans.tran: 热忱的；充满热情的，尤指对某事抱有强烈信念或渴望。

sentences.en: The company seeks zealous candidates who are passionate about innovation and eager to contribute to our team.
sentences.cn: 公司寻找热忱的候选人，他们对创新充满热情，并渴望为我们的团队做出贡献。

sentences.en: Her zealous dedication to the project ensured its successful completion despite numerous challenges.
sentences.cn: 她对该项目的热忱投入，确保了该项目的成功完成，尽管面临了众多挑战。

trans.tran: 零；无；毫无；最低点

sentences.en: The temperature dropped to zero degrees Celsius last night.
sentences.cn: 昨晚气温降到摄氏零度。

sentences.en: We have zero tolerance for discrimination in the workplace.
sentences.cn: 我们对职场歧视零容忍。

trans.tran: 锌 (一种化学元素，符号为 Zn，是人体必需的微量元素，也常用于合金和电镀)

sentences.en: Zinc is an essential trace mineral that plays a crucial role in immune function.
sentences.cn: 锌是一种必需的微量矿物质，在免疫功能中扮演着关键角色。

sentences.en: The manufacturer uses a special process to zinc the steel components to prevent corrosion.
sentences.cn: 制造商采用特殊工艺将钢材部件镀锌以防止腐蚀。

trans.tran: 将…压缩成 ZIP 文件；(电脑文件) ZIP 压缩文件

sentences.en: Please zip the presentation files before sending them via email to save space.
sentences.cn: 请在透过电子邮件发送演示文稿文件之前将其压缩成 ZIP 文件以节省空间。

sentences.en: The IT department is zipping the large database backup to upload it to the cloud server.
sentences.cn: IT 部门正在将大型数据库备份压缩成 ZIP 文件，以便上传到云端服务器。

trans.tran: 区域；特定范围（通常指划定的区域，例如商业区、禁区等）

sentences.en: The warehouse is divided into several zones for different product categories.
sentences.cn: 仓库被划分为几个区域，以存放不同的产品类别。

sentences.en: Please refrain from using your cell phone in the restricted zone.
sentences.cn: 请勿在限制区域使用您的手机。

trans.tran: 动物园

sentences.en: We plan to visit the local zoo next weekend with the kids.
sentences.cn: 我们计划下周末带孩子们去参观当地动物园。

sentences.en: The city's zoo is famous for its conservation efforts for endangered species.
sentences.cn: 这座城市的动物园以其对濒危物种的保育工作而闻名。
